entry.title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT

author.name: Thiago Laitz, Thales Sales Almeida, Jo\~ao Guilherme Alves Santos, Giovana Kerche Bon\'as

entry.summary: Introduces moBERTo, a Portuguese ModernBERT obtained via continued pretraining on 60B tokens, preserving rotary embeddings, alternating attention, and flash attention. Evaluated across retrieval (up to 8K tokens), classification, NER, and NLU.

entry.title: On the Effect of Segmentation Width and Cluster Size on Speech Resynthesis and Continuation in Generative Spoken Language Models

author.name: Shunsuke Kando, Wataru Nakata, Shinnosuke Takamichi, Yusuke Miyao

entry.summary: Investigates how segmentation width and K-means cluster size affect speech resynthesis and continuation in Generative Spoken Language Modeling across bitrate settings. Finds intelligible speech can be synthesized at lower bitrates than baseline, suggesting conventional GSLM settings may be redundant.

entry.title: The Language Blind Spot: How Query Language and Brand Recognition Tier Shape AI-Constructed Brand Reputation Across Twelve European Languages

author.name: Dmitrij \.Zatuchin (Estonian Entrepreneurship University of Applied Sciences)

entry.summary: Measures how query language and brand recognition tier shape AI-constructed brand reputation across twelve European languages using three grounded LLMs and multilingual embeddings. Finds reputation is language-bound, challenging English-only monitoring.

entry.title: GIM-ENDO: A Multimodal Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Morphology and Pathology

author.name: Mojgan Forootan, Mahziar Setayeshfar, Ali Darvishi, Mohammad Tashakoripour, Hamidreza Bolhasani

entry.summary: Releases GIM-ENDO, a multimodal endoscopic image and video dataset for gastric intestinal metaplasia with histopathological validation, subtype labels, and standardized grading. Fills a gap for AI-driven early gastric cancer precursor detection.

entry.title: SEED: Simple ViT and Evolving Harness for Explainable Text Forgery Detection

author.name: Kahim Wong, Kemou Li, Yiming Chen, Haiwei Wu, Jiantao Zhou

entry.summary: Presents SEED, a modular system for explainable multilingual text forgery detection combining synthetic augmentation, a DINOv3+LoRA ViT for joint detection and localization, and an evolving harness for forensic report generation. Targets the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics Challenge.

entry.title: OSOG: A Differentiable, Physics-Informed Synthetic Data Engine for Micro-Optical Environments

author.name: Caio Silva

entry.summary: Introduces OSOG, a fully differentiable physics-informed synthetic data engine for micro-optical environments based on wave-optics models of diffraction and phase retardation. Addresses scarcity of densely annotated microscopy data for deep learning.

entry.title: Boundary-by-Mask: Few-Shot Instance Segmentation with Mask-Conditioned Boundary Learning for Texture-Poor Industrial Parts

author.name: Yutaka Yoshinaga, Naoya Chiba, Koichi Hashimoto

entry.summary: Proposes Boundary-by-Mask, a few-shot instance segmentation framework for texture-poor industrial parts that supervises boundaries via a signed distance function head instead of interior appearance. Addresses application-specific instance definitions and domain gaps.

entry.title: GTA-Net: Cooperative Game Theory for Vision-Language Alignment in Chest X-Ray Report Generation

author.name: Saif ur Rehman Khan, Imad Ahmed Waqar, Sebastian Vollmer, Muhammad Nabeel Asim

entry.summary: Proposes GTA-Net, framing chest X-ray report generation as a cooperative game-theoretic vision-language alignment problem with Shapley-inspired importance weighting and disease-aware aligners. Targets explicit region-word correspondence and clinical consistency.

entry.title: Morphology-Aware Multimodal Representation Learning for Insect Phylogenetic Reconstruction

author.name: Zixuan Liu, Kaijie Yu, Chun He, Xiaoxu Cai, Xinhai Ye, Haishuai Wang, Gongyin Ye, Jiajun Bu

entry.summary: Presents a morphology-aware multimodal framework combining insect specimen images with curated morphological text descriptions via parameter-efficient fine-tuning and contrastive learning for phylogenetic reconstruction. Aligns image and text in a shared latent space.

entry.title: Physically-guided Image Generation for Multi-Projection Mapping

author.name: Xingyun Liu, Yuqi Li, Jinhui Xiang, Pinyan Tang, Chong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ConPhyG, a physically-guided image generation framework for multi-projection mapping, formalizing cooperative (semantic harmonization) and adversarial (radiometric compensation) generative paradigms. Bridges idealized 2D diffusion generation with physical projection constraints.

entry.title: DrivingVoxels: Compositional Sparse Voxel Rasterization for Dynamic Driving Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Tania Aguirre, Luis Rold\~ao, Moussab Bennehar, Nathan Piasco, Dzmitry Tsishkou, Simone Rossi, Pietro Michiardi

entry.summary: Presents DrivingVoxels, a compositional sparse voxel rasterization framework for dynamic driving scene reconstruction that jointly rasterizes multiple octrees in a single pass. Aims for faster, memory-bounded reconstruction compared to dynamic Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: LUMINA-26: Low-Light Understanding for Modeling and Interpreting Night-time Actions

author.name: Aman Kumar Pandey, Anil Singh Parihar

entry.summary: Introduces LUMINA-26, a low-light human action recognition dataset of 6,784 clips across 26 action classes under naturally occurring low-light conditions, plus Illumi-Net, an illumination-adaptive mixture-of-experts network. Addresses scarcity of diverse, realistic low-light action data.

entry.title: LightSTAR: Efficient Visual Document Retrieval via Lightweight Selection with Vision-Adaptive Refinement

author.name: Tongkun Guan, Haocheng Wang, Wei Shen, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes LightSTAR, an efficient visual document retrieval framework that uses LLM-free visual selection exploiting keyword-anchored queries to quickly narrow candidate pages before expensive MLLM encoding. Reduces the prohibitive cost of encoding every page with MLLMs.

entry.title: LOGOS: LiDAR-Only Gaussian Elevation Splatting for Unified Tiny Obstacle Segmentation

author.name: Nan Ming, Yeqiang Qian, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

entry.summary: Presents LOGOS, a LiDAR-only unified tiny obstacle segmentation system that models the road surface via Gaussian elevation splatting to distinguish curbs, gravel, and potholes from road undulations. Targets robustness in degraded off-road LiDAR scenarios.

entry.title: Overcoming Imperfect Kinematics in Surgical Robotics Through Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Learning

author.name: Zhaoxuan Yan, Kaizhong Deng, Zhaoyang Jacopo Hu, George P. Mylonas, Daniel S. Elson

entry.summary: Uses sim-to-real visuomotor learning with a teacher-student framework to actively compensate for imperfect kinematics in surgical robots, fusing unreliable internal readings with precise visual feedback. Addresses control errors from unreliable internal sensors.

entry.title: BIT-Nav: Brain-Inspired Trajectory Memory for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Rithvik Jonna, Aakash Gurram, Man Namgung, Wyatt Mackey, Tinoosh Mohsenin

entry.summary: Introduces BIT-Nav, a brain-inspired compact trajectory memory module that augments frozen VLM navigation pipelines, motivated by hippocampal path integration, to capture turning patterns and path topology beyond sparse frame selection. Targets long-horizon embodied navigation.

entry.title: ACEsplat: Accelerated 3D Gaussian Scene Regression via RGB and Poses Only

author.name: Mingkai Liu, Haohua Que, Dikai Fan, Haojia Gao, Tianle Zhu, Handong Yao, Qian Zhang, Ruopeng Zhang, Xianliang Huang, Fei Qiao

entry.summary: Introduces ACEsplat, a fast per-scene 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization framework that reconstructs from RGB images and poses only using a self-supervised scene-coordinate regression module, avoiding external SfM or depth priors. Builds an internal geometry prior in 4-5 minutes.

entry.title: When Robots Rate Their Own Interactions: Engagement Validity and the Strangeness Failure

author.name: Victor Lockwood, Hasan Mahmud, Mohammad Javad Khojasteh, Prabu David, Jamison Heard

entry.summary: Proposes inverted evaluation in which LLM-powered robots complete standard HRI questionnaires from their own perspective, testing agreement with human ground truth. Across five LLMs and over 1,500 evaluations, LLMs matched humans on engagement dimensions but systematically inverted comfort/strangeness ratings, revealing a key failure mode.

entry.title: TSD: A Physics-Inspired Trajectory Saliency Detector for Efficient Imitation Learning

author.name: Yiming Zhao, Gongrui Ma, Qingkai Li, Mingguo Zhao

entry.summary: TSD is a training-free, plug-and-play trajectory saliency detector that categorizes manipulation motions into transitional, precise, and agile types using physically grounded metrics (spatial entropy and centripetal acceleration) to prioritize task-critical segments for efficient imitation learning. It targets the high cost of collecting high-quality demonstration data.

entry.title: Nonparametric Deconvolution and Denoising using Simulation Based Inference

author.name: Ritwik Vashistha, Abhra Sarkar, Arya Farahi

entry.summary: Presents a likelihood-free, simulation-based framework for nonparametric density deconvolution and empirical Bayes denoising under additive measurement error, using a convolutional maximum mean discrepancy loss to match observed and noise-convolved model distributions. It yields a differentiable objective for multivariate latent signal recovery.

entry.title: A First-Order Mean Field Control Analysis of Transformer Layers under Cross-Entropy Training

author.name: Cheng Huan, Hongwei Yuan

entry.summary: Studies Transformer residual layers under cross-entropy training through a continuous-depth mean field control viewpoint, treating depth as time and proving pathwise approximation of finite-depth trajectories by a continuous controlled flow. It derives a Pontryagin optimality condition and sampling bounds for the empirical risk.

entry.title: Bridging Multi-Valued Heuristics and Dimensionality Reduction in Multi-Objective Search

author.name: Maya Wolff, Ariel Felner, Oren Salzman

entry.summary: Bridges multi-valued heuristics with dimensionality reduction in multi-objective shortest-path search, showing naive combination destroys ordering invariants. Proposes correct integration to retain richer Pareto-frontier guidance.

entry.title: Agent Behavior Mining: Generative AI Agent Governance in Business Processes

author.name: Hoang Vu, Maximilian K\"orner, Adrian Rebmann, Gabriel Kevorkian, Michael Perscheid, Gregor Berg, Timotheus Kampik

entry.summary: Introduces Agent Behavior Mining, applying process mining techniques to make generative AI agent decision-making observable and traceable in business processes. It includes an event data model translating reasoning traces and tool usage into analyzable form.

entry.title: PulseCX: Breaking the Closed-World Assumption in Real-Time CX

author.name: Rajat Agarwal, Suvidha Tripathi, Shubham Sharma

entry.summary: PulseCX breaks the closed-world assumption in customer-experience AI by decoupling knowledge acquisition from consumption via an asynchronous agent building a Decay-Aware Temporal Knowledge Graph governed by reinforcement-decay dynamics. It removes synchronous search latency bottlenecks with under 10ms overhead.

entry.title: Hypothesis-Driven Skill Optimization for LLM Agents

author.name: Fangxin Shang, Yehui Yang

entry.summary: HDSO is a train-free framework in which a frozen curator agent proposes falsifiable hypotheses about useful skills, validates them through paired control/treatment executions, and only commits skill updates that survive testing. It aims to make skill acquisition for agents robust against spurious shortcuts.

entry.title: Efficient Multimodal Clinical Question Answering for Pulmonary Embolism Risk Assessment

author.name: Xiangyuan Xue, Yang Yu, Yan Gao, Junyan Wang, Bin Chen, Lingyan Ruan, Ting Dang, Hong Jia

entry.summary: This work benchmarks compact multimodal LLMs on the INSPECT pulmonary-embolism dataset of over 23,000 CTPA studies, formulating eight diagnostic and prognostic tasks as structured clinical question answering. It evaluates efficient models in a clinically meaningful multimodal setting.

entry.title: PRIME: Evaluating Prompt Resolution Under Incompatible Instructions in LLMs

author.name: Tehreem Javed, Shumaim Fatimah, Masooma Bakhtiari, Gibrail Islam, Mehwish Fatima

entry.summary: PRIME is a framework that constructs calibrated conflicting instructions across length, format, and reasoning dimensions and classifies how LLMs resolve them via a deterministic behavioral taxonomy. It evaluates five open-weight instruction-tuned models on handling incompatible meta-instructions.

entry.title: A Topology-Aware, Memory-Centric Architecture that Separates Root-Cause Derivation from Root-Cause Explanation

author.name: Momil Seedat

entry.summary: OpsCortex is a topology-aware, memory-centric multi-agent prototype for microservice root-cause analysis that separates root-cause derivation from explanation using persistent operational memory across four tiers. It argues operational memory, not bigger models, is the missing ingredient for autonomous operations.

entry.title: BELDE: Building a Large-scale Earth-observation Land-cover Dataset for Europe

author.name: \"Umit Mert \c{C}a\u{g}lar, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: BELDE is a publicly available large-scale RGB-based land-cover segmentation dataset for Europe built from Sentinel-2 true-color imagery and ESA WorldCover annotations. It addresses limited geographic coverage and accessibility in existing datasets.

entry.title: ACE-GS: Acing the Trade-off with Accurate, Compact and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jijian Zhao

entry.summary: ACE-GS is a progressive optimization framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting aiming to balance rendering quality, compactness, and reconstruction speed via momentum consistency-guided densification. It targets the trade-off where aggressive pruning loses high-frequency detail.

entry.title: Generating Public Health Responses using Survey-Augmented Large Language Models

author.name: Leonardo Marciaga, Thuyen Pham, Julia Rezvani, Alina Hyk, Chunyang Liao, Konstantinos Mitsopoulos, Raffaele Vardavas

entry.summary: This study generates synthetic survey responses using cluster-informed prompting of LLMs to reproduce vaccination attitude patterns from longitudinal FluPaths surveys. It investigates whether LLMs can substitute for costly repeated epidemiological surveys.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Quantum Reasoning

author.name: Katherine Ip, Casey R. Myers, Udaya Parampalli, James Quach, Peiyong Wang

entry.summary: Studies fine-tuning LLMs for genuine quantum reasoning using quantum circuit simulation (predicting measurement outcomes) as a training objective, rather than task-specific pattern matching. Probes whether LLMs can acquire deep domain reasoning in quantum computing.

entry.title: Neural Conjugate Aggregation: Identifiable Unsupervised Multi-Sensor Regression under Heterogeneous Sensor Bias

author.name: Muhammed Faruk Aytin, Zehra Demir, Alper \"Unal, Julian Marshall, G\"ozde \"Unal

entry.summary: Proposes NCAM, a hierarchical Bayesian framework combining neural networks with conjugate Gaussian inference for unsupervised multi-sensor regression under heterogeneous sensor bias without ground-truth labels. Yields identifiable source-specific bias/reliability and decomposed uncertainty.

entry.title: From Speech to Text Corpora: Evaluating ASR-Based Data Acquisition for Low-Resource Fongbe and Hausa

author.name: Mahounan Pericles Adjovi, Victor Olufemi, Roald Eiselen, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Investigates whether ASR pipelines can extend text corpora for low-resource Fongbe and Hausa, fine-tuning MMS-300M to achieve 9.48 percent WER on Fongbe (a 78 percent relative reduction) while preserving tonal diacritics. Catalogs and transcribes YouTube data to build new corpora.

entry.title: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference

author.name: Soumil Rathi

entry.summary: Introduces RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session robot-memory benchmark built on RoboMME that constructs session histories with controlled numbers of unrelated distractor sessions. Measures how vision-language-action models retain and retrieve information under long-context interference.

entry.title: Adaptive Hard-Soft Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Boundary-Constrained PDE Solving

author.name: Duc Tien Nguyen, Trinh Minh Tuan, Nguyen Duc Manh, Vu Linh Nguyen, Dinh Gia Ninh

entry.summary: Proposes HSPINN, a hybrid hard-soft physics-informed neural network that enforces boundary conditions exactly via analytical lifting while using adaptive loss weighting. Addresses slow convergence and poor boundary enforcement in standard PINNs.

entry.title: DVL-DeepONet: A Physics-Guided Operator Learning for Resilient Underwater Navigation

author.name: Arup Kumar Sahoo, Itzik Klein

entry.summary: DVL-DeepONet uses physics-guided operator learning to estimate underwater vehicle velocity when Doppler velocity log beams are noisy, incomplete, or when inertial sensors are absent. Aims for resilient autonomous underwater navigation under degraded conditions.

entry.title: MedTS-TTT: Test-Time Training for Medical Time Series Classification

author.name: Mingzhi Chen, Yiyu Gui, Guibo Luo

entry.summary: Proposes MedTS-TTT, a test-time training framework for medical time series classification that adapts online to subject-level distribution shift without expensive inner-loop optimization. Targets EEG/ECG applications where individual heterogeneity hurts generalization.

entry.title: Enhancing Creativity in 3D Generative Design via a TRIZ-Inspired Text-to-CAD Framework

author.name: Dongeon Lee, Leekyo Jeong, Soyoung Yoo, Sunwoong Yang, Namwoo Kang

entry.summary: Presents a TRIZ-inspired text-to-CAD framework that embeds inventive problem-solving principles into LLM prompting to generate creative, editable 3D CAD designs. Moves beyond geometric precision toward creative design exploration.

entry.title: One Size does not Fit All: Heterogeneous Latent Space Alignment for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Evangelia Koskinioti, Yi Shen, Georgios Stamou, Michael M. Zavlanos

entry.summary: Proposes ADualVUOT, a dual-encoder VAE with continuous normalizing flows and unbalanced optimal transport for unsupervised domain adaptation in medical image segmentation. Aims to improve expressiveness and robustness to domain shift over static augmentation methods.

entry.title: Stationary Robust Mean-Field Games under Model Mismatches

author.name: Yue Wang

entry.summary: Develops a stationary mean-field game framework incorporating distributional model uncertainty to make robust multi-agent RL tractable as agent counts grow. Establishes robust dynamic programming results under model mismatch.

entry.title: One-Step Flow Matching for Generative Modeling of Path-Dependent Physical Fields

author.name: Yijing Zhou, Jasmin Jelovica

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based one-step flow matching model for generating high-resolution path-dependent (plastic) physical stress fields, reducing sampling steps versus diffusion approaches. Targets expensive physical simulations.

entry.title: Towards Robust Personalized Federated Learning: Vulnerability Assessment and Defense Co-Design

author.name: Mingyuan Fan, Cen Chen

entry.summary: Reveals that personalized federated learning methods are more vulnerable to transfer-based adversarial attacks than centralized learning, where malicious clients exploit local models. Proposes a co-designed defense.

entry.title: PromptDyG: Test-Time Prompt Adaptation on Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Guoguo Ai, Chaoxi Niu, Hui Yan, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Yew-Soon Ong, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: Introduces PromptDyG, an unsupervised test-time prompt adaptation framework for discrete-time dynamic graphs that addresses evolving complexity and distribution shift in test snapshots. Moves beyond offline-trained dynamic graph models.

entry.title: Non-asymptotic estimates of the minimal risk in statistical learning

author.name: Liming Wu (Laboratoire de Math\'ematiques Blaise Pascal, CNRS-UMR 6620, Universit\'e Clermont Auvergne), Sen Yang (IASM, Harbin Institute of Technology)

entry.summary: Proves non-asymptotic concentration inequalities providing high-confidence lower and upper bounds on minimal risk in empirical risk minimization, relaxing boundedness to Gaussian/exponential integrability conditions. The lower-bound confidence is dimension- and parameter-count-independent.

entry.title: Input-schema identifiability limits in physics-informed surrogates for mechanics-governed flow

author.name: Daniel Cieslak, Andrzej Czyzewski

entry.summary: Introduces an input-schema identifiability certificate for physics-informed surrogate models, decomposing target fields into measurable, boundary-dependent, and symmetry-ambiguous components. It provides a pre-training audit predicting which interventions can reduce error in mechanics-governed flow modeling.

entry.title: No Reference-Free Generalization in Quantum Machine Learning

author.name: Jeongho Bang

entry.summary: This paper formalizes a fundamental generalization barrier in quantum machine learning: without an external reference frame, a learner cannot assign meaning to unseen quantum directions, and predictions must respect unitary symmetries unbroken by training data. It proves impossibility results when training states fail to span the Hilbert space.

entry.title: Scalable Bayesian Additive Models for Stellar Flare Detection via Amortized Gaussian Process Inference and Hidden Markov Models

author.name: Rodrigo Herrera, Vianey Leos-Barajas, Gwendolyn Eadie, Elizaveta Semenova, James Davenport

entry.summary: This work introduces a VAE-based generative surrogate of the Celerite Gaussian-process prior to enable scalable, amortized Bayesian inference for stellar flare detection in long astronomical time series. It combines hierarchical/additive GP modeling with hidden Markov models.

entry.title: Changing Modalities: Adapting Remote Sensing Models to New Satellites and Sensors

author.name: Tim G. Zhou, Anthony Fuller, Geoff Pleiss, Evan Shelhamer

entry.summary: DeluluNet is an architecture for adapting remote-sensing models to changing sensor modalities across three scenarios: substitution, superset, and subset. It learns a multimodal model from a unimodal teacher to enable redeployment with minimal retraining.

entry.title: Quality and Agreement in Multilabel Emotion Annotation: A Case Study and Evaluation Framework

author.name: Emily \"Ohman, Anna Koufakou

entry.summary: This case study examines multilabel emotion annotation, representing targets as soft vote-share labels instead of collapsing disagreement into majority-vote gold labels, and evaluates both thresholded and probabilistic metrics with disagreement diagnostics. It shows how annotator behavior and aggregation choices affect agreement and downstream classifiers.

entry.title: Towards Pedagogically Aligned LLM Tutors for Math Mistake Remediation

author.name: Kseniia Petukhova, Tien Dat Nguyen, Ekaterina Kochmar

entry.summary: Studies a two-stage SFT plus DPO alignment pipeline for math tutoring that guides students without revealing answers. Builds a dataset mixing real tutoring corpora and synthetic pedagogically-dimensioned data, improving both factual accuracy and pedagogical quality.

entry.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion: A Japanese Case Study

author.name: Tomoki Koriyama

entry.summary: Benchmarks over 30 LLMs on Japanese grapheme-to-phoneme conversion against conventional morphological analyzers on 3,000 annotated sentences. Best LLMs achieve under 0.52% kana CER versus 1.03% for the best traditional tool, with parse mode outperforming direct.

entry.title: Predicate Importance Estimation and Decoupled Rationale-Score Distillation for Entity Alignment

author.name: Keunha Kim, Yoonjin Jang, Hyeon-gu Lee, Sihyung Kim, Youngjoong Ko

entry.summary: Addresses entity alignment for integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs in KG-RAG via Predicate Importance Estimation and Decoupled Rationale-Score Distillation. PIE encodes subjectless triples to handle predicate-name variation and incomplete neighborhoods.

entry.title: Chehre: An Emoji-Prompted Video Dataset for Perceptually Diverse Facial Expression Recognition

author.name: Bita Azari, Zoe Stanley, Avneet Batra, Poorvi Bhatia, Hali Kil, Manolis Savva, Angelica Lim

entry.summary: Introduces Chehre, an emoji-prompted video dataset of dynamic facial expressions where facial motions are transferred to synthetic faces for privacy. It captures inter-individual perceptual diversity with thousands of annotated videos from hundreds of performers.

entry.title: TeleStyle V2: Beyond Content-Preserving Style Transfer with Self-Distillation and Distribution-Matching-Distillation

author.name: Shiwen Zhang, Yifan Xu, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents TeleStyle V2, extending content-preserving style transfer to handle all four combinations of realistic and stylized content/style references via self-distillation and distribution-matching distillation. Broadens applicability beyond V1's constraints.

entry.title: LEViL: Label-Efficient Video Learning via Zero-Shot Distillation over VLM-Generated Pseudo-Label Spaces

author.name: Asl{\i} \c{C}elik

entry.summary: Proposes LEViL, a label-efficient video learning framework combining annotation-free VLM-generated pseudo-label pretraining with target-label-set-aware fine-tuning. Reduces reliance on large labeled source datasets for action recognition.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Models for Classroom Engagement Recognition: A Benchmark Study of Prompt Sensitivity and Cross-Dataset Generalization

author.name: Aman Goyal, Kshama Nitin Shah, Kemmannu Vineet Venkatesh Rao

entry.summary: A benchmark study evaluating five vision-language models on zero-shot classroom engagement recognition across two educational datasets, probing prompt sensitivity and cross-dataset generalization. It identifies key failure modes of current VLMs for this task.

entry.title: Interest Entanglement: The Hidden Barrier to Blind Super-Resolution Optimization

author.name: Junxiong Lin, Xinji Mai, Qianyu Guo, Haoran Wang, Zeng Tao, Xuan Tong, Ivy Pan, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies an Interest Entanglement problem in blind super-resolution multi-objective optimization between fidelity and perceptual quality, exploring frequency-based analysis beyond simple loss-weight tuning. Reframes the fidelity-perception conflict.

entry.title: Venice-H1: Failure-Aware Query Re-Ranking with Multi-Scale Grid Signatures for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Nicol\`o Savioli

entry.summary: Introduces Venice-H1, a lightweight post-hoc re-ranking module for referring image segmentation that encodes candidate masks via multi-scale grid signatures with a transformer re-ranker and a failure gate that intervenes only on likely failures. Targets the residual 7-18% of failures dominating the error budget.

entry.title: Full-Body Golf Swing Kinematic Reconstruction From a Smartwatch IMU

author.name: Yuanshuo Tan, Kezhe Zhu, Xiujie Sun, Chunping Liang, Shuoyang Zhu, Chenquan Xu, Licheng Zhong, Huiming Pan, Yinri Jin, Chang Liu, Bo Xiao, Shenglong Le, Bryndan W. Lindsey, Peter B. Shull

entry.summary: Proposes WIT-KinNet, a single wrist-worn IMU approach for reconstructing full-body golf swing joint angles, using modality-specific IMU embeddings and temporal kinematic encoding to learn wrist-to-body motion dependencies. Avoids laboratory-bound motion capture and multi-sensor setups.

entry.title: Concept Alignment Contrast and Long-Short Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of SAM3 in Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yubo Zhou, Jianghao Wu, Ping Ye, Shaoting Zhang, Guotai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes test-time adaptation for SAM3 in medical image segmentation using concept alignment contrast and long-short prompt memory, targeting region-level semantic correctness rather than image-level uncertainty. Addresses the domain gap when applying natural-image foundation models to medical scans.

entry.title: MambaADv2: Evolving Duality-enhanced State Space Model for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiaobin Hu, Haoyang He, Bo Yin, Yu He, Lei Xie, Jiangning Zhang, Yu-Gang Jiang, Shuicheng Yan

entry.summary: Proposes MambaADv2, a state-space-model framework for multi-class unsupervised anomaly detection that critically rethinks the Mamba architecture lineage with a duality-enhanced decoder. Aims to combine long-range dependency modeling with linear complexity.

entry.title: Temporally Aware Densification for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Vikram Sandu, Mayurdeep Pathak, Rajiv Soundararajan

entry.summary: Proposes Visibility-Aware Densification for dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting, integrating temporal visibility and adaptive thresholding so Gaussians are refined based on their actual temporal presence. Addresses blurry under-reconstructed dynamic regions caused by static densification strategies.

entry.title: HERCULES: An Open-Source Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot SLAM, Collaborative Perception, and Exploration

author.name: Sandilya Sai Garimella, Daniel Chase Butterfield, Sean Wilson, Lu Gan

entry.summary: Presents HERCULES, an open-source UE5-based simulator for heterogeneous multi-robot SLAM, collaborative perception, and exploration with UAV-UGV coordination and added LWIR/night-vision sensing. Aims to overcome limitations of prior simulators.

entry.title: TooBad: Backdoor Diffusion Models with Ultra-Low Poison Rate and Imperceptible Trigger

author.name: Vu Tuan Truong, Long Bao Le

entry.summary: Introduces TooBad, a backdoor attack on diffusion models using trigger optimization to achieve high attack success with ultra-low poison rate and imperceptible triggers. Highlights stealthiness trade-offs that evade existing defenses.

entry.title: TACT-ful: Multi-Channel Terrain Affordance and Compliance Training for Payload-Robust Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion

author.name: Thanh Ly, Truong-Duy Dang, Chien Le, Tan-Dzung Do, Phuong Tuan Dat, Cuc T. Trinh, Vien Anh Ngo, An T. Le

entry.summary: Proposes TACT-ful, a multi-channel terrain cost combining flatness, steepness, and velocity-aware feasibility for payload-robust perceptive humanoid locomotion, driving both a DCM foothold planner and an RL policy from depth images. Targets foothold selection on structured terrain.

entry.title: Factor-Aware Mixture-of-Experts with Pretrained Encoder for Combinatorial Generalization

author.name: Feihong Zhang, Guojian Zhan, Zeyu He, Yinuo Wang, Likun Wang, Tianze Zhu, Yao Lyu, Tao Zhang, Tinghao Yi, Wei You, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Proposes FAME, a factor-aware mixture-of-experts combined with a pretrained encoder and lightweight adapters to improve diffusion policy generalization across lighting and texture variations. Uses a three-stage training process.

entry.title: RogueRover: Autonomous Rogue Device Localization for Incident Response

author.name: Priyanka Prakash Surve, Asaf Shabtai, Yuval Elovici

entry.summary: Presents RogueRover, an end-to-end system using a single commodity quadruped to autonomously detect and physically localize rogue wireless devices under zero-configuration constraints, without RF fingerprinting or pre-installed sensors. Targets cyber-physical incident response.

entry.title: Online Learning of Robust Legged Odometry with Minimal Exteroceptive Supervision

author.name: Abhijeet M. Kulkarni, Yuze Du, Guoquan Huang

entry.summary: Develops a plug-and-play robust legged odometry system that uses exteroceptive motion pipelines as continuous supervision to train an online velocity network from proprioception, eliminating explicit calibration and kinematic modeling. Aims for robustness in perceptually degraded conditions.

entry.title: DeformX: A Versatile Co-Simulation Framework for Deformable Linear Objects

author.name: Yi Yang, Xiang Fei, Lehong Wang, Chenhao Li, Zilin Dai, Henry Kou, Lu Li, Howie Choset

entry.summary: Presents DeformX, a co-simulation framework integrating a Cosserat rod physics engine with NVIDIA Isaac Sim for physically accurate and visually realistic simulation of deformable linear objects like wires and ropes. Addresses limitations of rigid-link or generic soft-body approximations.

entry.title: Bridging Semantics and Kinematics: A Modular Framework for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Ali Alabbas, Dipshikha Das, Camillo Murgia, Sainul Ansary, Alaa Elkamash, Philip Long

entry.summary: Presents a modular, training-free framework for zero-shot language-guided manipulation that decomposes the pipeline into perception, semantic interpretation, and execution, using FastSAM and Set-of-Mark prompting to ground a VLM and overcome spatial ambiguity and hallucinations. The same foundation model also acts as a semantic router.

entry.title: Distributional Granger Causality: Identification, Sequential Inference, and Adaptive Testing

author.name: Ayush Jha

entry.summary: Develops a framework for distributional Granger causality based on a finite collection of channel-specific restrictions (mean, scale, tails, asymmetry), proves the channel menu is complete under determinacy conditions, and provides an adaptive sequential testing procedure. It extends Granger causality beyond the conditional mean.

entry.title: The AI Industrial Explosion — Part 4: Cheap power

author.name: djbinder

entry.summary: Part 4 of a series modeling post-AGI economic growth, focusing on energy production and the energy payback time of building advanced power-generation infrastructure. It estimates how fast an AI-driven economy could expand using more advanced technology.

entry.title: Learning Splitting Heuristics for Parallel String Solvers

author.name: Chenhao Gao, Peisen Yao

entry.summary: Introduces a data-driven approach to automatically learn splitting heuristics for parallel string constraint solvers using a cube-and-conquer framework. It replaces labor-intensive handcrafted heuristics for dividing the search space.

entry.title: Towards Dys-XAI: Influence-Based Explanations for Dysarthria Severity Assessment

author.name: Xiaoliang Wu, Qiyang Sun, Yupei Li, Erfan Loweimi, Jennifer Williams, Zhengjun Yue

entry.summary: Proposes an influence-based instance-level explainability framework for dysarthria severity assessment that explains predictions through supportive and competing training samples via gradient-based influence approximations. It aims to improve clinical interpretability over acoustic feature importance.

entry.title: VADAOrchestra: Neurosymbolic Orchestration of Adaptive Reasoning Workflows

author.name: Teodoro Baldazzi, Luigi Bellomarini, Andrea Coletta, Michela Iezzi, Carsten Maple, Alessandro Pesare, Emanuel Sallinger

entry.summary: VADAOrchestra is a neurosymbolic framework that models complex workflows as evolving reasoning processes, combining the rigor and auditability of business-process management with the flexibility of LLM agents. It aims to overcome the rigidity of deterministic systems and the opacity of agentic ones.

entry.title: Empowering Polymeric Materials Discovery by Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Chenyao Ma, Linda Zhang, Yuheng Chen, Wei Du, Shangwen Fang, Zihao Jiang, Chuanyu Liu, Xinyu Ma, Rui Su, Gang Wang, Muyao Yu, Dong Zhong, Jie Zhu, Weibo Gong, Huan Gu, Limin Li, Chen Shen, Rui Wu, Zhenghao Wu, Kan Xu, Min Zhou, Donglin He, Xiayun Huang, Shan Jiang, Pengfei Ou, Jiayu Peng, Yuwei Zhang, Jie Zhao, Di Zhang, Piao Ma, Zhenghao Li, Hao Li

entry.summary: A broad review of how AI, machine learning, large models, and lab automation are reshaping polymeric materials discovery across scales. It surveys data infrastructure and modeling approaches for rational polymer design.

entry.title: The Substrate Collapse: AI Code Generation Invalidates Authorship-Based Knowledge Metrics

author.name: Brett Wheeler

entry.summary: Argues that AI code generation invalidates authorship-based knowledge metrics like truck factor and degree-of-authorship, since merging AI-generated code no longer implies human understanding. Frames this as invalidation of an entire metric class rather than degradation.

entry.title: FiLM-Coordinated Dual-Branch Transformer for Global-Local Dependency Modeling in Language Modeling

author.name: Zhiqiang Zhou, Xu Ling, Junliang Dai

entry.summary: Proposes a FiLM-coordinated dual-branch Transformer for language modeling with explicit global and local branches coordinated by feature-wise linear modulation instead of concatenation. Argues channel-wise calibration suits the two dependency views better than token-level interaction.

entry.title: Clinical Term Extraction using Open-Source Small Language Models

author.name: Noah Marchal, William E. Janes, Mihail Popescu, Xing Song

entry.summary: This work evaluates open-source small language models with few-shot prompting for extracting ALS-relevant clinical terms across 17 categories from unstructured notes, without task-specific training. It compares 26 models using aggregate, label-level, and manual validation.

entry.title: Latent Confidence Alignment for LLM Self-Assessment

author.name: Ting-Yu Chen, Tingting Yu, Pei-Cing Huang, Chan Hsu, Ming-Yen Lin, Yihuang Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Confidence Alignment Error, using a Rasch latent-ability framework to account for item difficulty when evaluating LLM confidence calibration and metacognition. Aims to distinguish genuine self-assessment from generation byproducts.

entry.title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing

author.name: Yizhou Dang, Chuang Zhao, Lianbo Ma, Guibing Guo, Xingwei Wang, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold Restore Mixing for protein representation learning, a data-augmentation strategy that restores disrupted structure caused by perturbation-based augmentation to provide both original structure and diverse variations. Addresses structure-defect and performance-degradation issues in protein DA.

entry.title: Gold Points Sniper: Self-guided Visual Reasoning in VLM for Fine-grained Action Understanding

author.name: Haodi Liu, Xinhang Yang, Kunda Yan, Sen Cui, Zeyu Zhang, Changshui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Gold Points Sniper (GPS), a framework empowering lightweight vision-language models with self-guided multimodal reasoning for fine-grained human action understanding from broad views where people occupy small regions. Targets reliable human-robot interaction beyond predefined-label recognition.

entry.title: Human and AI collaboration for pulmonary nodule segmentation

author.name: Hongqiao Dong, Wenhao Chi, Ruobing Liang, Xiaokui Yang, Wenhua Liang, Peng Hou, Wenjun Pu, Yipeng Zhao, Ping Chen, Haiping Liu, Jianxing He, Bo Liu

entry.summary: Presents Hi-Seg, a human-in-the-loop pulmonary nodule segmentation framework built on the Segment Anything Model where humans iteratively refine prompts to guide SAM toward higher-quality masks. Enables junior trainees or non-medical personnel to achieve robust medical segmentation.

entry.title: Automated Semantic Fault Localization in SysML v2: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework Using Knowledge-Graph Augmented LLMs

author.name: Haitham Al-Shami, Rohail Malik, Riku Ala-Laurinaho, Jari Veps\"al\"ainen, Raine Viitala

entry.summary: Presents a human-in-the-loop framework combining a fine-tuned small language model with a domain knowledge graph to detect and repair semantic faults in SysML v2 models that pass syntax checks but violate domain rules. Uses the knowledge graph to generate synthetic training data.

entry.title: A Gated Graph Neural Network Approach to Fast-Convergent Dynamic Average Estimation

author.name: Antonio Marino, Claudio Pacchierotti, Paolo Robuffo Giordano

entry.summary: Proposes a gated graph neural network for fast-convergent distributed dynamic average estimation in multi-agent systems using only local information. Models estimation as a distributed autoregressor with a regularization term enforcing convergence.

entry.title: Statistical Matching via Schr\"odinger Bridge beyond Conditional Independence

author.name: Eunho Koo, Tongseok Lim, Jinwon Sohn

entry.summary: Proposes a dependency-aware Schrödinger bridge for statistical matching that moves beyond the conditional independence assumption, recovering informative joint distributions across separately observed variables. Captures latent dependence ignored by classical methods.

entry.title: BranchShine: Compact Raw-Audio-to-IPA Transcription with a RoPE E-Branchformer Encoder

author.name: Nikhil Navas, Sergio Chevtchenko, Talisson Damiao, Saeed Afshar

entry.summary: Introduces BranchShine, a compact 33M-parameter raw-audio-to-IPA transcriber using a RoPE E-Branchformer encoder that outperforms a 575M-parameter baseline on multilingual phonetic transcription. Demonstrates efficient pronunciation recognition.

entry.title: Counterfactual learning of new adaptive instructional policies using logged data

author.name: Samuel Girard (SODA), Sein Minn (AIT), Amel Bouzeghoub (IP Paris, TSP - INF, ACMES-SAMOVAR), Jill-J\^enn Vie (SODA)

entry.summary: Introduces an offline contextual bandit framework for learning adaptive tutoring policies from logged data, mapping interactions to a latent proficiency-difficulty scale via a Rasch model and optimizing a flow-based reward. Avoids costly online experimentation or simulators.

entry.title: Temporal-Spectral Alignment with Frequency Adaptation for Source-Free Time-Series Adaptation

author.name: Shichang Meng, Linquan Wu, Xuan Ai, Linqi Song

entry.summary: Proposes SAFA, a source-free time-series domain adaptation method that jointly models temporal dependencies and spectral characteristics, addressing overlooked spectral shifts. Adapts pre-trained models to unlabeled targets without source data.

entry.title: Selective Time Series Forecasting via Metalearning

author.name: Ricardo In\'acio, Vitor Cerqueira, Mar\'ilia Barandas, Carlos Soares

entry.summary: Proposes a selective time-series forecasting framework with a reject option that models the empirical percentile of forecast errors via metalearning to generalize abstention beyond the training domain. Allows models to abstain from high-risk predictions.

entry.title: Dataset-Aware Cold-Start Active Learning for Annotation-Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: R\'emi Hattat, Marine Beaumont, Charline Bertholdt, Gabriela Hossu, Olivier Morel, Bailiang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CSCS, a curriculum-stratified cold-start active learning framework for 3D medical image segmentation that selects initial unlabeled volumes using self-supervised typicality and reconstruction signals. Addresses the unresolved cold-start problem in active learning.

entry.title: Sea-Scan: High-Accuracy, ML-based Dark Vessel Detection and Localisation via Weakly Supervised DAS Monitoring

author.name: Tian Tian, Agastya Raj, Lara Flanagan, John Kennedy, Marco Ruffini

entry.summary: Presents Sea-Scan, a weakly supervised ML system using distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on undersea cables to detect dark vessels with 97.8% detection at 1.98% false-trigger rate. Trained from imperfect AIS labels and detects unlabeled dark-vessel events.

entry.title: Radial Basis Function Networks as Projection Heads in Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Andreas Schliebitz, Heiko Tapken, Martin Atzmueller

entry.summary: Proposes replacing MLP projection heads in self-supervised learning with radial basis function networks, whose interpretable parameters yield a label-free representation quality metric (Scale-Normalized Separation). Avoids costly linear probing for evaluation.

entry.title: How Should a Simulation-to-Reality Transfer Budget Be Spent?

author.name: Syed Hamzah Rizvi, Yash Vardhan Tomar

entry.summary: Studies how to allocate a real-robot measurement budget between system identification and domain randomization for sim-to-real transfer, using a controlled sim-to-sim pendulum setting. Finds that accurate measurement (system ID) does most of the work across reality gaps and noise levels.

entry.title: Music Playlist Captioning at Scale with Large Language Models

author.name: Mathieu Delcluze, L\'ea Briand, Benjamin Chapus, Deniz Mekik, Guillaume Salha-Galvan

entry.summary: This paper describes Deezer's deployed LLM-based playlist captioning system that generates natural-language descriptions powering the Daily Mix feature for millions of users. It reports measurable user-engagement gains from improved semantic framing of recommendations.

entry.title: Generalized nonparametric regression in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces: Consistency and rates of convergence

author.name: Ioannis Kalogridis

entry.summary: This paper analyzes the limits of CTC-internal scoring for N-best ASR hypothesis selection, showing eleven scoring strategies yield no significant WER improvement and that CTC's correlation with WER degrades as candidate count grows due to blank-path proliferation. It localizes the bottleneck as linguistic rather than acoustic.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Audit Framework for High-Stakes Reasoning: Evaluation and Interpretability in Clinical Mental Health Screening

author.name: Jingchen Ye, Yanpei Yu, Luyao Zhang

entry.summary: This work proposes a multi-agent audit framework simulating collaborative multi-step verification for high-stakes clinical mental-health screening, decomposing reasoning into perception, RAG, chain-of-thought inference, and an audit verification stage. It targets reducing hallucination and improving interpretability over single-model approaches.

entry.title: Dissecting Agentic RAG: A Component Ablation for Multi-Hop QA with a Local 7B Model

author.name: Sheroz Shaikh

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled ablation of agentic RAG components (iterative reasoning, query decomposition, adaptive retrieval) for multi-hop QA using a local 7B model on 5,000 HotpotQA questions. Tests whether added agentic complexity actually improves results in resource-constrained settings.

entry.title: TALAS: Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Embedding Distillation

author.name: Quoc Phong Dao, Hoang Son Nguyen, Pham Khanh Chi, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Thien Huu Nguyen, Trung Le

entry.summary: Proposes TALAS, an embedding distillation framework combining teacher-anchored multi-layer alignment with adaptive sharpness-aware minimization. Selectively distills final embeddings into student upper layers to reduce overhead while respecting capacity gaps.

entry.title: BLUEX v2: Benchmarking LLMs on Open-Ended Questions from Brazilian University Entrance Exams

author.name: Jo\~ao Guilherme Alves Santos, Giovana Kerche Bon\'as, Thiago Laitz, Thales Sales Almeida, Helio Pedrini

entry.summary: Introduces BLUEX v2, a Portuguese benchmark of 395 open-ended discursive questions from second-phase Brazilian university entrance exams (UNICAMP, USP, 2022-2025). Extends prior multiple-choice evaluation to free-form reasoning and generation.

entry.title: Time-Frequency Weighted Losses for Phoneme Reconstruction in DNN-Based Speech Enhancement

author.name: Nasser-Eddine Monir, Paul Magron, Romain Serizel

entry.summary: Proposes time-frequency weighted losses for DNN speech enhancement that modulate the SDR objective based on local speech presence, speech-to-interference ratio, and spectral flux. Emphasizes phoneme-relevant TF bins and transient cues, improving frequency-weighted metrics and phoneme recognition.

entry.title: HAKARI-Bench: A Lightweight Benchmark for Comparing Retrieval Architectures and Efficiency Settings under Unified Conditions

author.name: Yuichi Tateno

entry.summary: Presents HAKARI-Bench, a lightweight benchmark reconstructing retrieval suites into compact Nano-sets covering 35 benchmarks and 551 tasks across 43 languages for fast, unified comparison of retrieval architectures and efficiency settings. Eases development-time configuration choices.

entry.title: CDER-SME: A Cross-Device Event-RGB Micro-Expression Dataset under Multi-Level Stress Induction

author.name: Jingting Li, Hui Sha, Su-Jing Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CDER-SME, a cross-device Event-RGB micro-expression dataset under multi-level stress induction with hardware-agnostic alignment for decoupled sensors. Provides 92 subjects with expert action-unit and emotion annotations.

entry.title: NeoLoc-68: End-to-end 68-point neonatal facial landmark localisation in neonatal clinical environments

author.name: Abdullah Bin-Obaid, Maria M. Cobo, Rebeccah Slater, Lionel Tarassenko, Mauricio Villarroel

entry.summary: Proposes NeoLoc-68, an end-to-end 68-point facial landmark detector for neonatal faces in clinical environments with occlusions and motion blur. Enables automated non-contact neonatal pain assessment.

entry.title: A Test-time Actor-Critic Approach to News Images Generation

author.name: Damianos Galanopoulos, Vasileios Mezaris

entry.summary: Presents ACIG, a test-time model-agnostic actor-critic approach for news image generation that generates prompts, produces images, evaluates results, and refines in a feedback loop. Won the MediaEval NewsImages 2026 challenge.

entry.title: From Gradient Clipping to Structural Refinement: Improving DPSGD for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Shiva Parsarad, Parth Shandilya, Isabel Wagner

entry.summary: Evaluates recent DPSGD gradient-clipping variants for differentially private medical image segmentation, showing prior assumptions (notably for per-sample adaptive clipping) do not consistently hold for segmentation tasks. It proposes structural refinements to improve utility under privacy constraints.

entry.title: Fidelity- and Perception-Aware Local Implicit Attention for Arbitrary-Scale Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Yu-Syuan Xu, Hao-Lun Sun, Hao-Wei Chen, Hsien-Kai Kuo, Chun-Yi Lee

entry.summary: Introduces FPLIA, a framework integrating fidelity-oriented features into a diffusion pipeline for arbitrary-scale image super-resolution, aiming to balance perceptual realism against structural hallucinations. Uses a Fidelity-and-Perception Attention Module.

entry.title: Towards Accurate and Robust Surveillance Roadside IVD via Trackletized Audio-Visual Reasoning

author.name: Xiwen Li, Xiaoya Tang, Bodong Zhang, Tolga Tasdizen

entry.summary: Introduces TAVR-IVD, a trackletized audio-visual framework for idling vehicle detection that uses multi-object tracking to align vehicles with distributed microphones, improving robustness over full-frame fusion. Targets brittleness under domain shift.

entry.title: Homographic Navigation: Geometry-Driven Camera Guidance for Deterministic Planar Capture

author.name: Dominik Kroupa, Marek Va\v{s}ko, Muh Yuzril Ihza Baharuddin, Adam Herout

entry.summary: Presents homographic navigation, a geometry-centric framework that uses homography as an organizing variable to guide camera acquisition toward precise planar-region capture, with synthetic training data generation and a two-pass inference scheme. Targets deterministic planar capture from a single reference image.

entry.title: MotionMAR: Multi-scale Auto-Regressive Human Motion Reconstruction from Sparse Observations

author.name: Yuhua Luo, Junsheng Zhang, Mengyin Liu, Xincheng Lin, Ming Yan, Zhudi Chen, Chenglu Wen, Lan Xu, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents MotionMAR, a coarse-to-fine multi-scale autoregressive framework for reconstructing human motion from sparse observations, using multi-resolution VQ-VAE tokenization to separate semantic motion from jitter. Targets temporal hierarchical structure in motion.

entry.title: UECP: Uncertainty-Enhanced Collaborative Perception

author.name: Kang Yang, Tianci Bu, Peng Wang, Deying Li, Wen Jie, Yongcai Wang

entry.summary: Introduces UECP, an uncertainty-enhanced collaborative perception method for autonomous driving that proposes a physically grounded uncertainty map to weight contributions of participating agents, replacing detection-correlated confidence maps. Deeply integrates uncertainty into cooperative fusion.

entry.title: Rethinking Prototype-based Similarity Learning for Few-Shot Object Detection

author.name: KunHo Heo, Seungjae kim, Wongyu Lee, SuYeon Kim, MyeongAh Cho

entry.summary: Rethinks prototype-based similarity learning for few-shot object detection, addressing class confusion from similarity margin collapse and weak localization cues. Introduces text-anchored semantic masks and complementary components for training-free adaptation.

entry.title: StreamPPG: Low-Latency rPPG Estimation via Consistent Privileged Learning

author.name: Yiming Li, Yihan Yang, Yuguang Chu, Yuanhui Hu, Si-Yuan Cao, Xiaohan Zhang, Xiaokai Bai, Zhe Wu, Hui-Liang Shen

entry.summary: Presents StreamPPG, a low-latency frame-wise remote photoplethysmography architecture trained with consistent privileged learning to achieve real-time pulse estimation with accuracy competitive with clip-wise methods. Addresses the seconds-long delay of clip-based approaches.

entry.title: PhysFlow: Frequency Decoupled with Dual-Field Rectified Flow for Remote Photoplethysmography

author.name: Zixu Li, jianjun Qian, Hang Shao, Lei Luo, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PhysFlow, a frequency-decoupled dual-field rectified flow method for remote photoplethysmography that separates weak pulse signals from strong disturbance-induced changes during reconstruction. Aims to stabilize rPPG under illumination changes, expressions, and head motion.

entry.title: A Skin-Tone-Aware Dual-Representation Remote Photoplethysmography Framework for Contactless Respiratory Rate Estimation

author.name: Trishna Saikia, Anup Kumar Gupta, Puneet Gupta, Pasi Liljeberg

entry.summary: Proposes a skin-tone-aware dual-representation remote photoplethysmography framework for contactless respiratory rate estimation, using dynamic RGB signal projection rather than fixed projections designed for heart rate. Addresses the underexplored use of rPPG for respiration across diverse skin tones.

entry.title: Real-Time Multimodal Activity-Aware Error Detection in Robot-Assisted Surgery

author.name: Seyed Hamid Reza Roodabeh, Zongyu Li, Homa Alemzadeh

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal framework for real-time technical error detection in robot-assisted surgery using video, kinematics, and descriptive textual prompts with activity-level grounding. Targets patient safety in minimally invasive procedures.

entry.title: Learning-Based Modeling of Soft Robots via Cosserat Rod Theory

author.name: Mohammad Ali, Nithin Senthur Kumar, Eric J. Barth, Thomas Beckers

entry.summary: Proposes a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework integrating Cosserat rod theory and Hamiltonian physics for learning planar soft-robot dynamics while preserving energy structure. Balances physical consistency with data-driven inference.

entry.title: R2HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-to-Human Object Handovers

author.name: Hanxin Zhang, Abdulqader Dhafer, Hongbiao Dong, Zhou Daniel Hao

entry.summary: Presents R2HandoverSim, a simulation benchmark for robot-to-human object handovers comparing baselines with five complementary metrics validated against a 30-participant user study. Establishes standardized evaluation for handover quality.

entry.title: BLENDS: Bayesian Learning-Enhanced Deep Smoothing for GNSS-Denied Environments

author.name: Nadav Cohen, Itzik Klein

entry.summary: BLENDS is a transformer-based framework that augments Bayesian smoothing with learned covariance adaptation and state correction to maintain navigation accuracy during GNSS outages with low-cost inertial sensors. It preserves classical estimation foundations while adding data-driven improvements.

entry.title: LP-NavOA: Integrated Local Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance for Humanoid Robots under Limited Perception

author.name: Yukun Luo, Jianjun Ma, Yuyao Min, Jinzhe Li, Kaihong Huang, Peng Li

entry.summary: LP-NavOA is a humanoid local navigation and obstacle-avoidance framework for short-range, partially observable sensing that combines a raycast-conditioned PPO locomotion backbone with A* and waypoint planning and a shared safety filter. It addresses obstacle avoidance, sparse-goal recovery, and stable whole-body locomotion together.

entry.title: Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries

author.name: Ruaidhr\'i Campion, Matthew Fenlon, Joshua Cooney Mercedal, Casey Farren-Colloty, Eliza Somerville, Michael A. J. Mitchell

entry.summary: COTHROM applies statistical physics, formulating Irish electoral redistricting under PR-STV as a Potts Hamiltonian optimized via Markov Chain Monte Carlo. It is the first computational framework making constitutional trade-offs explicit for Irish districting.

entry.title: Skill Coverage: A Test Adequacy Metric for Agent Skills

author.name: Boyin Tan, Xiaowei Huang, Youcheng Sun

entry.summary: Introduces skill coverage, a test adequacy metric treating an agent skill artifact as the object under test by extracting behavior constraints and measuring whether trajectories exercise them. It moves beyond task-outcome-only evaluation of agent skills.

entry.title: Learning Burst-Aware Early Warning Models for Capacity Stress under AI Workload Surges in Hyperscale Data Centers

author.name: Zihan Yu, Xianling Zeng, Zhiming Xue, Yalun Qi, Sichen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a burst-aware early warning framework for proactive capacity stress prediction under AI workload surges in hyperscale data centers, formulated as high-recall forecasting over multivariate telemetry windows. It targets intervention before system degradation.

entry.title: MetaPS: Adaptive Programmatic Strategy Selection for Market Agents

author.name: Jiaxiang Chen, Aotian Luo, Zhouyi Zheng, Weiyi Huang, Chi Zhang, Zenglin Xu

entry.summary: MetaPS has a market agent select among a library of programmatic trading strategies rather than directly generating actions, using simulated rollouts to identify state-strategy pairs and convert them into supervised fine-tuning data. It targets adaptive strategy selection across changing market regimes.

entry.title: Integrating Large Language Model Agents with Digital Twins for Industrial Autonomous Systems

author.name: Yuchen Xia

entry.summary: A dissertation proposing a three-layer framework integrating LLMs, digital twins, and automation systems for industrial autonomous control with adaptive reasoning for interpreting, planning, and executing tasks. Targets reconfigurable production environments.

entry.title: LK Jam: System Architecture and Implementation of a Real-Time Human-AI Interactive Music Generation System using Role-Aware GRU

author.name: Yakun Liu, Zhiyu Jin, Dong Liu, Hai Luan

entry.summary: LK_Jam is a real-time, bidirectional human-AI interactive music generation system using a lightweight role-aware GRU and a sparse event-stream representation that abandons fixed time grids for low-latency dynamic interplay. Targets live musical interaction in embodied AI settings.

entry.title: Context-Aware Generative AI for Automated Telecom Test Script Generation

author.name: Gautam Prasad, Chandramohan T. N., Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents a context-aware generative AI framework for automated telecom test script generation that treats testing as a continuously adapting process, detecting fine-grained changes in code, configs, topologies, and KPIs to selectively update only affected tests. Addresses staleness of static test suites in evolving systems.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of OpenPangu Quantization on Ascend NPUs

author.name: Tong Shi, Jiacheng Wang, Hui Xie, Ying Li, Aishan Liu, Jinyang Guo, Xianglong Liu

entry.summary: An empirical study quantizing OpenPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend NPUs across multiple PTQ methods. It finds 8-bit weight-only quantization is essentially lossless while 4-bit is practical for 7B but more harmful for 1B.

entry.title: L20-Edu-135M: An Auditable Single-GPU Study of Data-Efficient Small Language Modeling

author.name: Yin Li

entry.summary: Documents L20-Edu-135M, a fully auditable 134.5M-parameter language model pipeline trained on a single L20 GPU with about 13B tokens, detailing data deduplication, SFT with weight interpolation, and RL. Studies data-efficient small LM training in a sharply resource-constrained regime.

entry.title: Reliability-Guided Adaptive Ensembling for Robust Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Adam Koziak, Yuhong Guo

entry.summary: Proposes SAFER, a training-free reliability-guided augmentation wrapper for robust test-time adaptation under adversarially contaminated test streams. Replaces brittle single-view predictions with correlation-weighted pooled predictions from stochastic augmentations.

entry.title: An LLM-Orchestrated Agent for Directional-Coupler Design with Self-Consistent Eigenmode and FDTD Validation

author.name: Saumya Biswas, Amrit De, Md Tauhidul Islam

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-orchestrated design agent for silicon-on-insulator directional couplers where the LLM proposes candidate geometries and judges convergence while deterministic eigenmode and FDTD solvers own all physics. Demonstrates self-consistent validation in a photonic design loop.

entry.title: UnBias-Plus: Detect, Explain, and Rewrite Bias

author.name: Ahmed Y. Radwan, Ahmed ElKady, Sindhuja Chaduvula, Mohamed Hafez, Amrit Krishnan, Shaina Raza

entry.summary: UnBias-Plus is an open-source toolkit for detecting, localizing, explaining, and rewriting biased language with multi-class classification and reasoning. Provides accessible interfaces via Python, CLI, REST API, and web.

entry.title: Load Testing for Machine Learning Model Serving Systems at Scale

author.name: Amr S. Abdelfattah, Nakul Tirumalai, Indu Mohanan, Xiao Li, Pengchao Wang, Dinakar Dhurjati, Eric Sung

entry.summary: Presents an industrial load testing framework for ML model serving that estimates serving capacity via adaptive feedback-driven search using real-time performance signals with dampening and convergence detection. Addresses ad hoc capacity planning under SLO constraints.

entry.title: Frequency-Domain Neural ODEs for Modeling Non-Linear Dynamical Systems

author.name: Mohammed Ashraf, Ayman A. El-Badawy

entry.summary: Investigates Frequency-domain Neural ODEs that project continuous temporal dynamics into the frequency domain via FFT to better model highly nonlinear dynamical systems. Empirically compared against GRUs and LSTMs.

entry.title: Patient-Aware Contrastive Learning Preserves Per-Patient Structure in RR-Interval Representations

author.name: Yasantha Niroshana, Weijith Wimalasiri, Chathuranga Hettiarachchi

entry.summary: Proposes a patient-aware contrastive objective for RR-interval representations in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation detection, forming positive pairs only from same-patient same-class segments to preserve individual baselines. Counters collapse of per-subject structure in standard supervised contrastive learning.

entry.title: It's Much Easier for Neural Networks to learn Game of Life Dynamics with the Right Activation Function: Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Tashin Ahmed, Q. Tyrell Davis

entry.summary: Shows that polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with appropriate activation functions learn Conway's Game of Life dynamics far more easily than standard networks, reframing the task from search to learning with the right inductive bias. Closes the gap to minimal representable networks.

entry.title: ReLaTS: a Reinforcement Learning-based method for dynamically determining the coupling Time Step in multi-scale simulations of self-gravitating systems

author.name: Veronica Saz Ulibarrena, Simon Portegies Zwart

entry.summary: Introduces ReLaTS, a reinforcement learning framework that dynamically selects coupling time steps in multi-scale self-gravitating astrophysical simulations to balance accuracy and cost. Validated on star clusters with planetary systems.

entry.title: Adversarial observations in probabilistic State-Space Models for robust Reinforcement Learning

author.name: M. Santos-Pascual, D. R\'ios Insua

entry.summary: Analyzes adversarial attacks on linear probabilistic state-space models within RL architectures, where observations are perturbed under likelihood constraints. Aims to inform building more robust RL for safety-critical domains like robotics.

entry.title: CAT-Translate: Building Compact Open-Source Models for Japanese-English Translation

author.name: Yuu Jinnai

entry.summary: Develops CAT-Translate, a family of compact open-source Japanese-English translation models (0.8B-7B) via two-stage SFT and Multi-Objective GRPO on synthetic parallel corpora. Addresses whether specialized small models are worth building versus large multilingual ones.

entry.title: One-Shot Data Selection for Medical Image Classification via Graph Coverage

author.name: Zahiriddin Rustamov, Nadia Badawi, Rafat Damseh, Nazar Zaki

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-based one-shot data selection method for medical image classification operating on frozen foundation model embeddings, using a kNN graph and a two-term coverage objective. Avoids retraining and oracle access required by active learning.

entry.title: Anticipating the Optimism Gap: Predicting Distribution-Shift Degradation of RF-Impairment Detectors from In-Distribution Statistics

author.name: Chakshu Baweja

entry.summary: Asks whether the distribution-shift degradation (optimism gap) of GNSS RF-impairment detectors can be predicted from in-distribution statistics before seeing OOD data, finding it grows monotonically with shift severity across thirteen detectors. Uses an open parameter-grounded synthetic testbed.

entry.title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms for Online Vertex Cover

author.name: Tianhang Lu, Runtian Ren, Shengcai Liu

entry.summary: This paper provides learning-augmented online algorithms for weighted vertex cover with predictions, establishing optimal robustness-consistency tradeoffs for bipartite and general graphs. It connects these to the well-known ski-rental tradeoff.

entry.title: Topic-to-Timestamp Alignment by Constrained Evidence Selection

author.name: Zeynep Y{\i}lb{\i}rt, Marina Litvak, Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: This paper recasts topic-to-timestamp alignment in meeting transcripts as constrained candidate selection rather than timestamp generation, having the model select the best-grounding timestamped chunk to avoid hallucinated or invalid timecodes. It evaluates on hundreds of queries over municipal meeting transcripts.

entry.title: PeerMathDial: A Middle School Dialogue Dataset for Student Collaborative Math Problem Solving

author.name: Murong Yue, Desmond Alexander Mcglone, Emily Slutz, Wenhan Lyu, Yixuan Zhang, Jennifer Suh, Ziyu Yao

entry.summary: Introduces PeerMathDial, the first dataset of authentic peer collaborative problem-solving dialogues from middle school math classrooms, with 55 dialogues and 6,406 turns. Fills a gap in student-student (vs teacher-student) educational dialogue resources.

entry.title: Evaluation of Medical Vision Language Models HuluMed and MedGemma, and general purpose chatbots Gemma 3, ChatGPT Plus, and Claude Pro on real previously unseen wound images

author.name: Yunzhe Xue, Mohammed Saim Ahmed Quadri, Neal Panse, Justin W. Ady, Usman Roshan

entry.summary: Evaluates medical and general-purpose VLMs (including ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, MedGemma) on real unseen chronic wound images using a structured clinical questionnaire. Assesses readiness of current models for automated wound assessment.

entry.title: Can Single-View Mesh Reconstruction Generalize to Robot Camera Rotation?

author.name: Yu Zhan, Guangcheng Chen, Hanjing Ye, Zhiqin Cheng, Zanjia Tong, Wenjun Xu, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates whether single-view mesh reconstruction models generalize to camera rotations typical of robot-mounted cameras, introducing a controlled evaluation protocol with roll, pitch, and yaw sweeps. Reveals an under-studied failure mode for robot spatial reasoning.

entry.title: Three-Step Hierarchical Transformer for Multi-Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Rapha\"el Del\'ecluse, Hazem Wannous, Laurent Grisoni, Laurent Guimas

entry.summary: Proposes a three-step hierarchical Transformer for multi-pedestrian trajectory prediction that explicitly separates temporal encoding, multimodal fusion, and scene-level interaction reasoning. Uses lightweight GRU summaries for efficient cross-modal attention.

entry.title: From Reconstruction to Decision: A Post-Encoder Plug-in Adapter for Curvilinear Segmentation

author.name: Qin Lei, Jiang Zhong, Xin Xiao, Yuming Yang, Hao Wu

entry.summary: Presents PEPA, a lightweight post-encoder plug-in adapter for curvilinear segmentation (vessels, cracks) that targets reconstruction and binarization bottlenecks left by heavy-downsampling foundation encoders. Improves recovery of thin, topologically fragile structures.

entry.title: Lightweight Neural Framework for Robust 3D Volume and Surface Estimation from Multi-View Images

author.name: Diego E. Farchione, Ramzi Idoughi, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight feed-forward framework that regresses scale-normalized volume, surface area, and uncertainties directly from multi-view images by fusing 3D point clouds with view-aligned 2D features via a graph decoder. Bypasses iterative optimization for fast inference even with sparse/noisy data.

entry.title: TIDY: Thermal Infrared Image Denoising via Wavelet Domain Entropy and Directional Stripe Index

author.name: Tai Hyoung Rhee, Dong-Guw Lee, Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TIDY, a lightweight wavelet-domain denoiser for thermal infrared imaging using wavelet entropy and a directional stripe index, trained on real clean-noisy pairs to handle severe stochastic and fixed-pattern noise. Targets the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for online field robotics deployment.

entry.title: Coupled Routing and Configuration Optimization for Multi-Viewpoint Robotic Inspection

author.name: Minh Nhat Vu, Khang Nguyen, Vu Trung Tran, Vien Ngo

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework jointly optimizing inspection viewpoint visiting order and per-viewpoint robot configuration for a 9-DoF system, using closed-form self-motion manifold parameterization and CMA-ES routing. Improves over modular fixed-IK pipelines.

entry.title: Temporal logics and formal synthesis for robot planning and control

author.name: Jana Tumova, Joris Verhagen, Matti Vahs

entry.summary: A survey/tutorial presenting temporal logics (linear and signal temporal logic) as specification languages for robot behavior and discussing formal synthesis methods from graph/game-based approaches to sampling-based planning and control certificates. Provides a unifying overview for verified robot planning.

entry.title: GeoFlow-SLAM++: A Robust Multi-Camera Visual-Inertial SLAM System with Relocalization

author.name: Wei Fen, Tingyang Xiao, Liu Liu, Xiaolin Zhou, Zhizhong Su

entry.summary: Presents GeoFlow-SLAM++, a tightly-coupled multi-camera visual-inertial SLAM system extending a single RGB-D system to a calibrated rig with interchangeable ORB and neural-feature (SuperPoint/LightGlue) front-ends and robust relocalization. Unifies tracking, mapping, and relocalization on a shared body state.

entry.title: ARP: Enhancing Quantized Skill Abstractions via Visual Alignment and Iterative Refinement for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuntian Wang, Zesheng Jia, Yuhui Duan, Qibing Wang, Yang Liu, Song Wang, Siao Liu, Jin Wang

entry.summary: ARP enhances discrete skill-based imitation learning by coupling semantic visual grounding with execution-level iterative refinement to fix the weak visual grounding and quantization precision errors of prior quantized-skill methods. It targets long-horizon manipulation.

entry.title: From Langflow to Monero: Inside CVE-2026-33017 Cryptominer

author.name: Simon Dulude

entry.summary: A threat-intelligence report on a cryptomining campaign exploiting CVE-2026-33017 in Langflow, showing attackers scanning exposed AI application infrastructure for footholds. It highlights AI tooling as an emerging attack surface.

entry.title: The New Associationism: Lessons from Deep Learning

author.name: Daniel Rothschild

entry.summary: A philosophical paper arguing that the success of supervised learning across AI systems vindicates a modest form of associationism as a model of human learning. It connects deep learning paradigms to long-standing debates in cognitive science.

entry.title: An LLM-Explainable DRL Framework for Passenger-Directed Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ouided Braoui, Meriem Bouali, Nadir Farhi

entry.summary: Combines deep reinforcement learning for adaptive autonomous driving control with LLM-based explainability modules to communicate agent behavior to passengers. Demonstrates stable learning across fast, comfort, and stop driving modes.

entry.title: A Quantum-Assisted Agentic Distributed Artificial Intelligence Framework for Deadline-Bounded Orchestration of Hybrid Renewable Microgrids

author.name: Iacovos I. Ioannou, Saher Javaid, Minella Bezha, Yasuo Tan, Naoto Nagaoka, Vasos Vassiliou

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum-assisted agentic distributed AI framework for real-time microgrid orchestration, formulating dispatch as QUBO problems solved by a portfolio of quantum, quantum-inspired, and classical solvers. Solver selection becomes an agentic deliberation action.

entry.title: AgentCAT: Simulating Computerized Adaptive Testing via Multi-Agent Large Language Models

author.name: Weiyuan Zhou, Haiping Ma, Xiaoshan Yu, Changqian Wang, Shangshang Yang, Xingyi Zhang

entry.summary: AgentCAT builds a multi-agent LLM simulation to create a dynamic, high-fidelity benchmarking environment for computerized adaptive testing, overcoming the static offline-data limitations of prior CAT research. It targets personalized education assessment.

entry.title: AgentRiskBOM: A Risk-Scoping Security Bill of Materials for Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Srimonti Dutta, Akshata Kishore Moharir

entry.summary: AgentRiskBOM proposes a security bill-of-materials layer for tool-using agents, documenting runtime authority such as autonomy, tool permissions, memory, credential scope, and approval requirements that existing SBOM/AIBOM artifacts omit. It addresses an agentic transparency gap.

entry.title: CFAgentBench: A Reproducible Environment and Benchmark for Autonomous Construction-Finance Agents

author.name: Rishi Srivastava

entry.summary: CFAgentBench is a self-hostable, executable benchmark for autonomous construction-finance agents operating across ERP, payroll, lien waivers, and treasury systems, with over 1,000 task specifications and oracle-validated evaluators. It brings agent evaluation into a specialized financial-operations domain.

entry.title: An approach with Visual and Tabular Mamba to multimodal medical data using Mixed Fusion

author.name: Matheus B. Rocha, Gustavo B. Dettogni, Renato A. Krohling

entry.summary: Presents a mixed multimodal fusion architecture using Mamba state-space models for visual and tabular medical data in cancer classification, aiming for interpretable decision-making. One Mamba processes images, another fuses image probabilities with clinical data.

entry.title: Communication Heterogeneity and Collective Consensus in Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Nishit Singh

entry.summary: Using a neural cellular automaton solving density classification, this paper studies what happens when agents do not share a single communication protocol, introducing tunable linguistic distance between subpopulations. It finds linguistic distance slows consensus and causes mild divergence rather than full fragmentation.

entry.title: Scaling Performance and Low-Resource Annotation with Many-Shot In-Context Learning for Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Qi Zhang, Fangping Lan, Cornelia Caragea, Longin Jan Latecki, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Investigates many-shot in-context learning (hundreds of demonstrations) for named entity recognition with LLMs and its use for low-resource data annotation and refinement. Addresses the gap where prior NER ICL work focused only on few-shot settings.

entry.title: SPOTR: Spatio-temporal Pooling One-Token Reconstruction for Universal Physiological Signal Self-supervised Learning

author.name: Yiyu Gui, Mingzhi Chen, Yuesheng Zhu, Guibo Luo, Yuchao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SPOTR, a spatio-temporal pooling one-token reconstruction method for self-supervised learning on physiological signals like EEG, ECG, and PPG. Aims to handle heterogeneous datasets and reduce transformer compute while preserving clinically meaningful structure.

entry.title: Select-to-Act: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Language Guidance

author.name: Hanping Zhang, Adam Koziak, Yuhong Guo

entry.summary: Proposes HRLLI, a hierarchical RL framework that models natural-language instructions as dynamically selectable stage-dependent guidance rather than a single conditioning input. Aims to improve sample efficiency in complex sequential decision-making via adaptive language selection.

entry.title: Reinforcement learning to improve large language model-based automated code compliance systems

author.name: Jack Wei Lun Shi, Minghao Dang, Wawan Solihin, Leong Hien Poh, Justin K. W. Yeoh

entry.summary: Introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework using supervised fine-tuning plus Group Relative Policy Optimization to improve LLM-generated intermediate representations for automated building code compliance. Reports substantial reductions in tree edit and Levenshtein distance over SFT baselines.

entry.title: Dynamic multi-agent deep reinforcement learning-based pricing and incentivization approach in multimodal transportation networks

author.name: Khadidja Kadem, Mostafa Ameli, Carlos Lima Azevedo, Mahdi Zargayouna, Latifa Oukhellou

entry.summary: Uses multi-agent deep RL for dynamic pricing and incentives in multimodal transportation to balance conflicting goals of authorities, providers, and travelers. Targets equity, congestion, and emissions in shared mobility systems.

entry.title: Urban Power Grid Topology and Hierarchy Identification from Open Data

author.name: Shiliang Zhang, Sabita Maharjan

entry.summary: Develops an open-data-driven framework to reconstruct complete urban power grid topology and hierarchy from public infrastructure data, down to individual building connections. Addresses the proprietary-data barrier in grid resilience and power-flow research.

entry.title: Weighted Score-Oriented Losses for Temporally Localized Event Prediction

author.name: Edoardo Legnaro, Sabrina Guastavino, Francesco Marchetti
