entry.summary: Studies a temporally localized weighted score-oriented loss for event prediction where alarm utility depends on timing relative to events, bridging the gap between training losses and event-based deployment metrics. Targets anomaly, changepoint, and warning systems.

entry.title: Leveraging AutoML for Sustainable Deep Learning: A Multi-Objective HPO Approach on Deep Shift Neural Networks

author.name: Leona Hennig, Marius Lindauer

entry.summary: Uses multi-objective hyperparameter optimization (AutoML) to design energy-efficient Deep Shift Neural Networks for image classification, balancing accuracy and energy consumption. Provides insights into designing computationally cheaper inference models.

entry.title: Do Location Encoders Capture Spatial Effects? A GeoShapley Benchmark Across Scales

author.name: Daniel Kiv, Shaowen Wang

entry.summary: Benchmarks whether GeoShapley can recover spatially varying coefficients from eleven location encoders against a synthetic process with known coefficients across multiple scales. Examines interpretability of geographic embeddings.

entry.title: BARD-MARL: Byzantine-Agent Detection for Learned Communication in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Almond Kiruthu Murimi

entry.summary: Introduces BARD-MARL, a post-hoc Byzantine-agent detection layer for learned-communication multi-agent RL in adaptive traffic control, combining policy-graph features and Bayesian trust statistics. Addresses trust vulnerabilities when policies route information through faulty or adversarial agents.

entry.title: Betting on Moments: Legendre Jumper Martingales for Online Exchangeability Testing

author.name: Johan Hallberg Szabadv\'ary

entry.summary: Presents a family of conformal test martingales based on shifted Legendre polynomials for online exchangeability testing, extending the Simple Jumper martingale to detect higher-order distributional deviations. Introduces a variational variant to control state-space growth.

entry.title: Subsampling for supervised learning in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces

author.name: Eyal Vayness, Maxime Sangnier

entry.summary: Studies subsampling for supervised learning in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces using a Horvitz-Thompson reweighted estimator, deriving an optimal subsampling scheme based on the covariance operator trace. Aims to reduce computational cost and energy footprint.

entry.title: Detecting and Understanding Vulnerabilities in Fully Homomorphic Encryption Frameworks

author.name: Yiteng Peng, Dongwei Xiao, Zhibo Liu, Zhenlan JI, Shuai Wang

entry.summary: This paper investigates detecting and understanding logic bugs in fully homomorphic encryption frameworks, which translate high-level FHE programs into complex encrypted operations and are prone to silent correctness errors. It targets privacy-critical applications like secure cloud, finance, and healthcare.

entry.title: From Point Estimates to Distributions: GMM Pooling for MIL in Preterm Birth Prediction

author.name: Hussain Alasmawi, Numan Saeed, Soha Said, Mohammad Yaqub

entry.summary: This work formulates preterm-birth prediction as multiple-instance learning over a variable-sized bag of transvaginal ultrasound images per patient, proposing a Gaussian Mixture Model pooling that summarizes a bag's feature distribution into a fixed-length representation to capture intra-patient variability. It moves beyond standard point-estimate MIL aggregators.

entry.title: Event Ontology Expansion via LLM-Based Conceptualization

author.name: Weicheng Ren, Zixuan Li, Long Bai, Xiaolong Jin, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: ConceptE is a conceptualization-enhanced framework for event ontology expansion that derives concept-level semantics by prompting an LLM, rather than clustering contextualized trigger representations that conflate type semantics with surface variation. It aims for more stable clustering and reliable hierarchy expansion.

entry.title: Synthetic Audio Generation Framework for Air Traffic Control Speech Recognition

author.name: Rapha\"el Bagat, Zhe Zhang, Junichi Yamagishi, Irina Illina, Emmanuel Vincent

entry.summary: Proposes a synthetic audio generation pipeline combining TTS, voice conversion, and bidirectional L1-L2 accent conversion to address data scarcity in Air Traffic Control speech recognition. Tested on Whisper, it tackles channel noise and non-native accents in a safety-critical domain.

entry.title: Shear-Free Viewport Magnification for 360-Degree via Spherical Mobius Boosts

author.name: Boyang Li, Hezhao Xu

entry.summary: Formulates spherical Mobius boosts as exact conformal maps for shear-free viewport magnification in 360-degree imaging, preserving local angles while reallocating samples. Shows PSNR gains over offset cubemaps on panorama benchmarks.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Dual-Frequency Phase Decomposition for Single-Shot Composite Fringe Projection Profilometry

author.name: Jin-Hyuk Seok, Yatong An, Jae-Sang Hyun

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised dual-frequency phase decomposition framework for single-shot composite fringe projection profilometry, avoiding dense phase/depth labels. Improves accuracy over Fourier methods in complex regions for 3D measurement.

entry.title: NoduLoCC2026: Lung Nodule Localization and Classification Contest from Chest X-Ray Images

author.name: Adnan Mustafic, Halim Benhabiles, Adnane Cabani, Kristhian Andr\'e Oliveira Aguilar, Romain Amigon, Cl\'ement Bardin, Chiara Bentifece, Marin Boehm, K\'evin Bouchard, Laura Burattini, Diedre Carmo, Fahima Idiri, Matthis Lahargoue, Ilaria Marcantoni, Hicham Messaoudi, Cyril Meyer, Farid Meziane, L\'eon Morales, Let\'icia Rittner, Agnese Sbrollini, L\'eonard Zipper, Karim Hammoudi

entry.summary: Introduces NoduLoCC2026, a challenge and dataset for lung nodule localization and classification from chest X-rays with submissions from five teams. Highlights that localization remains substantially harder than classification.

entry.title: Quantile Adaptive Temperature Scaling for Confidence Calibration

author.name: Omprakash Chakraborty, Leo Fillioux, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz

entry.summary: Proposes Quantile Adaptive Temperature Scaling, a post-hoc calibration method that applies different temperatures across confidence quantiles rather than the global uniform rescaling of standard Temperature Scaling. It targets the observation that miscalibration is heterogeneous across the confidence spectrum, especially in low-confidence regions.

entry.title: Denoising-Enhanced Coarse-to-Fine Infrared Small Target Detection with Attention Prior-Guided Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Houzhang Fang, Ruixuan Huang, Qiuhuan Chen, Xiaolin Wang, Yi Chang, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes ECFNet, a coarse-to-fine infrared small target detection framework using denoising enhancement and attention prior-guided knowledge distillation to reduce redundant background computation. Targets UAV surveillance applications.

entry.title: Evaluating self-supervised echocardiographic representations across downstream extraction strategies for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction estimation

author.name: Sylwia Majchrowska, Philip Teare

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates self-supervised echocardiography representations for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction estimation, comparing extraction strategies of increasing expressivity. Highlights that single downstream probes confound representation quality with downstream model capacity.

entry.title: PaaF: Raising the perceived quality of INR-Based Image Compression

author.name: Lorenzo Catania, Dario Allegra

entry.summary: Proposes PaaF (Picture as a Function), an implicit-neural-representation image codec with improved architecture, adaptive quantization, and efficient entropy coding to close the PSNR gap and reduce long encoding times of INR-based compression. Preserves the simplicity and parallelizability of INR approaches.

entry.title: Improving Robotic Imitation Learning via Trajectory Standardization

author.name: Licheng Yang, Lingfeng Qian, Fei Zheng, Yonghao He, Wei Sui, Shuangshuang Li, Hu Su

entry.summary: Proposes Information-Standardized Trajectory Resampling, an offline preprocessing method that resamples robot demonstrations to enforce equal information distance between points, improving imitation learning from noisy human data. Addresses speed and pause-induced irregularity.

entry.title: A Theory-grounded Hybrid Neural Network Integrating Complementary Estimation Mechanisms for Stable Visual Object TrackingA

author.name: Yancheng Zhou, Hanle Zheng, Lei Deng, Yujie Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a theory-grounded hybrid framework integrating ANNs with continuous attractor neural networks for stable continuous-state visual object tracking, extending hybrid networks beyond neuron-scale spiking. Targets continuous estimation tasks.

entry.title: UNSEEN: Uncertainty-aware Navigation via Sparse Estimation in Unknown Environments

author.name: Tommaso Faraci, Marco Camurri, Daniele Fontanelli, Luigi Palopoli

entry.summary: Introduces UNSEEN, an uncertainty-aware vision-only navigation framework for resource-constrained robots that tightly couples commanded motion with perception and propagates uncertainty. Targets robustness under motion blur, low texture, and illumination changes.

entry.title: Ultra-Fusion: A Resilient Tightly-Coupled Multi-Sensor Fusion SLAM Framework under Sensor Degradation and Spatiotemporal Perturbation for Intelligent Transportation Systems

author.name: Yihong Tian, Junjie Zhang, Liuyang Li, Deteng Zhang, Yunfei Zuo, Jie Yin

entry.summary: Presents Ultra-Fusion, a tightly-coupled multi-sensor SLAM framework resilient to sensor degradation (poor illumination, LiDAR degeneracy, wheel slip, GNSS outage) and spatiotemporal calibration errors for intelligent transportation. Targets robust localization in challenging environments.

entry.title: Geometric Reconstruction of Extrinsic Contact Trajectories using Tactile Sensing and Proprioception for Tool Manipulation

author.name: Seojung Min, Yoonjin Kim, Jeong-Jung Kim, Jung Kim

entry.summary: Reconstructs the trajectory of tool-tip contact away from the gripper using tactile sensing and proprioception, formulated as a geometric inference problem under a single-point contact assumption. This enables better perception in tool-mediated manipulation where contact occurs far from the sensor.

entry.title: Lessons from the Field: A Case Study of Robotic Intervention in an Industrial Emergency

author.name: Jonathan Lichtenfeld, Frederik Bark, Robert Grafe, Oskar von Stryk

entry.summary: A field report documenting the successful deployment of a UGV with a custom manipulation tool to open a critical valve and neutralize an explosive gas hazard at a chemical plant after a fire. It offers practical lessons on rescue robotics and the limitations of research platforms in real emergencies.

entry.title: Discrete Geometric Modeling and Extended State Estimation of Continuum Robots

author.name: Maximilian Herrmann, Leander Pfeiffer, Paul Kotyczka

entry.summary: Presents a fully discrete approach for accurate and efficient dynamical modeling and state estimation of continuum robots using geometrically exact, strain-based beams within a Lie group variational integrator framework. It adds an extended Kalman filter disturbance observer validated on a real system.

entry.title: Variance or Standard Deviation? Shell Geometry and Global-Scale Priors in High-Dimensional Shrinkage

author.name: Wayne Yuan Gao, Zhiheng You

entry.summary: Examines how the default prior for a common Gaussian scale (flat on variance versus flat on standard deviation) affects high-dimensional shrinkage risk, showing the two priors allocate markedly different mass near zero scale, leading to distinct shrinkage behavior. It establishes asymptotic risk advantages and informs principled default prior selection.

entry.title: Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents

author.name: Boming Xia, Liming Zhu, Zhenchang Xing, Qinghua Lu, Dino Sejdinovic, Xiwei Xu

entry.summary: Develops architectural patterns and a reference architecture for how LLM agents discover, activate, and interpret reusable skill artifacts, introducing the concept of skill-in-use. It governs the transition from static skill documents to executable behavior.

entry.title: Towards Transparent Mental Health Insights: An Explainable AI Model for Career-Related Depression and Anxiety Among University Students Using Structured Data

author.name: Arsham Azam, Rasikh Ali, Tayyaba Farhat, Sheeraz Akram

entry.summary: Proposes an explainable AI framework using multimodal data and federated learning to detect early career-related depression and anxiety in university students in a privacy-preserving way. It fuses structured behavioral data and facial emotion features with attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Nous: A Predictive World Model for Long-Term Agent Memory

author.name: Pranav Singh

entry.summary: Nous proposes an agent memory architecture where knowledge is stored as categorical probability distributions updated by Bayesian posteriors, with information-theoretic surprise scoring and natural forgetting via entropy decay, storing belief shifts rather than raw facts. It reframes memory as prediction.

entry.title: A Digital Twin Framework for Traffic-Aware UAV Pavement Monitoring without Lane Closure

author.name: Yamil Uchani, Grace Abigail Luna Verdueta, Mauricio Figueroa, Edwin Salcedo

entry.summary: Introduces a Unity-based digital twin framework for traffic-aware UAV pavement monitoring without lane closures, integrating procedural road defects, dynamic agents, autonomous navigation, and a two-stage YOLO-based perception pipeline. Targets realistic deployment challenges.

entry.title: Rethinking the Adaptation of Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cell Segmentation

author.name: Qing Xu, Xiangjian He, Wenting Duan, Jiebo Luo, Zhen Chen

entry.summary: Introduces EffiCell-Seg, a framework that adapts vision foundation models for cell segmentation without retraining heavy encoders by exploiting their intrinsic structural priors. Targets computational efficiency and reduced annotation dependency in computational pathology.

entry.title: Gradient-Descent Steps to Success over Mean Accuracy: A Paradigm Shift for ML

author.name: Riccardo Poli, Ahmet Yilmaz

entry.summary: Argues for evaluating ML models by computational effort (gradient-descent steps to reach acceptable accuracy with high probability) instead of mean accuracy alone, extending Koza's effort metric. Shows minimizing this effort acts as a form of AutoML across 11 models.

entry.title: Structured Hyperedge Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision Transformers

author.name: Edwin Kwadwo Tenagyei, Lei Wang, Ugochukwu Ejike Akpudo, Jun Zhou, Yongsheng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes HyperAdapter, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for vision transformers that performs adaptation in hyperedge space rather than per-token, capturing structured relationships among tokens. Aims to reduce redundant updates and spatially inconsistent feature refinement.

entry.title: All Green, Still Broken: Real-Flow Verification Lessons from an LLM-Integrated, Multi-Market Web Application

author.name: Muhammad Bilal (Technical University of Munich), Ali Hassaan Mughal (Independent Researcher)

entry.summary: Reports a case study of a production LLM-integrated multi-market web app where a 1,553-test suite passed continuously yet defects reached production, classifying all 252 bug-fix commits by the seam they escaped through. Finds about 44 percent fell in four seams unit tests cannot observe (live browser runtime, non-default market, end-to-end flow, whole-system).

entry.title: Evolutionary Discovery of Developmental Reward Schedules in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alan Nadelsticher Ruvalcaba

entry.summary: Proposes an evolutionary framework to discover time-varying developmental reward schedules combining biologically inspired agency, novelty, and reactivity components in deep RL. Compares four evolutionary algorithms on sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks.

entry.title: Dual-Attention Convolution Experts for Sparse Tensor Completion

author.name: Yanlei Liu, Zhenyu Liao

entry.summary: Proposes DCGC, a neural tensor factorization method using dual-attention convolution experts and group-level contrastive learning to handle complex cross-mode interactions and extreme sparsity in tensor completion. Targets high-dimensional sparse data recovery.

entry.title: The Fractal Neural Operator: Overcoming Spectral Bias in Chaotic Attractors via Prime-Harmonic Weierstrass Encodings

author.name: Kanishk Awadhiya

entry.summary: Introduces the Fractal Neural Operator using a non-resonant prime-harmonic Weierstrass encoding to overcome spectral bias when modeling chaotic strange attractors with fractal geometry. Claims infinite spectral resolution in the latent space.

entry.title: Deep learning-based detection of cessation of breathing in pre-term infants

author.name: Dineo Serame, Lionel Tarassenko, Mauricio Villarroel

entry.summary: Evaluates deep learning detection of cessation-of-breathing events in pre-term infants using impedance pneumography, ECG, and photoplethysmography signals routinely acquired in the NICU. Aims to improve apnoea detection without extra sensors.

entry.title: Interpretable Kolmogorov-Arnold Network with Feature-Isolated Temporal Attention Mechanism for Electricity Load Forecasting

author.name: Jinhao Li, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Develops LoadKAN, an interpretable Kolmogorov-Arnold Network with a feature-isolated temporal attention mechanism for electricity load forecasting. Aims to combine KAN's interpretability with strong temporal modeling versus black-box deep models.

entry.title: Estimating Learners' Skill Acquisition Without Temporal Information

author.name: Ryosuke Nagai (SODA), Kyohei Atarashi (SODA), Koh Takeuchi (SODA), Jill-J\^enn Vie (SODA), Hisashi Kashima

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for predicting learners' next skill acquisition using only single-time-point assessment data without temporal information, exploiting inclusion relations among skill sets from cognitive diagnostic models. Addresses settings where time-series knowledge tracing cannot apply.

entry.title: Eigenspace-Based Clustering for Personalized System Identification

author.name: Abdulmoneam Ali, Dipankar Maity, Ahmed Arafa

entry.summary: Proposes a one-shot, training-free clustering method for heterogeneous system identification using alignment between leading covariance eigenspaces. Avoids sensitivity of iterative training-based cluster assignment.

entry.title: GRAG: Generic Response-Augmented Generation Framework for Personalized Conversational Systems

author.name: Junfeng Liu, Christopher T. Symons, Ranga Raju Vatsavai

entry.summary: Proposes GRAG, a framework that decouples content grounding from personalization in conversational systems, addressing the bottleneck where models conflate what to say with user-specific style. Targets deployment in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive settings.

entry.title: Behavioral and Representational Evidence of Binomial Ordering Preferences in Large Language Models

author.name: Zhiqing Yang, Yilun Liu, Yunpu Ma, Volker Tresp, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs model gradient frequency distributions of linguistic binomials (e.g., 'men and women') across 8 languages, formalizing binomial ordering as distributional alignment. Finds models recover dominant orders behaviorally but with representational gaps.

entry.title: Signed Evidence Flow: Conflict-Aware and Stability-Calibrated Data Analysis

author.name: Jeffery Opoku, David Banahene

entry.summary: Introduces Signed Evidence Flow (SEF), combining predictions with signed feature attributions to quantify support, opposition, conflict, and perturbation stability behind a decision. Proves conditions relating confidence to conflict and connects conflict to decision fragility.

entry.title: Target-Aware Linear Regression Under Distribution Shift

author.name: Zhewen Hou, Tian Zheng

entry.summary: This work studies multivariate linear regression under covariate shift when target marginals are known, proposing a hybrid-loss estimator that incorporates target information as side knowledge with a stable conditional mean. It develops tractable approximations to a coupled nonlinear objective.

entry.title: LLM and Human Modes of Representation

author.name: Shalom Lappin

entry.summary: A conceptual analysis by Shalom Lappin comparing LLM and human modes of representation across linguistic knowledge and real-world reasoning/planning domains. Examines points of convergence and divergence in information processing.

entry.title: Olfactory-Inspired Sparse Combinatorial Coding for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Bhushan Deshpande

entry.summary: Introduces a biologically-inspired receptor-glomerular bottleneck based on olfactory sparse combinatorial coding, inserted between token embeddings and a BiLSTM-CRF for low-resource NER. Evaluated from scratch across six multilingual datasets without pretrained embeddings.

entry.title: ROMEVA: Geometry-Preserving Vocabulary Expansion for Roman Urdu Language Models

author.name: Mahnoor Khan, Afsheen Asif, Milhan Afzal Khan, Seemab Latif, Mehwish Fatima

entry.summary: Proposes ROMEVA for Roman Urdu vocabulary expansion in mBERT, combining sub-word-average initialization and PCA-guided anchor loss to stabilize embeddings against severe sub-word fragmentation. Adds 500 fragmented tokens and compares against naive fine-tuning.

entry.title: Koshur Pixel: a large-scale synthetic ocr dataset for kashmiri

author.name: Haq Nawaz Malik, Faizan Iqbal, Nahfid Nissar

entry.summary: Releases Koshur Pixel, the first large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Kashmiri in Perso-Arabic Nastaliq script, with 613k image-text pairs and 25+ augmentation strategies. Addresses low-resource OCR challenges with complex glyph shaping.

entry.title: A Smart Classroom Behavior Analysis Framework with a New Highly Congested Classroom Dataset

author.name: Wei Xu, Maoxiang Chu, Yuelong Fan, Guanghao Liao, Yinxiang Yu, Zhi Chen, Haotian Wang, Yutian Zhu

entry.summary: Constructs HCCB, a Highly Congested Classroom Behavior dataset with 50k instances across seven behavior categories, and a detection framework for dense, occluded, scale-varying classroom scenarios. Targets intelligent classroom analysis in large classes.

entry.title: CoSA: Correlation-Guided Change Attention with Learnable Residual Gating for Remote Sensing Change Detection

author.name: Abdirashid Omar, Jonghyuk Park

entry.summary: Introduces CoSA, a lightweight decoder-side refinement module for remote sensing change detection that uses bi-temporal feature correlation as an explicit control signal with learnable residual gating. Aims to improve robustness under sparse changes and noisy labels.

entry.title: MythraGen: Two-Stage Retrieval Augmented Art Generation Framework

author.name: Quang-Khai Le, Cong-Long Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le

entry.summary: Proposes MythraGen, a two-stage retrieval-augmented framework for text-to-artistic image generation that combines art retrieval from a large dataset with LoRA-based fine-tuning to integrate artist-specific styles and content. Targets contextually accurate artistic generation.

entry.title: Boosting Neural Video Codec via Scale-Driven Online Flow Refinement

author.name: Tiange Zhang, Rongqun Lin, Haocheng Tang, Xiandong Meng, Weijia Jiang, Zhimeng Huang, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes SOFR, a training-free plug-and-play module that refines optical flow at multiple scales to improve neural video codec generalization to unseen motion patterns. Adds rate-aware fusion with negligible compute overhead.

entry.title: Scaling State-Space Models from Lines to Paragraphs: An Ablation of Mamba-based OCR

author.name: Merveilles Agbeti-Messan, Pierrick Tranouez, St\'ephane Nicolas, Cl\'ement Chatelain, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: An ablation study examining how Mamba-based OCR scales from text lines to full paragraphs, systematically varying four core hyperparameters and testing generalization to handwriting. Provides empirical understanding of state-space models for long-sequence transcription.

entry.title: How Should a Robot Configure Its Laser Scanner for Inspection?

author.name: Zhiling Chen, David Gorsich, Matthew P. Castanier, Yang Zhang, Jiong Tang, Farhad Imani

entry.summary: Proposes SenseHD, a robotic sensing system that formulates laser scanner configuration as an instruction-conditioned discrete decision selected via hyperdimensional associative memory, rather than predicting precise parameter values. Addresses the underexplored problem of sensing-parameter configuration for inspection.

entry.title: Adaptive Beam Selection for Efficient Scanning Probe Tomography

author.name: San Dinh, Zichao Wendy Di, Matt Menickelly

entry.summary: Proposes a sequential design-of-experiments method for adaptive beam selection in scanning probe X-ray tomography, choosing each subsequent measurement to maximize information gain and align beams with sample edges. Aims to reduce projections, acquisition time, and radiation dose.

entry.title: NGPS: Structure-Preserving Self-Supervised Denoising via Neighbor-Guided Patch Sampling

author.name: Jaehyun Cho, YoungJoon Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes NGPS, a self-supervised denoising method for volumetric medical imaging that constructs neighbor supervision under inter-slice misalignment without explicit registration, preserving high-frequency anatomical boundaries. Avoids ghosting from naive neighboring-slice training.

entry.title: Design and Development of a Neuromorphic Silicon Suite: PVT Sensing, Stochastic LIF Inference, On-Chip STDP Learning, and Crossbar Programming

author.name: Poornima Kumaresan, Santhosh Sivasubramani

entry.summary: Develops a neuromorphic silicon suite on SkyWater 130nm including PVT sensing, stochastic LIF neurons, on-chip STDP learning, and crossbar programming as interface-compatible digital IP blocks. Targets edge neuromorphic systems.

entry.title: Mind the Privileged-to-Camera Gap: Actor-Centric Sidecar Supervision for Camera-First Open-Loop Waypoint Prediction

author.name: Feeza Khan Khanzada, Jaerock Kwon

entry.summary: Studies camera-first open-loop waypoint prediction for autonomous driving, using simulator-derived sidecar labels to supervise actor grounding and motion during training while keeping camera-only inference. Frames it as supervised representation learning.

entry.title: Long-Distance Real-World Navigation of the Legged-Wheeled Robot Go2-W Using Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Takaaki Matsuzawa, Kiyoshi Irie, Tomoaki Yoshida, Taro Suzuki, Yoshitaka Hara, Masahiro Tomono

entry.summary: Reports building a DRL-based locomotion controller and autonomous navigation system for the commercial Go2-W legged-wheeled robot, applied to long-range real-world navigation. Extends a proprioception-only quadruped policy to the 16-DoF legged-wheeled platform.

entry.title: Cooperative-ORCA*: Real-Time Proactive Deadlock Avoidance for Continuous-Space Multi-Agent Navigation

author.name: Junfeng Wu, Jiaqi Chen, Hongkun Lyu, Kevin Zheng, Andy Li

entry.summary: Cooperative-ORCA* extends the real-time continuous-space MAPF solver ORCA* with proactive deadlock avoidance, replacing myopic post-hoc fallback interventions that incur high flowtime overhead. It targets coordinated multi-agent navigation.

entry.title: Model Size Scaling in 2023-2031

author.name: Vladimir_Nesov

entry.summary: A LessWrong analysis projecting feasible LLM model sizes from 2023 to 2031 based on token-generation speed constraints from HBM bandwidth, pipeline stage limits, and available pretraining compute. It estimates total parameters growing from around 10T in 2026 (8x sparsity) to 240T in 2028 (30x sparsity) given evolving hardware racks.

entry.title: The AI Evaluability Gap: The Missing Layer for Managing Risk and Sustaining Value

author.name: Vishal Srivastava, Tanmay Sah

entry.summary: Argues that AI governance suffers from an Evaluability Gap, where organizations lack sufficient evidence to justify confident risk and value decisions, framing current practice as a category error focused on system properties rather than evidentiary foundations. Proposes evaluability as a missing governance layer.

entry.title: Short-Term Electricity Demand Forecasting for New England Using a Hybrid Transformer-XGBoost Framework with Weather, Calendar, and COVID-19 Indicators

author.name: Reza Ghanavati, Behrooz Mosallaei

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid Transformer-XGBoost framework for short-term New England electricity demand forecasting integrating weather, calendar, autoregressive lags, and COVID-19 epidemiological indicators. Uses Optuna hyperparameter optimization with leakage-free chronological splits.

entry.title: Lexical Consensus: Grounded Word Learning and Shared Meaning in Artificial Agents

author.name: Patricio M. Vera

entry.summary: Introduces Lexical Consensus, an experimental framework for studying grounded word learning in artificial agents using frozen DINOv2 embeddings and nonce words. Finds a robust perceptual-coherence gradient where native categories are learned more readily.

entry.title: Active Sensing and Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization for Robust Target Identification

author.name: Farbod Siahkali, Mengxue Hou, Vijay Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes Active-Sensing Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization (AS-DDTO) for mobile sensing, computing trajectories that maintain reachability to all candidate targets while biasing the coincident path toward information-rich regions for robust target identification. Extends DDTO with an information-acquisition term.

entry.title: CASPER in the Machine: Insights into Character Variety in LLM-Generated Stories

author.name: Anneliese Brei, Abhisheik Sharma, Nicholas Sanaie, Lu Wang, Snigdha Chaturvedi

entry.summary: Uses narratology-derived definitions to analyze eight character dimensions (such as stylization and wholeness) comparing LLM-generated and human-written stories. Examines whether LLMs produce similar and as varied characters as humans.

entry.title: Towards Robust Training in NNGPT AutoML Pipeline: A Loss-Optimizer Pairing Selection Study

author.name: Anton Abramochkin, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov

entry.summary: Conducts a systematic study of all eighteen optimizer-loss pairings across structurally diverse architectures within an AutoML pipeline, asking whether a single recipe suffices for heterogeneous model pools. Includes a recently evolved NGL loss.

entry.title: Learning Graphs through Continuous Information Entropy Fields

author.name: Hui Cong, Bo Sun, Ziheng Jiao, Yisheng An

entry.summary: Proposes the Field-informed Graph Network (FGN), an explanatory framework where graph edges emerge from latent continuous information entropy fields modulating message passing. Offers a why-oriented view of graph structure.

entry.title: Efficient Network Inference via Hardware-Aware Architecture Search, Model Pruning & Quantization

author.name: Lucas Heublein, Mark Deutel, Axel Plinge, Felix Ott

entry.summary: Investigates efficient neural network inference for GNSS interference monitoring using structured pruning, post-training quantization, and hardware-aware zero-shot NAS starting from MCUNet. Targets real-time processing on resource-constrained embedded hardware.

entry.title: Orthogonal Discrepancy Kernels for Learning with Partial Physics

author.name: Swapnil Manna, Timothy J. Rogers, Lawrence Bull

entry.summary: Introduces orthogonal discrepancy kernels in a semi-parametric Gaussian process framework for nonlinear system identification, decoupling physics-based components from learned discrepancy. Produces interpretable gray-box models from incomplete physics.

entry.title: Can LLMs Control Readability? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for CEFR-Controlled Arabic Generation

author.name: Nour Rabih, Chatrine Qwaider, Ted Briscoe

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional evaluation framework for CEFR-controlled Arabic text generation, integrating readability prediction, lexical constraint validation, and syntactic profiling. Finds structured prompting with lexical constraints substantially improves CEFR alignment.

entry.title: CITADEL: CSI-Based Jamming Detection and Open-Set Classification for IIoT Networks

author.name: Aymen Bouferroum (FUN), Ildi Alla (uni.lu), Valeria Loscri (FUN), Abderrahim Benslimane (AU), Vincent Lenders (uni.lu)

entry.summary: CITADEL is a lightweight two-stage pipeline using only Channel State Information to detect and classify RF jamming attacks, including unseen ones via open-set classification, on commodity IIoT devices. It avoids impractical raw I/Q processing at scale.

entry.title: Attention mechanism for scalable mesh-based neural surrogates of free-surface fluids

author.name: Federico Lanteri, Massimiliano Cremonesi

entry.summary: This work proposes a self-attention-based neural surrogate for Particle Finite Element Method simulations of free-surface fluids that operates on arbitrary and evolving mesh geometries, including non-Newtonian rheologies. It aims to approximate costly Lagrangian fluid dynamics at reduced computational cost.

entry.title: Time Series Classification through Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW)

author.name: Vicky Geneva Haney, Kamel Lahouel, Victor Rielly, Bruno M. Jedynak

entry.summary: DiffTW proposes a diffeomorphic time-warping framework for time-series classification that learns continuous mappings approximating the flow of a transport equation, generalizing beyond Dynamic Time Warping's discrete point matching. It targets domains like health monitoring where temporal structure matters.

entry.title: Language-Specific Sentiment Polarity Biases in Encoder and Large Language Model Classification of Product Reviews

author.name: Advita Rajiv, Kavitha Kothur, Gautham Reddy

entry.summary: Investigates language-specific sentiment polarity biases in encoder and LLM classifiers of product reviews. Finds LLMs show negative bias in French while encoders show positive bias in Japanese, missing indirect criticism.

entry.title: ARGUSTRACK: A Multi-View Annotation System for Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Hao Vo, Duc Nguyen, Ngan Le

entry.summary: Presents ARGUS-TRACK, a multi-camera annotation system that lets annotators label on a bird's-eye-view plane with automatic projection to 2D boxes across views. Addresses the annotation bottleneck for camera-only multi-object tracking.

entry.title: Sparse Point-Guided Fusion of Supervised and Self-Supervised Learning Model for Seaweed Segmentation

author.name: Tatsuya Suzuki, Kazuya Ijuin, Hideki Tomimori, Megumi Chikano, Katsushi Sakai

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage seaweed segmentation method combining supervised and self-supervised learning with sparse point guidance for blue carbon quantification in Ocean Digital Twins. Addresses underwater data scarcity and species diversity.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Person Re-Identification from Temporal Sequences with Transformer and Hungarian Optimization

author.name: Rapha\"el Del\'ecluse, Hazem Wannous, Laurent Guimas

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving person re-identification approach using depth images (which obscure identifiable features) with a Transformer and Hungarian-algorithm matching over temporal frame sequences. Targets surveillance applications where RGB raises privacy concerns.

entry.title: Autonomous Subsea Cable Search and Tracking with Graph-Optimised Priors and Visual Tracking

author.name: Ibrahim Fadhil Djauhari, Adrian Bodenmann, Samuel Simmons, Cailei Liang, David White, Susan Gourvenec, Tom Bennetts, Darryl Newborough, Blair Thornton

entry.summary: Presents a subsea cable search and tracking method for AUVs that fuses uncertain prior route maps with visual observations via graph-based optimization and physics-based catenary models. Targets inspection of critical communications infrastructure.

entry.title: Conflict-Aware Switching for CBF-CLF-Based Multi-Goal Navigation

author.name: Rohan Walia, Kevin Leahy

entry.summary: Proposes a conflict-aware switching strategy for CBF-CLF quadratic programs to mitigate slowdowns and deadlocks in multi-goal reach-and-avoid navigation under shared safety constraints. Better suited to sequential goal-to-goal navigation than prior relaxation methods.

entry.title: Bayesian model selection of vine copulas: a loss-based perspective

author.name: Rosario Barone, Luciana Dalla Valle, Fabrizio Leisen, Cristiano Villa

entry.summary: Proposes a novel loss-based Bayesian framework for vine copula model selection and estimation that addresses the intractable combinatorial explosion of possible vine structures even in moderate dimensions. It enables more efficient Bayesian inference for complex dependence modeling.

entry.title: On the Identifiability of User Adaptation in Co-Adaptive Neural Interfaces

author.name: Philip Waggoner

entry.summary: This paper analyzes identifiability in co-adaptive human-machine systems, showing that closed-loop encoder estimates reflect joint system properties rather than uniquely identifying user adaptation. It proposes conditions for proper identification, which matters for interpreting brain-computer or neural interface adaptation.

entry.title: DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency

author.name: Oleg Solozobov

entry.summary: DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark assessing whether agent-runtime evidence records are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level governance properties. It applies a Decision Evidence Maturity Model across eight evidence regimes with deterministic degradations.

entry.title: Whistleblowing and the machine -- towards a considered position

author.name: Marija Slavkovik, Liuwen Yu, Leon van der Torre, Reka Markovich

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that machine whistleblowing must be normative and principled, grounded in existing understandings of whistleblowing as a societal rule-breaking mechanism, and calls for regulatory stances. It examines whether autonomous agents should protect all secrets.

entry.title: Hallucination as Context Drift: Synchronization Protocols for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Carson Rodrigues

entry.summary: This paper reframes some multi-agent hallucinations as context drift, where agents hold divergent internal world states, and proposes a Context Divergence Score plus a shared-state verification protocol to keep agents synchronized. It offers a useful conceptual lens but limited empirical depth.

entry.title: Self-Evolving Cognitive Framework via Causal World Modeling for Embodied Scientific Intelligence

author.name: Yi Yu, Tetsunari Inamura

entry.summary: This position-and-framework paper argues embodied intelligence should move beyond predictive world modeling toward self-evolving cognitive systems that build and refine causal representations through intervention-driven reasoning and continual refinement. It proposes a three-component cognitive architecture.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Sign Language Recognition from Videos and Cross-Lingual Translation to Indian Vernaculars

author.name: Chandranath Adak, Ramesh Nandipalli

entry.summary: This paper presents a two-stage pipeline that classifies Indian Sign Language video clips into English labels with a fine-tuned VideoMAE transformer and translates them into Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali using NLLB-200. It targets accessibility for low-resource Indian languages.

entry.title: Text-to-Image Generative AI for Modeling and Simulation: Methods, Opportunities, and Applications

author.name: Philippe J. Giabbanelli

entry.summary: A tutorial introducing text-to-image generation to the modeling and simulation community, detailing applications like communicating conceptual models, visualizing outcomes, generating educational materials, and interfacing multi-scale models. Combines conceptual guidance with practical workflows.

entry.title: Anatomically Consistent TMJ Disc Segmentation via Semantic Anchoring and Clinical Priors

author.name: Dayun Ju, Chanyoung Kim, Sunyoung Jung, Hyo-Jung Jung, Chena Lee, Younjung Park, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: TISC is a TMJ disc segmentation framework for MRI that combines prototypical semantic anchoring in a foundation model feature space with clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement. It targets the difficulty of segmenting small, low-contrast, variable anatomy for diagnosing internal derangement.

entry.title: ScalePredictor: Instance-aware Scale Learning for Accurate Quantization of Vision Transformers

author.name: Changjun Li, Runqing Jiang, Lian Xu, Ye Zhang, Qingyong Hu, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: Presents ScalePredictor, a dynamic post-training quantization framework for vision transformers that learns instance-aware quantization scales to handle varying activation distributions across images. Improves accuracy over static uniform quantization paradigms.

entry.title: Sequential Minimal Optimization Algorithm for One-Class Support Vector Machines With Privileged Information

author.name: Andrey Lange, Dmitry Smolyakov, Evgeny Burnaev

entry.summary: Develops a Sequential Minimal Optimization algorithm for one-class SVM with privileged information (OC-SVM+), filling a gap in the LUPI paradigm, with proven finite-time convergence. Significantly outperforms non-sequential training algorithms.

entry.title: MixedPEFT: Combining Multiple PEFT Methods with Mixed Objectives for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Mohammed Rawhani, Dervis Karaboga, Ozkan Ufuk Nalbantoglu, Alper Basturk, Bahriye Akay

entry.summary: Proposes MixedPEFT, combining invertible adapters and LoRA with a mixed objective (source classification plus target masked language modeling) for unsupervised domain adaptation of pretrained LMs. Preserves target-domain knowledge while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Words as Difference Makers: How Large Language Models Determine Causal Structure in Text

author.name: Wolfgang Pietsch

entry.summary: A philosophical/conceptual analysis arguing that LLMs determine causal structure through difference-making (variational induction) rather than Pearl's interventionist or Neyman-Rubin potential-outcomes frameworks. Explains why LLMs need vast diverse text to identify causal and indifference relations.

entry.title: The Cost Geometry of Belief: finite-resource inference under noisy observation

author.name: Laurent Caraffa

entry.summary: Equips belief space with a cost geometry combining Wasserstein optimal transport reweighted by Fisher information for finite-resource inference under noisy observation. Derives invariants for digital-twin Bayesian belief updating.

entry.title: Evolving Spatial Weights for Cartographic Synthesis

author.name: Gesiel R. Lopes, Roberto F. da Silva, Mellina Yamamura, Sergio H. V. L. de Mattos, Antonio M. Saraiva, Alexandre C. B. Delbem, Eric K. Tokuda

entry.summary: Presents GIS-moGA, a bi-objective evolutionary framework for cartographic synthesis that estimates thematic layer weights by maximizing global spatial autocorrelation (Global Moran's I) while minimizing local heterogeneity (LISA variance). Addresses expert-driven weighting limitations with spatially grounded optimization.

entry.title: Federated learning with heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise: a variance-reduction based algorithm

author.name: Shengchao Zhao, Yongchao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes VRA-FedSGD, a variance-reduction federated learning algorithm robust to heavy-tailed gradient and communication noise common in wireless/IoT deployments. It combines momentum variance reduction with nonlinear mapping and variance-reduced aggregation, with convergence rate guarantees.

entry.title: Bridge the Gaps: Heterogeneous Attributed Graph Clustering via Quaternion Representation Learning

author.name: Xinxi Chen, Junyang Chen, Yiqun Zhang, Chuangming Qiu, Xiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes quaternion representation learning for heterogeneous attributed graph clustering, addressing attribute heterogeneity, over-smoothing, and topology amplification. Combines numerical and categorical attributes in unified representations.

entry.title: Differential Spectral Damping Gap Adaptive Regularization for Ill-Conditioned Kernel Methods

author.name: Praveg Vashishtha

entry.summary: Proposes Differential Spectral Damping, an adaptive regularization for ill-conditioned kernel methods (notably LSTSVM) that adapts penalties to local eigengap structure using Davis-Kahan perturbation theory. Preserves reliable eigenvectors while suppressing corrupted ones.

entry.title: Empowering Embodied AI in 6G Networks: Architecture, Enablers, and Open Challenges

author.name: Junaid Sajid, Sheikh Salman Hassan, Wenshuai Liu, Yan Kyaw Tun, Yaru Fu, Nguyen H. Tran, Zhu Han, Cedomir Stefanovic, Tharmalingam Ratnarajah, Muhammad Mahtab Alam

entry.summary: A survey/architecture paper on empowering embodied AI in 6G networks, presenting a holistic perception-communication-action framework and identifying enablers and open challenges. Argues existing AI-native wireless architectures are too connectivity-centric for embodied intelligence.

entry.title: A Generalized Formalism of Auto-Regressive Decoding for Speech Processing

author.name: Julia Gachot, Philipp Allgeuer, Marie S. Bauer, Stefan Wermter

entry.summary: Provides a generalized theoretical framework to categorize and unify auto-regressive decoding strategies in speech processing, establishing explicit inclusion criteria. Aims to resolve inconsistencies in how decoding methods are characterized and compared.

entry.title: Evaluating Document-Tuned Transformer Representations for Person-level Mental Health Assessment

author.name: Aaron Marker, Oscar Kjell, Vasudha Varadarajan, H. Andrew Schwartz

entry.summary: Empirically compares base transformers versus document-tuned (sentence) transformers for person-level mental health assessment across two longitudinal datasets, finding document-tuned models consistently improve correlation by 13.4%. Evaluates layer-wise performance and robustness.

entry.title: Towards Whole Hand and Wrist Kinematic Tracking with a Wearable A-Mode Ultrasound Probe

author.name: Giusy Spacone, Luca Benini, Andrea Cossettini

entry.summary: This work presents a wearable A-mode ultrasound system that regresses 23 hand and wrist degrees of freedom directly on-probe using a compact CNN with incremental training for robustness to sensor repositioning. It targets practical, on-device kinematic tracking.

entry.title: A Dual-Track Framework for Template-Constrained LaTeX Conversion

author.name: Chung Cheuk Hei, Liu Li

entry.summary: Presents a dual-track framework decoupling template formatting from document processing for Markdown-to-LaTeX conversion, extracting template constraints offline into a reusable manifest. Aims to avoid both rule-based brittleness and LLM hallucination/semantic drift.

entry.title: Robust Image-Driven Phenotyping of Ovarian Tumor Cells using Optimized Dynamic Features in Hyperbolic Channels

author.name: Hong-Fei Li, Xi-Lin Gao, Yi-Juan Xiang, Shu-Song Huang, Yi-lin Wang, Chun-Dong Xue, Zhuo Yang, Yong-Jiang Li, Xu-Qu Hu

entry.summary: Introduces a stability-guided framework for label-free mechanophenotyping of ovarian tumor cells in hyperbolic microchannels, decoupling flow-induced noise from intrinsic biological signatures. Improves robustness of single-cell profiling.

entry.title: Toward Parking Spot Occupancy Recognition: A Self-Supervised Approach

author.name: Luan Marko Kujavski, Rayson Laroca, Paulo Lisboa de Almeida

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised two-stage approach for parking spot occupancy recognition requiring no target-lot labels, using SimCLR with ResNet-50 and cross-environment evaluation. Reduces annotation needs for urban parking monitoring.

entry.title: Expert Consensus on Criteria for the Automated Assessment of Laparoscopic Camera Navigation

author.name: Amir Ebrahimzadeh, Nazila Esmaeili, Michael Ghadimi, Jannis Hagenah

entry.summary: Establishes expert consensus on a 14-aspect taxonomy for automated assessment of laparoscopic camera navigation and evaluates the technological readiness of automating each criterion. Aims to enable scalable, standardized surgical training feedback.

entry.title: Configurable Algorithms for Histopathologic Cancer Detection on Quantum Hardware

author.name: Nandika Goyal, Glen Uehara, Andreas Spanias

entry.summary: Proposes two quantum algorithms for histopathologic cancer detection: a configurable dual-gradient CSWAP circuit and a hardware-efficient destructive swap circuit, proving their algebraic equivalence and adding a three-stage NISQ error-mitigation pipeline. Explores edge-detection-based image analysis on quantum hardware.

entry.title: Controllable Texture Tiling with Transformed RoPE-Enhanced Diffusion Models

author.name: Junrong Huang, Zhiyuan Zhang, Rui Tang, Hongbo Fu, Jnig Liao

entry.summary: Presents a RoPE-enhanced diffusion model for controllable texture tiling that repeats reference patterns with user-specified frequency, orientation, and scale while preserving structural fidelity. Targets material editing in image graphics.

entry.title: PHAST-Net: Attention-Guided, Physics-Informed Network for Unified Estimation of Ideal Time-Frequency Representations

author.name: James M. Cozens, Simon J. Godsill

entry.summary: Introduces PHAST-Net, a physics-informed attention network for unified estimation of ideal time-frequency representations across spectral, tempo, metrical, and harmonic domains using adaptive wavelet transforms. Targets high-resolution, cross-term-suppressed signal analysis.

entry.title: Predictive Gaze Is Preserved but Reorganized toward Monitoring during Robot-Mediated Manipulation

author.name: Manuela Uliano, Silvia Fattorini, Marco Controzzi

entry.summary: Investigates whether predictive, task-driven gaze behavior is preserved during robot-mediated telemanipulation, finding gaze remains aligned with task goals but redistributes attention toward the robotic end-effector for monitoring. Provides insight into visuomotor control under altered embodiment.

entry.title: Deep RL- Tuned Mo del-Free Adaptive Control for Lower-Limb Exoskeletons During Sit-to-Stand Transitions

author.name: Ranjeet Kumbhar, Appaso M. Gadade, Rajmeet Singh, Ashish Singla, Ravinder Kumar

entry.summary: Presents a model-free adaptive backstepping controller with an ultra-local second-order model and RBF neural network, tuned via deep RL, for lower-limb exoskeletons during sit-to-stand transitions. Avoids explicit system identification amid inter-subject variability.

entry.title: FPAS: Frontier-Based Path Planning with Adaptive Sampling for Large-Scale Unknown Environments

author.name: Jinwoo Choi, Yeonkyu Lee, Jung-Taak Kim, Jisung Bae, Seung-Woo Seo

entry.summary: FPAS is a frontier-based path planning framework with adaptive sampling for efficient goal-reaching in large-scale unknown environments, reinterpreting frontiers for goal-directed forward progress and backtracking. It uses a frontier-derived openness metric to dynamically adjust graph sampling.

entry.title: Embedded Polygon Symbolic Transfer Entropy (EPSTE): A Geometric Token and Deep Learning Approach to Estimating Transfer Entropy in Neuroimaging Time Series

author.name: David Alexander Finnigan

entry.summary: EPSTE reframes transfer entropy estimation in EEG/MEG as a learnable problem operating on geometric symbolic representations of local temporal morphology rather than raw amplitudes, aiming for more stable directed-information-flow inference in finite, noisy data. It combines symbolic tokens with deep learning for neuroimaging.

entry.title: Large reasoning models as thinking machines for medicine

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: A paper examining large reasoning models as thinking machines for medicine, likely surveying or evaluating reasoning-model applications in clinical contexts. No abstract content was provided.

entry.title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government

author.name: Ethan Knights, Christopher Conlan, Temilorun Gbolahan, Stephen Waterman, Gurpreet Muctor

entry.summary: GRAIDES is a lightweight open-source data schema for centralizing generative AI observability and evaluation evidence across vendors, demonstrated via a local government case study. It targets AI assurance for public-sector deployment.

entry.title: TraceView: Interactive Visualization of Agentic Program Repair Trajectories

author.name: Amirali Sajadi, Tu Nguyen, Kimmie Huynh, Esteban Parra, Preetha Chatterjee

entry.summary: Presents TraceView, an interactive tool for labeling and visualizing the reasoning/action/result trajectories of LLM-based automated program repair agents. Helps developers diagnose where agentic repair processes become repetitive or misaligned.

entry.title: From Handcrafted Features to Functional Edge Learning: Evolution of EEG Seizure Detection Frameworks

author.name: Sepideh Kheirollahi, Mohammad Rasoul Roshanshah

entry.summary: Reviews limitations of deep learning EEG seizure detection (black-box opacity, data hunger, compute cost) and explores Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks as an emerging interpretable, efficient alternative for edge/wearable deployment. Frames the evolution from handcrafted features to functional edge learning.

entry.title: On the Sparsity-Storage-Accuracy Tradeoff in Parsimoniously Activated Dictionary Learning

author.name: Zihui Zhao, Yuanbo Tang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Revisits parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (global constraint on number of activated atoms) and shows it admits an equivalent MAP formulation under a structured generative model. Analyzes the sparsity-storage-accuracy tradeoff with a probabilistic interpretation.

entry.title: EML Trees Are Universal Approximators

author.name: Joe Germany, Elie Abdo, Joseph Bakarji

entry.summary: Proves that tree-structured compositions of the EML (Exp-Minus-Log) function are universal approximators for functions in certain Sobolev spaces and proposes a learning algorithm for such trees. Establishes theoretical expressivity of a NAND-gate-like building block.

entry.title: Bayesian Model Averaging under Predictor Redundancy via Density-Ratio Posterior Compression

author.name: Hanqing Li, Xuewen Lu, Yuting Chen

entry.summary: Develops a method to report Bayesian model averaging posteriors under predictor redundancy via density-ratio compression, providing computable TV and KL distortion bounds for compressed reporting. Improves interpretability of unstable exact-support summaries.

entry.title: Accurate identification and measurement of the precipitate area by two-stage deep neural networks in novel chromium-based alloys

author.name: Zeyu Xia, Kan Ma, Sibo Cheng, Thomas Blackburn, Ziling Peng, Kewei Zhu, Weihang Zhang, Dunhui Xiao, Alexander J Knowles, Rossella Arcucci

entry.summary: Proposes DT-SegNet, a two-stage deep learning pipeline for accurate identification and measurement of precipitate area and size distribution in novel chromium-based superalloys from electron microscopy images. Replaces noise-sensitive fixed-threshold processing for materials characterization.

entry.title: Tensor Train Decomposition-based 3D Implicit Full Waveform Inversion with Multi-scale Structural Similarity

author.name: Liangsheng He, Chao Song, Tiansheng Chen, Tao Liu, Cai Liu

entry.summary: This work proposes a tensor-train-decomposition-based 3D implicit full waveform inversion framework with a multi-scale structural-similarity objective to reduce memory and computational cost while mitigating cycle skipping. It uses axis-specific implicit neural representations for the velocity model.

entry.title: A Viscosity Semigroup Framework for Stable Image Reconstruction

author.name: Arina Oberoi

entry.summary: Develops a viscosity-solution framework for multiscale image representations from degenerate elliptic-parabolic PDEs, motivating a hybrid reconstruction operator combining a learned inverse with nonlinear diffusion. Evaluated on CT-based reconstruction.

entry.title: Polynomial Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Hiroaki Aizawa

entry.summary: Proposes Polynomial Dice Loss, a Taylor-expansion-based polynomial extension of Dice Loss that allows adjusting the contribution of higher-order components, targeting data imbalance and small lesion detection in medical image segmentation. Evaluated against existing loss variants.

entry.title: Mass Conservation as an Inductive Bias for Self-Organized Criticality in NCA Reservoirs

author.name: Tong Zhang, Etienne Guichard, Sidney Pontes-Filho, Stefano Nichele

entry.summary: Investigates whether mass conservation as a local redistribution rule serves as an inductive bias toward self-organized criticality in neural cellular automata reservoirs. Evaluates on memory, MNIST, and CartPole benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning Control as Enabling Layer for Embodied Intelligence Research explored with Soft Robotic Swimming in diverse Flow Speeds

author.name: Fabian Schwab, Federico Allione, Bingcheng Wang, Mohamed El Arayshi, Claudio Mucignat, Ivan Lunati, Cristiano Verrelli, Ardian Jusufi

entry.summary: Evaluates augmenting PID control with a Linear Repetitive Learning Estimation Scheme for soft robotic swimming under varying flow speeds, recovering tracking accuracy under dynamic hydrodynamic loading. Frames learning control as an enabling layer for embodied intelligence.

entry.title: RoverDevKit: An open, physics-grounded tradespace toolkit for conceptual design of lunar micro-rovers

author.name: Jon Reifschneider

entry.summary: Contributes RoverDevKit, an open analytical evaluator coupling terramechanics, mass, power, thermal, and traverse for conceptual lunar micro-rover design that runs in 30ms per mission, enabling NSGA-II multi-objective optimization. Shows binding design trades change with mission profile.

entry.title: Semantic-Aware Autonomous Exploration for UAVs in Unknown Indoor Environments

author.name: Duc-Thien Nguyen, Ngoc Minh Do, Xiem HoangVan, Thanh Nguyen Canh

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic-aware autonomous exploration framework for indoor UAVs that augments a probabilistic-roadmap exploration planner (DEP) with a semantic layer and reward, improving exploration efficiency and environmental understanding. It addresses the lack of semantic awareness in geometry-only planners.

entry.title: Efficient Continuous Semantic Mapping based on Spatio-Temporal Awareness

author.name: My Le Pham, Dinh Trieu Duong, Xiem HoangVan, Thanh Nguyen Canh

entry.summary: Presents a continuous semantic mapping method that incorporates spatial and temporal relationships into semantic inference, adjusting inference range by local uncertainty and fusing labels over time for stability and efficiency. It is evaluated on SemanticKITTI.

entry.title: Line Drawings using LightBenders: Authoring and Illuminating

author.name: Hamed Alimohammadzadeh, Shahram Ghandeharizadeh

entry.summary: Introduces multi-target maneuver coordination for connected automated driving, allowing a vehicle to identify and select among multiple potential coordination partners rather than a single predefined target, without modifying execution logic or protocols. This expands coordination opportunities at the decision-making layer.

entry.title: A Censored Transformed Model for Proportional Outcomes with Boundary Mass and an Application to Loss Given Default Modeling

author.name: Yuan Christopher Qiang, Fabio Sigrist

entry.summary: Introduces the zero-one censored transformed normal (ZOC-TN) model for proportional responses with probability mass at the boundaries 0 and 1, combining a censored Gaussian with an affine-logit transformation. It is applied to loss-given-default modeling in credit risk and captures wider density shapes than benchmarks while remaining parsimonious.

entry.title: Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries

author.name: Ylli Prifti

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-specific protocol language for specifying human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints in AI-assisted software development. It distinguishes declared policy from structural enforcement mechanisms.

entry.title: Attractor Domain Theory: A Mathematical Framework for Cardiovascular Attractor Analysis with Wearable Photoplethysmography (PPG) Validation

author.name: Timothy Oladunni, Farouk Ganiyu Adewumi

entry.summary: Attractor Domain Theory offers a mathematical account linking which reconstructed cardiac-attractor properties capture which cardiovascular quantities, validated on wearable photoplethysmography data via Takens embedding. It aims to make nonlinear cardiac feature selection principled rather than ad hoc.

entry.title: Machine Learning Classification of Cryopathy Syndromes: A Comprehensive Comparative Study

author.name: Nataliya Shakhovska, Valentyna Chopyak, Ivan Izonin, Vira Haievska

entry.summary: A comparative machine learning study classifying 14 cryopathy syndrome categories from laboratory records of 2,686 patients, identifying practical strategies for clinical decision support amid overlapping lab patterns and rare diagnoses. Evaluates multiple ML approaches.

entry.title: Cohort Organized Learning: Clustering Through Agreement

author.name: Finn Henry O'Shea, Maria Elena Monzani

entry.summary: Cohort Organized Learning (CoOL) is a clustering method that groups data without explicit distance or similarity computations, using neural networks trained via expectation maximization to estimate clusters. It is demonstrated on vector data and images.

entry.title: Cluster-Specific Localized Drift Detection for Efficient Batch Model Adaptation under Controlled Distribution Shift

author.name: Ignacio Cabrera Martin, Marcello Trovati, Almas Baimagambetov, Nikolaos Polatidis

entry.summary: Proposes a cluster-induced distribution-shift simulation framework to convert static tabular datasets into controlled evolving streams, and systematically evaluates six drift-adaptation strategies. Addresses the lack of temporal structure in tabular benchmarks for drift research.

entry.title: DSSCNet: A Transfer Learning Framework for Cross-Corpus Dysarthric Speech Severity Classification

author.name: Arnab Kumar Roy, Hemant Kumar Kathania, Paban Sapkota, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Introduces DSSCNet, a transfer-learning model for cross-corpus dysarthric speech severity classification that pre-trains on one corpus and fine-tunes on another to improve speaker-independent generalization. Reports gains on TORGO and UA-Speech benchmarks.

entry.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Obscure Code Stylometry: A Comparative Study of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4

author.name: Saman Pordanesh, Benjamin Tan

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) can obscure code stylometry to evade authorship attribution while preserving functionality, evaluating prompt-engineering strategies against a Random Forest classifier. Investigates privacy/cybersecurity implications of LLM-driven style obfuscation.

entry.title: Enabling Cloud-Level Accuracy in Edge AI through IoT Data Preprocessing

author.name: Ayg\"un Varol, Katarzyna Ko{\l}odziej, {\L}ukasz Sobczak, Micha{\l} Romaszewski, Przemys{\l}aw G{\l}omb, Naser Hossein Motlagh, Mirka Leino, Johanna Virkki

entry.summary: Investigates whether prompt-side preprocessing of raw IoT sensor data into progressively enriched textual representations improves the accuracy-latency trade-off of compact local LLMs for environmental monitoring. Aims to bring cloud-level accuracy to edge AI by aiding weak numerical reasoning.

entry.title: BASIL: Bayesian Application for Scientific Iteration and Learning

author.name: Kelvin P. Idanwekhai, Valeriia Kaneva, Stefano Menegatti, Alexander Tropsha

entry.summary: BASIL is a user-friendly desktop application applying Bayesian optimization with specialized acquisition functions for single and multi-objective process optimization, with predefined surrogate model templates and a graphical interface. Targets accessible experimental optimization.

entry.title: Reconstructing Randomly Masked Spectra Helps DNNs Identify Discriminant Wavenumbers

author.name: Yingying Wu, Jinchao Liu, Yan Wang, Stuart Gibson, Margarita Osadchy, Yongchun Fang

entry.summary: Introduces TeaNet, a task-enhanced augmentation network that reconstructs randomly masked vibrational spectra to help deep nets identify discriminant wavenumbers under limited labeled data. Targets nondestructive detection applications in chemistry and pharmacy.

entry.title: Federated Temporal Attention Intelligence for Cyber-Resilient IoMT: Lightweight Digital Twins and PPO-Driven Honeypot Deception

author.name: Syed Zeeshan Haider, Anwar Shah, Muneeb Arif, Hamza Iftikhar, Waqas Ali

entry.summary: Presents a federated reinforcement-learning cybersecurity framework for IoMT combining temporal attention encoders, lightweight digital twins, and PPO-driven honeypot deception. Targets privacy-preserving threat defense for resource-constrained medical devices.

entry.title: QeHDC: Hyperdimensional Computing based on Quantum-enhanced binding and SuperClass Construction

author.name: Yangjie Xu, Hui Huang, Li Ning, Radu State

entry.summary: Proposes QeHDC, a quantum-enhanced hyperdimensional computing framework with one-pass training, quantum amplitude encoding, a reference-state-based quantum binding operation, and density-matrix superclass generation. Extends classical HDC with quantum mechanical properties for efficiency.

entry.title: Mitigating Measurement-Induced Training Instability in Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks for Protein Classification

author.name: Milton Mondal, Sushovan Chanda, Mohamad Mahdi Alawieh, Brijesh Sukhadiya, Donatus Krah, Clinton Gonsalves, Antonios Ntolkeras, Silvio O. Rizzoli, Ali H. Shaib

entry.summary: Identifies measurement-induced logit contraction as a source of training instability in hybrid quantum neural networks where Pauli measurements bound logits to [-1,1], suppressing gradients. Proposes a fix applied to protein classification.

entry.title: Stage-dependent integer-binary encoding in factorization-machine black-box optimization

author.name: Ryo Ogawa, Mayumi Nakano, Yuya Seki, Shu Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes stage-dependent integer-binary encoding for factorization-machine black-box optimization with Ising machines, deriving conversion formulas between one-hot and domain-wall QUBO matrices that preserve the surrogate objective. Allows different encodings for surrogate learning versus solution search.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Modeling for Wood Thermal Analysis and Prediction

author.name: Jingren Xie, Alex John Buckthal, Ryan Anthony O'Connor, Isak Worre Foged, Dim P. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Presents physics-informed deep learning frameworks integrating PDEs to predict pixel-level thermal responses of heterogeneous wood materials from RGB images and temperature maps. Aims for interpretable, thermodynamically plausible predictions versus black-box methods.

entry.title: Simulation-Free Estimation of Traffic Flows from Sparse Count Data

author.name: Davide Guastella, Gianluca Bontempi

entry.summary: Proposes a simulation-free method estimating time-varying traffic flows from sparse aggregated vehicle counts by partitioning into regions and solving a weighted least-squares route allocation problem. Evaluated on the Brussels network with real and synthetic data.

entry.title: MORL-A2C: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Reranker for Optimizing Healthiness in MOPI-HFRS

author.name: Aarya Vasantlal, Joshua Zolla

entry.summary: Introduces MORL-A2C, a multi-objective reinforcement learning reranker extending a health-aware food recommendation system to capture the sequential nature of dietary decisions. Uses frozen GNN embeddings to optimize the health-preference tradeoff.

entry.title: FPGA-Accelerated Neuromorphic Vision System for Real-Time Orbital Object Detection

author.name: Diego Hern\'andez, Sebasti\'an Valdivia, Vicente Westerhout, Esteban Vera, Daniel Yunge

entry.summary: Presents an open-source FPGA-accelerated neuromorphic vision system using an event-based camera for real-time orbital object detection, achieving 97% accuracy on night-sky data. Targets space situational awareness for orbital congestion.

entry.title: CuratorKIT : Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation for LLM Post-Training

author.name: Soham Bhattacharjee, Karun Sharma, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth

entry.summary: Presents CuratorKIT, an open-source Python library unifying ingestion, deduplication, synthetic generation, and quality filtering for LLM post-training data curation in a single configurable pipeline. Adds provenance tracking and hallucination verification for auditability.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Computing the Morse Index of the Critical Catenoid

author.name: Miraj Samarakkody

entry.summary: Tests how faithfully a physics-informed neural network reproduces the Jacobi-Steklov spectrum and Morse index of the critical catenoid, a problem with a known closed-form answer. The parity-enforcing network recovers eigenvalues to 1e-6 accuracy.

entry.title: Continuous Behavioral Authentication via Multi-Expert BERT Log Analysis for Secure Data Sharing

author.name: Stergios Lantzos, Ilias Syrigos, Apostolos Apostolaras, Thanasis Korakis

entry.summary: Presents a multi-expert BERT framework for continuous behavioral authentication from Android system logs, fusing expert models for network identity, battery timing, and Wi-Fi topology into a normality score for a policy decision point. Targets zero-trust mobile security.

entry.title: Convergence Analysis of Nystr\"om Subsampling in Covariate Shift Adaptation for Misspecified case

author.name: Hanna Myleiko, Sergei Solodky, Vasyl Semenov

entry.summary: This paper derives high-probability excess-risk bounds for regularized Nystrom subsampling applied to covariate-shift domain adaptation in the misspecified (low-smoothness) regime where the target lies outside the RKHS. It extends the analysis to settings where the density ratio between source and target marginals must be estimated.

entry.title: Deep material network for homogenization of piezoelectric composites

author.name: Ting-Ju Wei, Yen-Ming Lu, Chuin-Shan Chen

entry.summary: This paper proposes a piezoelectric deep material network that embeds electromechanical homogenization relations into the architecture to efficiently predict effective properties of two-phase piezoelectric composites. It aims to replace costly direct numerical simulation in multiscale design.

entry.title: SuperCond-GNN: Scalable Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Superconducting Circuit Simulations

author.name: Nandana Menon, Giorgio Vallone

entry.summary: SuperCond-GNN is a graph-neural-network surrogate predicting voltage distributions in high-temperature superconducting magnets modeled as lumped-element circuits, learning electrical response from topology, materials, and operating current. It achieves low error and fast inference within its design space.

entry.title: Beyond ROC-AUC: Operating-Point Performance Reporting for Biometric Verification

author.name: Ajan Ahmed, Masudul H. Imtiaz

entry.summary: Argues for operating-point performance reporting in biometric verification following ISO/IEC standards rather than threshold-independent summaries like ROC-AUC or EER. Advocates DET curves and uncertainty intervals at stated operating points.

entry.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Exploring Query-Based Segmentation and Increased Spatial Context for Outdoor Scene Understanding

author.name: David Pascual-Hern\'andez, Roberto Calvo-Palomino, Inmaculada Mora-Jim\'enez, Jose Mar\'ia Ca\~nas-Plaza

entry.summary: Technical report for the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D fine-grained segmentation challenge, improving from SegFormer baseline through larger crops, Mask2Former query-based architecture, and test-time augmentation. Demonstrates query-based segmentation advantages for outdoor scenes.

entry.title: A Controlled Study of CLIP-Based Body-Scene Fusion for Emotion Recognition in Context

author.name: Zubair Abbas, Muhammad Umair, Muqaddas Hameed

entry.summary: A controlled study of CLIP-based body-scene fusion for context-aware emotion recognition on EMOTIC, examining whether context-debiasing techniques still help after adding a CLIP scene encoder. Combines ResNet body stream with CLIP scene stream.

entry.title: Curvature-aware 3D length estimation of greenhouse cucumbers using RGB-D imaging and cubic spline arc-length integration

author.name: Manveen Kaur, Rajmeet Singh, Saeed Mozaffri, Shahpour Alirezaee

entry.summary: Presents CucumberVision, a non-contact RGB-D framework for curvature-aware 3D length estimation of greenhouse cucumbers using YOLO26 segmentation, SAM refinement, and cubic spline arc-length integration. Compares five measurement methods for agricultural grading.

entry.title: Biological Sex Determination in Cadavers Using Deep Learning Algorithms from Computed Tomography Images of Pelvis and Skull

author.name: Giovanna Herculano Tormena, Davi Nascimento Ara\'ujo, Germano Coimbra Soares de Carvalho, Gustavo Bruno Centenaro, Rafael Janowski Pozzer, Rodrigo Akira Azevedo Kurosawa, Danilo Aires Alves, Filipe Thiago Xavier de Campos, Pedro Henrique Macedo dos Santos, Pedro Augusto Prado Mota, Ricardo V. Godoy, Jo\~ao Manoel Herrera Pinheiro, Marcelo Becker

entry.summary: Evaluates state-of-the-art deep learning models with transfer learning to determine biological sex from forensic CT scans of pelvis and skull in 141 cadavers, using 2D profile projections of 3D reconstructions. Targets forensic identification of decomposed remains.

entry.title: Scene-agnostic ALS boresight self-calibration

author.name: Aur\'elien Brun, Jan Skaloud

entry.summary: Presents a scene-agnostic ALS (airborne laser scanning) boresight self-calibration method that replaces plane-based constraints with automatic point-to-point correspondences from overlapping strips. Enables boresight recovery within routine mapping missions.

entry.title: AwakeForest: An Interactive Geospatial Platform for Large-Scale Forest Imagery

author.name: Suraj Prasai, Kangning Cui, Rongkun Zhu, Sarra Alqahtani, Ying Zhang, Victor Paul Pauca, Miles R. Silman, Fan Yang

entry.summary: Presents AwakeForest, an interactive geospatial platform integrating model-assisted inference, automatic annotation, and human-in-the-loop refinement for large-scale forest imagery analysis. Provides a cloud-optimized, ML-integrated end-to-end workflow.

entry.title: Soliton-like Waves in a Two-Dimensional Recurrent Spiking Neural Network with Weighted Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity

author.name: Ch. Meessen

entry.summary: Constructs a biologically plausible 2D recurrent spiking network with weighted STDP and divisive normalization that spontaneously produces stable self-propagating soliton-like wave packets. Explores emergent dissipative-soliton dynamics in neural systems.

entry.title: Multi-Level Resistive Synapses for On-Chip Neural Networks: A Physics-Based Design of a Memristive Crossbar Fabric with Quasi-Continuous Conductance States

author.name: David Alejandro Trejo Pizzo

entry.summary: Presents a physics-based design of a memristive crossbar fabric with quasi-continuous conductance states for on-chip neural networks, deriving in-situ analog learning rules under noise and wire resistance. Single-author hardware modeling work.

entry.title: A Human-Inspired Thumb-Index Robotic Hand with Strain Gauges Embedded in Soft Joints

author.name: Jonas Papenbrock, Shubhan Patni, Tomaso Lisini Baldi, Michele Guerri, Elia Landi, Ada Fort, Matej Hoffmann

entry.summary: Develops STIR Hand, a minimal low-cost two-digit underactuated robotic hand with strain gauges embedded in soft joints for passive grasp adaptation and proprioception. Demonstrates object classification across 20 objects.

entry.title: Dynamics, stability, and energy efficiency of an energy-recycling rimless wheel with spring-clutch legs

author.name: Tongchen Lin, Yanqiu Zheng, Chuhan Zhang, Ruigang Chen, Yizhar Or, Mingyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-recycling rimless wheel with spring-clutch legs that stores impact-induced elastic energy and reinjects it in the next gait cycle, developing a hybrid dynamic model and showing up to 16% reduction in cost of transport. Analyzes dynamics, stability, and efficiency.

entry.title: RoboLineage: Agent-Native Data Lifecycle Governance Across Robot Policy Iterations

author.name: Qian Luo, Wentao Guo, Zhennan Qin, Nanchun Guo, Yunhan Zhao, Yi Ma, Yanchao Yang

entry.summary: RoboLineage is a data-lifecycle governance system that makes the rollout-review-retrain-evaluate-deploy loop explicit through typed lineage artifacts interpreted by agents. It targets reproducibility and traceability across robot policy iterations rather than new model capabilities.

entry.title: A Relaxed Quadratic-Program-based Framework for Trajectory Tracking of Unicycle Robots with Singularity Avoidance

author.name: Hamza Tariq, Usman Ali, Adeel Akhtar

entry.summary: Proposes a relaxed quadratic-program-based optimal control framework for unicycle trajectory tracking that avoids the velocity-vanishing singularity of dynamic feedback linearization using slack variables, while proving local Lipschitz continuity of the feedback law. It enables stop-and-reverse maneuvers.

entry.title: Machine-Coached Policy Revision in Adaptive Agent-Based Regulatory Simulation: A Controller-Level Contestability Layer

author.name: Roberto Garrone

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight machine-coached policy-revision layer that feeds simulation diagnostics back into adaptive regulatory controllers using defeasible rules with explicit priorities and explanations. Aims to make policy controllers contestable rather than only analyzing trajectories ex post.

entry.title: How Well Do Self-Supervised Speech Models Encode Age and Gender in Children's Speech? A Layer-Wise Analysis Across Multiple Architectures

author.name: Abhijit Sinha, Hemant Kumar Kathania, Mohit Joshi, Harishankar Kumar, Shrikanth Narayanan, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri

entry.summary: Conducts a layer-wise analysis across four self-supervised speech models of how well they encode age and gender in children's speech, which differs substantially from adult speech. Reveals where speaker attributes are captured in challenging child-speech domains.

entry.title: A Hybrid, Multi-Layered Pipeline for Phishing and Threat Classification: Independently Validated URL and NLP Engines with a Calibrated Multi-Channel Fusion Stage

author.name: Saifelden M. Ismail, Aser O. Ibrahim, Omar A. Mahmoud

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid multi-layered phishing detection pipeline with independently benchmarked URL, NLP (DistilBERT), and threat-intelligence engines fused via calibrated multi-channel fusion, reaching F1 of 0.914.
