author.name: Ayush Dwivedi, Qixin Wang, Ashvi Soni, Ruoteng Wang, Han Li, Animesh Mahapatra, Neeraj Agrawal, Xintao Wu

entry.summary: SAFE-Cascade is an interactive cost-adaptive system for chart question answering that first attempts OCR plus a text-only language model, then uses a learned router to decide whether to escalate to an expensive VLM. It exposes the routing decision and cost estimates to users.

entry.title: WorkBenchMark: A LEGO-Based Assembly Benchmark with an Assembly-by-Disassembly Baseline for the Smart Manufacturing League

author.name: Wenbo Ma, Daniel Swoboda, Matteo Tschesche, Till Hofmann

entry.summary: WorkBenchMark is a LEGO Duplo-based robotic assembly benchmark with 400 tasks across four complexity tiers, motivated by the RoboCup Smart Manufacturing League, with an Assembly-by-Disassembly planning baseline. The planning pipeline outperforms a modern vision-language-action approach across all tiers.

entry.title: pdSTL: Probabilistic Differentiable Signal Temporal Logic for Stochastic Systems

author.name: Bennett Dogbey, Hemanth Manjunatha

entry.summary: pdSTL is a probabilistic differentiable Signal Temporal Logic framework that unifies probabilistic semantics with differentiable robustness over belief trajectories for stochastic robotic systems. It uses interval-valued probabilistic semantics for conservative satisfaction bounds.

entry.title: CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation

author.name: Ziyuan Tang, Chenxi Xiao*

entry.summary: CoLI is an open-source reproducible platform for continuum robot learning featuring monolithic multi-material 3D printing for simplified fabrication and an isomorphic teleoperation interface for intuitive control. It addresses reproducibility barriers from complex fabrication and modeling.

entry.title: Agents are under-elicited: A case study in optimization tasks

author.name: zef

entry.summary: An empirical study showing that in LLM optimization tasks (inverse rubric optimization, where an agent learns a black-box judge's preferences under a label budget), agents are under-elicited by default and simple prompt and scaffold interventions roughly double performance. The gains come from improving both resource usage and per-resource effectiveness.

entry.title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability

author.name: Geon Kim, Dara Ron, Sukhdeep Singh, Suyog Moogi, Pranshav Gajjar, V V N K Someswara Rao Koduri, Een Kee Hong, Vijay K. Shah

entry.summary: Proposes TelcoAgent, a foundation-model framework for forecasting multiple 5G key performance measurements across diverse network cells without site-specific training, with a three-agent pipeline that builds a 3GPP knowledge graph from specs for explainability. Targets scalable, explainable network management.

entry.title: PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation

author.name: Zhangzhao Liang, Xiaofen Xing, Mingyue Yang, Wenlve Zhou, Xiangmin Xu

entry.summary: Identifies an embodiment gap in humanoid co-speech motion generation where human-centric pipelines generated in SMPL-X and retargeted to robots compress motion diversity and weaken prosody alignment. Proposes PhysDrift to bridge human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints for physically executable gestures.

entry.title: Sign-Language Datasets at Scale: A Comprehensive Survey on Resources, Benchmarks, and Annotation Standards

author.name: Yiming Ni, Zhi-Qi Cheng, Jiayu Li, Wei Cheng

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey indexing 120 sign-language datasets across 35 sign languages, analyzing challenges like modality imbalance, annotation granularity, and signer bias, and proposing a 24-field standard. It addresses fragmentation that limits progress in sign-language recognition and translation.

entry.title: Protein Representation Learning with Secondary-Structure and Energy-Filtered Hydrogen-Bond Graphs

author.name: Mohamed Mouhajir, Limei Wang, El Houcine Bergou, Hajar El Hammouti, Lamiae Azizi, Dongqi Fu

entry.summary: Introduces a secondary-structure-aware graph neural network for protein representation that builds graph edges from energy-filtered hydrogen-bond interactions rather than mere sequence adjacency or geometric proximity. Better reflects protein folding principles.

entry.title: JustDiag!: A Diagnostic Justification Engine for Accountable Root Cause Analysis

author.name: Tingzhu Bi, Xinrui Jiang, Xun Zhang, Pengcheng Su, Congjie He, Jinglin Li, Ping Wang, Meng Ma

entry.summary: Presents JustDiag, a diagnostic justification engine for root-cause analysis that maintains explicit process state over evidence, hypotheses, conflicts, and next checks, evaluated on 66 real incidents with separate final-answer and process quality scoring. Targets accountability gaps where fluent LLM answers lack supporting reasoning.

entry.title: Latent Confounded Causal Discovery via Lie Bracket Geometry

author.name: Sridhar Mahadevan

entry.summary: Introduces two causal discovery algorithms under latent confounding building on Kan-Do-Calculus, using Lie bracket geometry where Frobenius residuals of causal vector fields witness failed integrability and possible latent confounders. Highly theoretical category-theoretic and information-geometric framing.

entry.title: Before the Pull Request: Mining Multi-Agent Coordination

author.name: Dipankar Sarkar

entry.summary: Studies multi-agent coordination before pull requests via grite, an open-source serverless coordination substrate storing signed event logs in git, capturing how concurrent agents claim and collide over shared work. Shows duplicate/conflicting work dropping from 78% to 0% at bounded overhead.

entry.title: SL-S4Wave: Self-Supervised Learning of Physiological Waveforms with Structured State Space Models

author.name: Feng Wu, Harsh Deep, Eric Lehman, Sanyam Kapoor, Guoshuai Zhao, Rahul Krishnan, Gari Clifford, Li-wei H Lehman

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised learning framework using structured state space models (S4) tailored to multichannel physiological waveforms like ECG, capturing long-range dependencies and noise invariance. Targets the scarcity of labeled long medical time series.

entry.title: Hybrid Diffusion Transformer for Instruction-Guided Audio Editing via Rectified Flow

author.name: Liting Gao, Yonggang Zhu, Yaru Chen, Dongyu Wang, Shubin Zhang, Zhenbo Li, Jean-Yves Guillemaut, Wenwu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid diffusion transformer with rectified flow for instruction-guided audio editing, improving long-range semantic alignment and instruction localization over U-Net-based approaches. Aims to modify targeted audio content while preserving surrounding acoustics.

entry.title: FlowMaps: Modeling Long-Term Multimodal Object Dynamics with Flow Matching

author.name: Francesco Argenziano, Miguel Saavedra-Ruiz, Sacha Morin, Charlie Gauthier, Daniele Nardi, Liam Paull

entry.summary: Introduces FlowMaps, which models long-term multimodal object dynamics in household environments using flow matching to capture spatio-temporally consistent patterns of object locations driven by human routines. Helps robots associate current observations with previously seen objects for navigation.

entry.title: Multi-View Decompilation for LLM-Based Malware Classification

author.name: Bercan Turkmen, Vyas Raina

entry.summary: Shows that providing multiple decompiler views (Ghidra and RetDec) of the same binary improves LLM-based malware classification compared to single-view pipelines, since decompilers are lossy and expose different artifacts. Curates a benchmark of benign and malicious programs across threat behaviors.

entry.title: FreeStyle: Free Control of Style-Content Dual-Reference Generation from Community LoRA Mining

author.name: Jinghong Lan, Wei Cheng, Yunuo Chen, Ziqi Ye, Peng Xing, Yixiao Fang, Rui Wang, Yufeng Yang, Xuanyang Zhang, Xianfang Zeng, Difan Zou, Gang Yu, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FreeStyle, a scalable framework for style-content dual-reference image generation that mines community LoRAs as compositional anchors to construct clean triplet training data avoiding semantic leakage from style references. Addresses the bottleneck of large-scale data with clean content-style separation.

entry.title: Interactive Pareto navigation for deep multi-task learning

author.name: Augustina C. Amakor, Konstantin Sonntag, Sebastian Peitz

entry.summary: Introduces Preference Pareto Exploration, an interactive framework for deep multi-task learning that enforces decision-maker preferences while accounting for the geometry of the Pareto set. It aims to avoid the failures of naive weighted-sum loss aggregation in expensive deep learning settings.

entry.title: Comparative Study of Neural Surrogate Architectures for Autoregressive Prediction of Internal Battery States

author.name: Gihyun Lee, Thorben Menne, Simon Olma, Jakob Hilgert, Sangyoung Park

entry.summary: Systematically compares four neural surrogate architectures (MLP, ResNet, U-Net, FNO) as autoregressive state-transition operators for predicting internal lithium-ion battery states from the Doyle-Fuller-Newman model. Focuses on learning generalizable state-evolution dynamics rather than condition-specific approximations for real-time deployment.

entry.title: PU-UNet: Stable Multiplicative Interactions for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Ziyuan Li, Osamah Sufyan, Uwe Jaekel, Babette Dellen

entry.summary: Proposes PU-UNet, a residual U-Net integrating stable product-unit residual blocks that explicitly model multiplicative feature interactions via smooth positivity mapping and log-domain clipping for numerical stability. Demonstrates improved medical image segmentation on multiple datasets.

entry.title: Clusters are All You Need: Pre-Training the Tsetlin Machine with Semantic Clusters from Language Models for Interpretability

author.name: Jiechao Gao, Rohan Kumar Yadav, Yuangang Li, Yuandong Pan, Jie Wang, Ying Liu, Michael Lepech

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic pre-training framework that transfers knowledge from pretrained language models into an interpretable Tsetlin Machine without using embeddings, by grouping text into semantic clusters (K-means/Top2Vec) and pre-training with enhanced Type I feedback. The TM learns interpretable semantic keywords for transparent text classification.

entry.title: VFACamou: View-Fused Adversarial Camouflage for Environment-Adaptive Physical Evasion

author.name: Shihui Yan, Hu Liu, Junyu Shi, Zihui Zhu, Ziqi Zhou, Yufei Song, Youming Geng, Minghui Li, Shengshan Hu

entry.summary: VFACamou is an end-to-end framework generating wearable adversarial camouflage that remains effective under UAV reconnaissance with changing viewpoints, poses, and lighting. It integrates UV-volume rendering with a diffusion-based texture generator.

entry.title: Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder for Endoscopic Videos

author.name: Ivan De Boi, Xinxing Shi, Xiaoyu Jiang, Tim J. M. Jaspers, Francisco Caetano, Mauricio A. Alvarez, Fons van der Sommen, Sam Van der Jeught

entry.summary: This work introduces a Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder for endoscopic video restoration, replacing the factorized latent prior with a temporal GP prior to interpolate missing frames and handle corruptions with uncertainty. It exploits temporal continuity for clinical video quality.

entry.title: ReA-OVCD: Reliability-Aware Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Semantic and Spatial Refinement

author.name: Hongming Zhu, Huaji Chen, Bowen Du, Sicong Liu, Qin Liu

entry.summary: ReA-OVCD is a training-free reliability-aware open-vocabulary change detection framework that derives candidate change regions from pixel-wise semantic discrepancies then refines them semantically and spatially. It addresses the trade-off between instance-level and pixel-level change modeling in remote sensing.

entry.title: JanusMesh: Fast and Zero-Shot 3D Visual Illusion Generation via Cross-Space Denoising

author.name: Siang-Ling Zhang, Huai-Hsun Cheng, Tsung-Ju Yang, Yu-Lun Liu

entry.summary: JanusMesh is a fast, training-free framework for generating 3D visual illusions, single meshes that show different semantics from different viewing angles, via cross-space dual-branch denoising. It avoids the slowness and oversaturation of optimization-based methods.

entry.title: DiffusionVS: A Generative Framework for Robust Visual Servoing Based on Diffusion Policy

author.name: Hongkang Cui, Rui He, Haoyao Chen

entry.summary: DiffusionVS applies Diffusion Policy to visual servoing, generating camera velocities through conditional denoising of action sequences to reduce trajectory jitter from noise-sensitive single-step regression. It adds online adaptation to overcome static-dataset generalization limits.

entry.title: VFILC: Accurate Frequency Extrapolations in Imitation Learning via Sampling Frequency ILC

author.name: Nozomu Masuya, Toshiaki Tsuji, Sho Sakaino

entry.summary: VFILC combines variable-frequency imitation learning with iterative learning control (feedforward and feedback) to accurately extrapolate to speeds beyond the trained velocity range without frequency errors. It addresses the open-loop limitations of prior variable-frequency imitation learning.

entry.title: Mobile Target Search with Imperfect Perception: A Partially Observable Stochastic Game Theoretical Approach

author.name: Hanzheng Zhang, Shu Liang, Shuyu Liu

entry.summary: This work models mobile target search under imperfect perception (sensor limits, jamming, noise) as a partially observable stochastic game, generalizing POMDPs to incorporate target intelligence. It introduces a detectability concept and provides sufficient conditions guaranteeing eventual detection.

entry.title: Confidence-Aware Automated Assessment of Student-Drawn Scientific Models

author.name: Luyang Fang, Yingchuan Zhang, Jongchan Park, Zhaoji Wang, Ping Ma, Xiaoming Zhai

entry.summary: Studies automated scoring of student-drawn scientific models using a Vision Transformer with parameter-efficient adaptation and a confidence-aware framework that derives response-level confidence from test-time predictive distributions. Enables selective automation by deferring low-confidence cases to human experts.

entry.title: RIVET: Robust Idempotent Voice Attribute Editing

author.name: Dareen Alharthi, Bhuvan Koduru, Rita Singh, Bhiksha Raj

entry.summary: Introduces RIVET, a voice attribute editing framework that uses an idempotency objective as an implicit regularizer to improve robustness to noisy or inconsistent attribute labels in large speech datasets. Stabilizes edits of characteristics like age and gender while preserving identity.

entry.title: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards Efficient and Faithful Visual State Space Models

author.name: Jindi Lv, Aoyu Li, Yuhao Zhou, Zheng Zhu, Xiaofeng Wang, Qing Ye, Yueqi Duan, Wentao Feng, Jiancheng Lv

entry.summary: Proposes STORM, a spatial-aware token reduction framework for Mamba-based visual models that preserves grid topology and neighborhood coherence to avoid performance collapse under compression. Addresses a specific failure mode of token reduction in visual state space models.

entry.title: Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models for Event-Based Burst-Suppression Detection in ICU

author.name: Elisa Vasta, Thorir Mar Ingolfsson, Andrea Cossettini, Luca Benini, Tilman Beck, Emanuela Keller, Una Pale

entry.summary: First evaluation of EEG foundation models for event-based burst-suppression detection in ICU EEG without patient-specific calibration, comparing several foundation models against an adaptive thresholding baseline. Probes whether general EEG foundation models transfer to a clinically important sedation-monitoring task.

entry.title: Dual-Agent Framework for Cross-Model Verified Translation of Natural-Language Protocols into Robotic Laboratory Platform

author.name: Hyeonna Choi, Jung Yup Kim, Hyuneui Lim, Seunggyu Jeon

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-agent framework translating natural-language biological lab protocols into executable control commands for robotic microplate platforms, using a parser agent and rule-based mapping with cross-model verification. Bridges the semantic gap between human protocols and lab automation.

entry.title: Repurposing a Speech Classifier for Guided Diffusion-Based Speech Generation

author.name: Rostislav Makarov, Timo Gerkmann

entry.summary: Repurposes a conventionally trained, frozen noise-conditioned speech classifier as the backbone for guided diffusion-based speech generation by attaching a lightweight subnetwork trained with denoising score matching. Removes the need for a separately trained diffusion model in classifier guidance.

entry.title: Sovereign Execution Brokers: Enforcing Certificate-Bound Authority in Agentic Control Planes

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Introduces the Sovereign Execution Broker, a runtime enforcement boundary that verifies certificate-bound authority at the moment of mutation in agentic control planes, ensuring requested actions match certified execution contracts within validity windows. Provides a mandatory enforcement point separate from non-deterministic reasoning.

entry.title: Structuring and Tokenizing Distributed User Interest Context for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Ruizhong Qiu, Yinglong Xia, Dongqi Fu, Hanqing Zeng, Ren Chen, Xiangjun Fan, Hong Li, Hong Yan, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: Proposes structuring and tokenizing distributed user-interest context for generative recommendation, overcoming scalability and locality limits of graph-based integration and heuristic semantic tokenization. Aims to jointly inject user-behavioral and item-semantic context into recommendation models.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Contrastive Learning for Implicit Earth Embeddings via Location Tying

author.name: Jonathan Hecht, Lukas Arzoumanidis, Ziyue Li, Youness Dehbi

entry.summary: Proposes two multimodal contrastive learning architectures (MELT and SALT) that extend location encoder pre-training beyond two modalities using unpaired geospatial data. Both match the strongest two-modality baseline across four downstream tasks while incorporating additional modalities.

entry.title: One-Shot Novel View and Pose Human Image Synthesis via 3D Prior Guided Diffusion Model

author.name: Shenjian Gong, Kangkan Wang, Shanshan Zhang, Jian Yang

entry.summary: This paper proposes a 3D-prior-guided conditional diffusion model for one-shot novel view and pose human image synthesis, addressing limitations of 2D-keypoint pose transfer and generalizable human NeRFs for occluded parts. It divides the denoising into view and pose handling.

entry.title: OTCHA: Optimal Transport-driven Confidence-aware Latent Hub Alignment for Multi-View Medical Image Classification

author.name: Jiwoong Yang, Haejun Chung, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: OTCHA is an optimal-transport-based confidence-aware latent hub alignment module for multi-view medical image classification, using learnable shared hub tokens to refine and align patch tokens before fusion. It mitigates contamination from view-specific artifacts and background cues.

entry.title: Vision-Reasoning-Guided Occlusion Removal from Light Fields

author.name: Mohamed Youssef, Oliver Bimber

entry.summary: This work proposes a vision-reasoning-guided light field occlusion removal framework combining light field integration with vision-language models as a conditional semantic prior to recover scenes occluded by dense foreground vegetation. It targets occlusion-robust computational imaging.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Superpixel Graph Transformer with Metadata for Skin Lesion Classification

author.name: Muhammad Azeem, Tanveer Hussain, Amr Ahmed, Ardhendu Behera

entry.summary: WeGenBench is a multidimensional diagnostic benchmark of 4,000 bilingual (Chinese/English) prompts across two categories for comprehensive evaluation of text-to-image generation capabilities. It aims to reveal model deficiencies in specific categories better than existing benchmarks.

entry.title: Route-Constrained Robust Fusion Estimation for MEMS/GNSS Integrated Navigation of Unmanned Ground Vehicles in GNSS Degraded Environments

author.name: Jingzhi Cui, Chao Zhang, Yuliang Mao, Shaolin L\"u, Dongmei Li, Huan Che, Rong Zhang

entry.summary: This paper proposes a robust route-constrained state estimation method for MEMS/GNSS integrated navigation of unmanned ground vehicles under GNSS-denied conditions, matching dead-reckoning trajectories to HD map route segments as pseudo-position observations in an EKF. It mitigates cumulative localization drift in structured road environments.

entry.title: Towards 3D karst underwater scene reconstruction from rotating sonar data

author.name: Georgios Evangelos Margaritis, Lionel Lapierre, Simon Rohou, Zhi Yan, Andreas N\"uchter, Fran\c{c}ois Goulette

entry.summary: This work presents a pipeline for reconstructing 3D underwater karst conduits from sparse, noisy rotating sonar data, combining continuous-time SLAM for drift correction with a two-stage deep learning surface reconstruction method. It produces navigable 3D meshes for hydrogeological analysis.

entry.title: Vulnerabilities and exploits: where are we headed?

author.name: tchauvin

entry.summary: A follow-up analysis, building on work co-authored with Epoch AI, examining where AI-driven vulnerability discovery and exploit development are headed, arguing the field will shift from sparse to dense sampling and that defense will eventually dominate but with a bumpy 2026-2027 transition due to slow patching. It distinguishes offline versus online exploitation and identifies offense-dominant dynamics.

entry.title: REVEAL++: Differentiable Phenotypic Grouping for Vision-Language Retinal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Risk

author.name: Ethan Elio Meidinger, Seowung Leem, Zeyun Zhao, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Extends the REVEAL vision-language framework for predicting Alzheimer's risk from retinal images by replacing hard phenotypic grouping with a differentiable soft grouping that couples group formation to representation learning. Aims to improve contrastive multi-positive supervision.

entry.title: Augmenting Game AI with Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alessandro Sestini, Joakim Bergdahl, Amir Baghi, Jean-Philippe Barrette-LaPierre, Florian Fuchs, Linus Gissl\'en

entry.summary: Explores augmenting traditional hand-coded game AI with deep reinforcement learning to produce more believable, human-like in-game characters by learning from game interaction or player data. Argues behavioral complexity is hard to capture with hand-coded systems and immersion suffers as a result.

entry.title: Detecting Hallucinations for Large Language Model-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Xinyan Zhu, Yaoqi Liu, Yue Gao, Huadong Ma, Cheng Yang, Chuan Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a hallucination detection method for LLM-based knowledge graph reasoning that leverages KG structural information, which prior methods (internal-state or context-consistency based) overlook. Aims to make KG-grounded QA and decision support more reliable.

entry.title: ProMUSE: Progressive Multi-modal Uncertainty-guided Staged Evidential Alzheimer Disease Classification

author.name: Long Doan, Branden Chen, Ethan Litton, Huan Huang, Jiajing Huang, Yixin Xie, Weihua Zhou, Nandakumar Narayanan, Chen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes ProMUSE, a progressive multimodal evidential network for Alzheimer's classification that adaptively decides when costly modalities (MRI, PET) are needed, using uncertainty to reduce overall diagnostic cost. Targets practical clinical workflows with incomplete modalities.

entry.title: Concept Flow Models: Anchoring Concept-Based Reasoning with Hierarchical Bottlenecks

author.name: Ya Wang, Adrian Paschke

entry.summary: Proposes Concept Flow Models replacing the flat concept bottleneck with a hierarchical concept-driven decision tree to reduce information leakage that undermines interpretability as concept count approaches embedding dimension. Improves concept-based reasoning fidelity.

entry.title: VCG: A Multimodal Retrieval Framework for E-Commerce Video Feeds under Extreme Cold-Start Conditions

author.name: Katya Mirylenka, Egor Malykh, Mahdyar Ravanbakhsh, Michael Gygli, Marco-Andrea Buchmann, Andrew Dzhoha, Svitlana Borzenko, Francesca Catino, Mohamed Gaafar, Maarten Versteegh, Thomas Kober, Dario d'Andrea, Ellie Langhans

entry.summary: Demonstrates VCG, a scalable multimodal retrieval system using a domain-adapted CLIP-based vision-language model to map users and short-form e-commerce videos into a shared semantic space, solving extreme cold-start and position/duration bias problems. Enables zero-shot retrieval for new videos lacking interaction history.

entry.title: Before the Labels: How Dataset Construction Shapes Suicidality Detection in Clinical Text

author.name: Priyanshi Garg, Ishita Rao, Jieqiong Ding, Amandalynne Paullada

entry.summary: Critically examines how construction choices (ICD-based cohort selection, single-annotator labeling, hospital-stay aggregation) in EHR-based suicidality datasets like ScAN encode particular operationalizations of suicidality. Argues clinical documentation is not neutral ground truth.

entry.title: Library-Aware Doubles and Iterative Repair for Large Language Model-Generated Unit Tests in OpenSIL Firmware

author.name: Ma Toan Bach, Yuchi Zheng, Haingo Razafindranto, Tanvir Alam, Aric Leather, Ranveer Sandhu, Jitesh Arora

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-guided multi-agent pipeline for authoring unit tests for AMD's OpenSIL low-level C firmware, using library-aware stubs/mocks/fakes and an iterative compile-dispatch repair loop driven by build logs and coverage feedback. Reduces manual effort in fragile firmware test creation.

entry.title: Co-policy: Responsive Human-Robot Co-Creation for Musical Performances

author.name: Xuetao Li, Wenke Huang, Mang Ye, Zijian Liu, Jinhua Xie, Jifeng Xuan, Miao Li

entry.summary: Presents Co-policy, a framework for real-time human-robot musical co-creation that separates semantic intent grounding (via a fine-tuned Qwen-VL planner), constrained musical variation, and visuomotor execution. Connects high-level musical understanding to physically executable robotic performance.

entry.title: SIMBA: ABidirectional Retrieval Forward Simulation Framework for Modeling FY-4A GIIRS Hyperspectral Infrared Radiances Toward NWP Applications

author.name: Jingdong Shen, Fu Wang*, Qifeng Lu, Hao Huang, Chunqiang Wu, Chi Yang, Xiaofang Liu

entry.summary: Presents SIMBA, a bidirectional retrieval-and-forward-simulation framework for modeling FY-4A GIIRS hyperspectral infrared radiances, jointly performing atmospheric profile retrieval and radiance reconstruction for numerical weather prediction. Enforces consistency between atmospheric state and observation spaces.

entry.title: See-and-Reach: Precise Vision-Language Navigation for UAVs within the Field of View

author.name: Fanfu Xue, En Yu, Yantian Shen, Zhikun Hu, Hongjun Wang, Yang Yang, Xindi Wang, Jiande Sun

entry.summary: Introduces UAV-VLN-FOV, a target-visible navigation task isolating the final see-and-reach stage of UAV vision-language navigation, plus 3DG-VLN, a waypoint prediction framework for precise 3D motion toward visible targets. Enables more diagnostic evaluation of terminal reaching ability.

entry.title: Editorial Alignment: A Participatory Approach to Engaging Editorial Expertise in LLM-mediated Knowledge Dissemination

author.name: Simon Aagaard Enni, Malthe Stavning Erslev, Karl-Emil Kj{\ae}r Bilstrup, Kristoffer Laigaard Nielbo

entry.summary: Investigates editorial alignment as a participatory design practice for re-aligning LLM interfaces to editorial standards, through workshops building an LLM-enabled encyclopedia with a Nordic public knowledge institution. Addresses how commercial pretrained values clash with public editorial authority.

entry.title: Weibull Weight-Scale Parameter Evolution under AdamW Training Dynamics

author.name: Tiexin Ding

entry.summary: Analyzes why the Weibull weight-scale parameter rises, overshoots, and relaxes during AdamW training by decomposing the squared weight norm into alignment, injection, and decay forces, finding alignment dominates the rise phase on Pythia-70M models. Provides a mechanistic view of weight distribution evolution under AdamW.

entry.title: Spectral Retrieval-Augmented Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Huu Hiep Nguyen, Minh Hoang Nguyen, Dung Nguyen, Hung Le

entry.summary: SpecReTF is a retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting method that addresses spectral blindness and temporal recency by incorporating frequency-domain characteristics and weighting recent patterns. It improves retrieval of relevant historical patterns for non-stationary forecasting.

entry.title: Exploring the potential of AlphaEarth and TESSERA embeddings for Fine-scale Local Climate Zone Mapping: A case study across five cities in Switzerland

author.name: Htet Yamin Ko Ko, Clement Atzberger

entry.summary: Compares precomputed AlphaEarth and TESSERA geospatial embeddings against Sentinel-1/2 composites for upscaling coarse local climate zone maps to 10-meter resolution across five Swiss cities using an attention-based U-Net. Assesses multi-city transferability, reference-resolution impact, and temporal robustness.

entry.title: Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using a Multimodal Approach with 3D MRI and PET

author.name: Loukas Ilias, Anthi-Maria Vozinaki, Christos Ntanos, Dimitris Askounis

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal Alzheimer's diagnosis approach fusing 3D MRI and PET that moves beyond static concatenation and uniform per-subject computation to handle patient and site heterogeneity. Aims for robust early detection at the mild cognitive impairment stage.

entry.title: Computational Methods and Challenges in Cell-Free DNA Analysis for Multi-Cancer Early Detection

author.name: Nicko Starkey, Marcin W. Wojewodzic, Krzysztof Rzecki

entry.summary: Reviews computational methods from 2022 to 2025 for cell-free DNA-based multi-cancer early detection, covering fragmentomics and epigenetic feature extraction, classical ML, and deep learning approaches like autoencoders. Discusses biological interpretability and validation challenges for each method.

entry.title: Evolutionary Two-Stage Hyperparameter Optimization Strategies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Fedor Buzaev (HSE University), Dmitry Efremenko (HSE University), Egor Bugaev (HSE University), Andrei Ermakov (HSE University, AXXX), Denis Derkach (HSE University), Daria Pugacheva (HSE University, AXXX), Fedor Ratnikov (HSE University)

entry.summary: Proposes evolutionary two-stage hyperparameter optimization strategies for physics-informed neural networks to handle the noisy, black-box, mixed-parameter outer-loop search caused by the non-convex multi-term physics loss. Evolutionary population-based exploration is argued to outperform gradient-based strategies prone to suboptimal traps.

entry.title: Structure-Oriented Randomized Neural Networks for Poisson-Nernst-Planck and Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes Systems

author.name: Yunlong Li, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Develops SO-RaNN, a structure-oriented randomized neural network framework for solving Poisson-Nernst-Planck and coupled PNP-Navier-Stokes systems, using pointwise positivity cutoffs, mass-scaling factors, and SAV-type dissipation corrections. Targets structure-preserving numerical solutions for these physical systems.

entry.title: SSH-Net: A Deep Neural Network for Predicting Failure Time Distribution Functions under Competing Risks with Application to GPU Data

author.name: Jie Min, Yueyao Wang, Mengkun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SSH-Net, a structured segmented hazard deep neural network for predicting failure-time distributions under competing risks, designed to capture hierarchical physical structures by segmenting inputs rather than treating them as a single group. Applied to GPU reliability data.

entry.title: What sentiment analysis can't see: Measuring whether customers were helped, and what went wrong, across 70,000 support conversations

author.name: Jason Potteiger

entry.summary: Compares sentiment analysis against LLM-based (GPT-5.4) estimation of customer satisfaction and structured problem-flagging across 70,450 support conversations, validating against customer star ratings. Finds the satisfaction estimate correlates much better with ratings than sentiment and surfaces concrete problems sentiment misses.

entry.title: HypOProto: Hyperbolic Ordinal Prototypes for Left Ventricular Filling Pressure Classification

author.name: Victoria Wu, Nima Hashemi, Hooman Vaseli, Christina Luong, Purang Abolmaesumi, Teresa S. M. Tsang

entry.summary: HypOProto is a hyperbolic ordinal prototype-based framework for interpretable left ventricular filling pressure classification from B-mode echocardiography, avoiding operator-dependent Doppler measurements. It uses a frozen explainable foundation model with prototype reasoning.

entry.title: Linear Recurrent Unit with Semantic Modulation for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Mingyu Choi, Woo Kyoung Han, Sunghoon Im, Kyong Hwan Jin

entry.summary: This paper adapts the Linear Recurrent Unit to 2D vision via a semantic modulating unit handling LRU modulation, spatial categorization, and feature enhancement for single-image super-resolution. It reports state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency balance.

entry.title: Addressing Detail Bottlenecks in Latent Diffusion for RGB-to-SWIR Image Translation

author.name: Kaili Wang, Martin Dimitrievski, Jose Maria Salvador, Ben Stoffelen, David Van Hamme, Lore Goetschalckx

entry.summary: This paper addresses detail loss in latent diffusion for RGB-to-SWIR image translation with two lightweight fixes: a source-conditioned autoencoder injecting high-res features via skip connections, and a learnable guidance encoder replacing naive downsampling. It improves downstream perception for driving scenes.

entry.title: Memorization in large language models in medicine prevalence characteristics and implications

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: A Nature Communications article studying the prevalence, characteristics, and implications of memorization in large language models applied to medicine. The provided content is empty, but the title indicates an empirical investigation into how medical LLMs reproduce training data.

entry.title: RACL: Reasoning-Agent Control Layers for Continuous Metaheuristic Learning

author.name: Ant\'on Asla Manz\'arraga

entry.summary: Introduces RACL, a reasoning-agent control layer placed above an existing metaheuristic optimizer that observes operational memory, forms hypotheses, tests interventions with guardrails, and consolidates policies to control search behavior without replacing the optimizer. Demonstrated on vehicle routing as a testbed.

entry.title: Implicit Semantic-Aware Communication Based on Hypergraph Reasoning

author.name: Yiwei Liao, Shurui Tu, Yong Xiao, Yingyu Li, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: Proposes implicit semantic-aware communication based on hypergraph reasoning to capture higher-order correlations (group interactions, multi-entity associations) that pairwise graph representations miss in semantic communication systems. Aims to improve communication efficiency and inference accuracy at the receiver.

entry.title: Creating Multilingual Mental Health Dialogue Datasets: Limits of Persona-Based Localization via Nationality and Language

author.name: Yunkai Xu, Saeed Abdullah

entry.summary: Investigates whether persona-based localization (varying nationality and language parameters) can generate valid multilingual mental health dialogue datasets in Mandarin, Bengali, and Hindi, finding important limits to this English-centric approach. Highlights risks of naive synthetic-persona localization.

entry.title: OnDeFog: Online Decision Transformer under Frame Dropping

author.name: Daiki Yotsufuji, Kenta Nishihara, Shoma Shimizu, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Proposes OnDeFog, an online extension of the Decision Transformer for frame-dropping environments where states and rewards are missing due to communication delays or sensor failures, improving generalization to novel states beyond the offline DeFog baseline. Targets robustness in real-world RL deployments.

entry.title: NRITYAM: Language Models Meet Art and Heritage of Dance

author.name: Punit Kumar Singh, Niladri Ghosh, Advait Joshi{\i}nst, Shailee Choudhary, Michael F\"arber, Haiqin Yang

entry.summary: Introduces NRITYAM, the largest benchmark (9260 QA pairs across 12 languages) for evaluating LLMs' cultural comprehension of global dance traditions, co-authored with native dance artists and speakers. Highlights gaps in models' socio-cultural understanding.

entry.title: PSCT-Net: Geometry-Aware Pediatric Skull CT Reconstruction via Differentiable Back-Projection and Attention-Guided Refinement

author.name: Dong Yeong Kim, Jaewon Choi, Youmin Shin, Jungyu Lee, Myeongseop Kim, Jinwook Choi, Joo Whan Kim, Young-Gon Kim

entry.summary: Reconstructs 3D pediatric skull CT from sparse bi-planar X-rays using differentiable back-projection to inject geometric priors and an attention module to refine voxel correspondences. Aims to reduce radiation exposure for vulnerable pediatric patients.

entry.title: A Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Efficient Pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems

author.name: Junzhe Xu, Zecui Zeng, Lusong Li, Yuetong Fang, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Presents SDQN-RMFS, an end-to-end framework deploying an RL-trained pathfinding policy onto neuromorphic hardware for energy-efficient, event-driven robotic warehouse navigation. Bridges full-precision ANN training to spiking deployment.

entry.title: Hybrid ANN-SNN Pipeline with Local Plasticity

author.name: Denis Larionov, Khairutin Shtanchaev, Mikhail Kiselev, Mikhail Korovin, Ivan Tugoy

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid pipeline pairing a pretrained EfficientNet encoder with a spiking neural network classifier trained via local biologically inspired rules instead of end-to-end backprop, achieving 99% accuracy on a 64-class ImageNet subset. Demonstrates adapting powerful pretrained encoders to neuromorphic settings.

entry.title: Boundary Embedding Shaping with Adaptive Contrastive Learning for Graph Structural Disentanglement

author.name: Jiaqing Chen, Zidu Yin, Yichao Cai, Yuhang Liu, Zhen Zhang, Dong Gong, Javen Qinfeng Shi

entry.summary: Proposes Boundary Embedding Shaping with adaptive contrastive learning to disentangle graph structure for GNNs, focusing on vulnerable nodes near class boundaries where structural noise blurs decisions. Targets spurious correlations from semantically irrelevant neighbors.

entry.title: Low-Energy Reduced RISC-V Instruction Subset Processor for Tsetlin Machine Inference at the Edge

author.name: Chanda Gupta, Sanidhya Bhatia, Shaurya Priyadarshi, Himani Panwar, Rishad Shafik, Sudip Roy

entry.summary: Presents a domain-specific reduced RISC-V instruction-subset microprocessor architecture tailored for low-energy Tsetlin Machine inference at the edge. Retains programmability while improving energy efficiency compared to tightly-coupled accelerator designs.

entry.title: PaAno+: Multiscale Encoding and Cross-Variable Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Youji Zhu, Hongbing Wang, Wenchao Liu, Xiaodong Liu, Xiangguang Xiong

entry.summary: PaAno+ is a lightweight time-series anomaly detection model using multiscale convolutional encoding with differentiated receptive fields and cross-variable attention to capture multivariate dependencies. It aims to reduce the computational overhead of Transformer-based detectors while improving feature extraction.

entry.title: A Model-Driven Approach for Developing Families of Reinforcement Learning Environments

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Proposes a model-driven engineering approach for systematically developing families of similar-but-varying reinforcement learning training environments, reducing the labor-intensive and error-prone manual creation process. Targets scalable production of environment variants needed for robust RL training.

entry.title: DeepForestVisionV2: Ecology-Driven Taxonomy Expansion for Camera-Trap Monitoring in African Tropical Forests

author.name: Hugo Magaldi, Theau d'Audiffret, Etienne Francois Akomo-Okoue, Bala Amarasekaran, Naomi Anderson, Claire Auger, Noemie Cappelle, Daniel Cornelis, Raphael Cornette, Tobias Deschner, Gabriel Dubus, Davy Fonteyn, Rosa M. Garriga, Jennifer Hatlauf, Innocent Kasekendi, Raymond Katumba, Aram Kazandjian, Alfred Ngomanda, Stephan Ntie, Simone Pika, Xavier Rufray, Harold Rugonge, John Justice Tibesigwa, Peter van Lunteren, Hadrien Vanthomme, Joeri A. Zwerts, Sabrina Krief

entry.summary: DeepForestVisionV2 expands an African tropical-forest camera-trap classifier from 35 to 64 classes through ecology-driven taxonomy expansion to handle arboreal primates, birds, semi-aquatic taxa, and human-associated confounders beyond closed-canopy interiors. It provides a matched offline workflow for photos and videos.

entry.title: ForEnt: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Characterizing Quadruped Robot Entrapments in Forest Environments

author.name: Natapat Kirdwichai, Danesh Tarapore

entry.summary: ForEnt is a multi-modal dataset characterizing quadruped robot entrapments (legs ensnared in vines or vegetation) collected with a Unitree Go2 across eight UK forest sites. It addresses the absence of dedicated data for studying legged-robot failure modes in forests.

entry.title: Robust Assembly State Reasoning from Action Recognition for Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: James Fant-Male, Roel Pieters

entry.summary: This work systematically compares methods (logic-based, HMM, neural network) for tracking assembly state from human action recognition inputs for human-robot collaboration. It finds optimal approaches vary across tasks and different methods fail under different circumstances.

entry.title: Machine Learning Integrated in Wavelet Shrinkage (MLShrink)

author.name: Dixon Vimalajeewa, Vijini Lakmini, Brani Vidakovic

entry.summary: MLShrink is a two-threshold wavelet denoising procedure that combines classical shrinkage with machine learning for coefficients in an intermediate magnitude region where signal-versus-noise is uncertain. It discards small coefficients, retains large ones, and learns decisions for the ambiguous middle.

entry.title: Denoising Implicit Feedback for Cold-start Recommendation

author.name: Gaode Chen, Shicheng Wang, Shikun Li, Rui Huang, Xinghua Zhang, Yunze Luo, Shipeng Li, Shiming Ge, Ruina Sun, Yinjie Jiang, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Addresses denoising implicit feedback specifically for cold-start items in recommender systems, arguing cold items are more prone to noise (clickbait, position bias) and that prior heuristic loss-based denoising fails in cold-start. Proposes an adaptive denoising approach for new items.

entry.title: Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence

author.name: Ishanu Chattopadhyay

entry.summary: Proposes a thermodynamic definition of intelligence as the lawful amplification of rare but valid futures, where a system increases the probability of outcomes unlikely under passive dynamics but admissible under domain constraints. Derives necessity and conditional near-sufficiency statements linking recursive self-simulation to a precise thermodynamic measure.

entry.title: Information Lattice Learning as Probabilistic Graphical Model Structure Learning

author.name: Haizi Yu, Lav R. Varshney

entry.summary: Shows that information lattice learning rules, when the signal is a probability mass function, admit a probabilistic graphical model interpretation, framing rules as marginal constraints over interpretable abstractions. Connects interpretable rule learning with PGM structure learning.

entry.title: cAPM: Continual AI-Assisted Pace-Mapping with Active Learning

author.name: Dylan O'Hara, Pradeep Bajracharya, Casey Meisenzahl, Karli Gillette, Anton J. Prassl, Gernot Plank, Saman Nazarian, Roderick Tung, John L Sapp, Linwei Wang

entry.summary: Presents cAPM, a continual active-learning system for AI-assisted cardiac pace-mapping that transfers knowledge across multiple ventricular tachycardias within and across patients, avoiding per-target retraining. Aims to improve efficiency of catheter ablation procedures.

entry.title: DynAMO:Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration via Topological Multi-Agent Scheduling

author.name: Kanishk Kushwaha, Vikrant Vinod Bansode, Harsh Vardhan, Dhaval C. Patel

entry.summary: Presents DynAMO, a deployment-ready multi-agent orchestration engine using a Plan-then-Execute architecture to generate verifiable workflow graphs supporting both sequential and dependency-aware parallel execution for industrial asset management. Improves efficiency while preserving safety on the AssetOpsBench benchmark.

entry.title: ParaScale: Scale-Calibrated Camera-Motion Transfer via a Gauge-Invariant Parallax Number

author.name: Zijie Meng

entry.summary: Introduces a dimensionless, gauge-invariant Parallax Number to enable scale-faithful transfer of camera motion between videos at incompatible spatial scales. It provides a principled geometric quantity for cinematic motion reuse in generative video.

entry.title: When, Where, and How: Adaptive Binning for Tabular Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Daehwan Kim, Haejun Chung, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Binning, a self-supervised pretext for tabular data that couples discretization to learning via a feature-wise coarse-to-fine curriculum, motivated by neural spectral bias. It targets the underexplored area of deep learning on unlabeled clinical tabular data.

entry.title: The Algorithmic-Human Manager: AI, Apps, and Workers in the Indian Gig Economy

author.name: Omir Kumar, Krishnan Narayanan

entry.summary: Examines the impact of algorithmic management on India's blue-collar gig economy through interviews with workers and stakeholders, revealing a dual reality of expanded work access alongside surveillance and reduced worker agency. Uses a social justice framework to analyze AI-driven labor allocation.

entry.title: MakeupMirror: Improving Facial Attribute Preservation in Diffusion Models for Makeup Transfer

author.name: Nefeli Andreou, Angel Mart\'inez-Gonz\'alez, Sabine Sternig, Matthieu Guillaumin, Epameinondas Antonakos, Michael Opitz

entry.summary: Proposes MakeupMirror, a diffusion-based makeup transfer method improving identity and skin-tone preservation via facial geometry conditioning with ControlNets and region-specific mechanisms. Targets production-quality virtual try-on for makeup shopping.

entry.title: MedRLM: Recursive Multimodal Health Intelligence for Long-Context Clinical Reasoning, Sensor-Guided Screening, Evidence-Grounded Decision Support, and Community-to-Tertiary Referral Optimization

author.name: Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: Proposes MedRLM, a recursive multimodal framework for long-context clinical reasoning that processes patient cases across EHRs, images, sensor streams, guidelines, and referral constraints rather than compressing into a single prompt. Targets fragile single-step prompting in medical decision support.

entry.title: DataMagic: Transforming Tabular Data into Data Insight Video

author.name: Yupeng Xie, Chen Ma, Zhenyang Wang, Liangwei Wang, Jiayi Zhu, Chuxuan Zeng, Zhouan Shen, Boyan Li, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: Demonstrates DataMagic, an end-to-end interactive system that transforms raw tabular data into data insight videos with dynamic charts, narration, and synchronized animation while preserving data fidelity. Addresses the multi-skill burden of producing high-quality data videos.

entry.title: Optimal Order of Multi-Agent and General Many-Body Systems

author.name: Jake J. Xia

entry.summary: Develops a general framework analyzing multi-agent systems with feedback loops via two agent-level variables (power and response functions), deriving macroscopic properties like order, fragility, and mobility and an optimal degree of order balancing growth and resilience. Offers a physics-inspired theory of collective system organization.

entry.title: SEAGAN: domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes

author.name: Antriksh Srivastava, Soumyashree Kar

entry.summary: SEAGAN is a domain-specific edge-aware graph attention network for modeling dynamic plant physiological processes, applied to estimating photosynthetic limitation states along A-Ci curves. It addresses identifying biochemical limitation states that are a major source of uncertainty.

entry.title: Towards Graph-Based Deep Learning for Map Generalization: Insights from Building Footprints Simplification and Aggregation

author.name: Yanning Wang, Zhiyong Zhou, Zhouyu Liu, Mengni Yu, Yu Feng

entry.summary: First exploratory application of graph-based deep learning to cartographic map generalization, reformulating building footprint simplification as node movement prediction and aggregation as link prediction. Evaluates GCN, GAT, and GraphSAGE, finding GraphSAGE strong on link prediction but persistent challenges in node-movement precision.

entry.title: Pseudo-Feature Padding: A Lightweight Defense Against False Data Injection in Power Grids

author.name: Farhin Farhad Riya, Shahinul Hoque, Yingyuan Yang, Jinyuan Sun, Kevin Tomsovic

entry.summary: Proposes pseudo-feature padding, a lightweight defense that appends statistically-derived pseudo-feature values to inputs to strengthen DNNs against false data injection attacks in cyber-physical power grids. The padding increases input dimensionality in a randomized way to hinder evasion of detection.

entry.title: GB-LSR: A Fast Local Spectral Image Representation with a Single Global Bandwidth for Continuous Reconstruction and Super-Resolution

author.name: Max Shad, Naeem Khoshnevis

entry.summary: Presents GB-LSR, a fixed-grid local spectral image representation using patch-wise truncated Fourier bases with a single globally shared trainable bandwidth for continuous image reconstruction and super-resolution at size-independent cost. Compares trainable, fixed, and per-patch bandwidth variants on standard benchmarks.

entry.title: MiqraBERT: Regression-Based Sentence-BERT Finetuning for Biblical Hebrew Parallel Detection

author.name: David M. Smiley

entry.summary: Introduces MiqraBERT, a Sentence-BERT model finetuned from AlephBERT for verse-level semantic similarity in Biblical Hebrew, trained on 1,650 labeled verse pairs to detect textual reuse beyond lexical overlap including paraphrase and syntactic reworking. Addresses a gap where prior methods relied largely on lexical matching.

entry.title: When Does Streaming Tool Use Help? Characterizing Tool-Intent Stabilization in Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Elroy Galbraith

entry.summary: This paper studies when speculative streaming tool queries in RAG actually help, introducing the concept of tool-intent stabilization and a model-agnostic bound on latency that can be hidden. It measures this on the CRAG benchmark to characterize query-intrinsic speculation benefits.

entry.title: Token-Operations-Oriented Inference Optimization Techniques for Large Models

author.name: Shiguo Lian, Kai Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Wen Liu, Minjie Hua, Yutong Liu, Jiangze Yan, Xin Wang, Cong Wang, Yilin Zhang, Yi Shen, Jieyun Huang, Fang Zhao, Huanlin Gao, Ping Chen, Xinyu Yang, Kaikai Zhao, Yao Zhao, Xinggang Wang, Huishuai Zhang, Dongyan Zhao, Junping Du, Tao Chen, Xiang Gao, Qinghuai Ma

entry.summary: This survey-style paper proposes a four-layer technical architecture for token-oriented large-model inference optimization spanning multi-model fusion, model optimization, compute-model fusion, and compute-network-model fusion. It reviews industry technologies for reducing token costs and improving service efficiency.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration for Frozen Pose-Flow Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Ning Dong, Yingna Su, Xin Dong, Ziyun Jiao, Xinnian Guo, Zhuangzhuang Pan

entry.summary: RPC is a post-hoc score calibration method for frozen pose-flow video anomaly detection that adds a standardized nearest-prototype deviation to the flow score and uses keypoint confidence to gate this geometric evidence. It corrects unreliability from multimodal normal behavior and pose noise.

entry.title: Fail-RAG : A Retrieval Augmented Generation Informed Framework for Robot Failure Identification

author.name: Ameya Salvi, Jie Hu

entry.summary: Fail-RAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework for detecting robot operation failures in warehouse material handling, adapting to the dynamic changing forms of failures that break rule-based methods. It targets unexpected events requiring robot reaction.

entry.title: Safe Local Navigation for Ackermann-Steered Robots in Unmapped Environments

author.name: Christian Schaible, Shahin Sirouspour

entry.summary: This work proposes a control framework for safe local navigation of Ackermann-steered robots in unmapped environments without a global goal, choosing the safest heading toward the largest open space using convex quadratic optimization for obstacle separation. A feedback-linearizing controller regulates motion.

entry.title: Exit-and-Join Dynamics for Decentralized Coalition Formation

author.name: Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Studies decentralized coalition formation as a dynamical process of unilateral exit-and-join decisions using the Aumann-Dreze value, linking cooperative payoff allocation with best-response behavior. Establishes equilibrium characterizations and Lyapunov/potential conditions for stability.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization

author.name: Federica Filippini

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent system for multi-objective constrained optimization that addresses the difficulty of manually choosing penalty weights in Lagrangian-style RL reward shaping for cost-minimization under performance constraints in dynamic environments. Aims to identify appropriate trade-offs automatically in non-stationary settings.

entry.title: Context-Aware Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling of IVF Laboratory Environmental Conditions

author.name: Zahra Asghari Varzaneh, Reza Khoshkangini, Pia Saldeen, Lars Johansson, Thomas Ebner

entry.summary: Engineers 55 context-aware temporal features (thermal stability, temperature-humidity adherence, peak stress duration, recovery speed) from high-resolution IVF lab environmental sensor data and trains a hierarchical Bayesian Beta regression model to predict pregnancy rates. Reduces cross-validated error to 1.27 percent versus 3-5 percent for raw averages.

entry.title: Execution-bound advisory automation for agentic AI: a reproducible AIBOM-driven CSAF-VEX framework

author.name: Petar Radanliev, Omar Santos, Carsten Maple, Kay Atefi

entry.summary: Presents a protocol-driven framework binding SBOM/AIBOM artifacts to runtime telemetry to compute exploitability and auto-generate cryptographically signed CSAF-VEX security advisories for agentic AI workloads. Evaluated on ~10000 synthetic component entries.

entry.title: GDGU: A Gradient Difference-based Graph Unlearning Method for Cyberattack Localization in Electric Vehicle Charging Networks

author.name: Nanhong Liu, Mucun Sun, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GDGU, a gradient-difference-based graph unlearning method to remove specific training data influence for cyberattack localization in EV charging networks without full retraining. Addresses privacy-regulation deletion rights for graph models.

entry.title: PrefSQA: Pairwise Preference Prediction for Speech Quality Assessment and the Critical Role of High Quality Datasets

author.name: Junyi Fan, Donald S. Williamson

entry.summary: Proposes PrefSQA, a MOS-free pairwise preference prediction approach for speech quality assessment with uncertainty-aware logits and an impairment attention head, emphasizing the role of high-quality datasets. Reduces label noise inherent in scalar MOS ratings.

entry.title: FineREX: Fine-Tuned NER-RE for Human Smuggling Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Elijah Feldman, Dipak Meher, Carlotta Domeniconi

entry.summary: Introduces FineREX, a knowledge-graph construction pipeline with a fine-tuned LLM for named entity recognition and relation extraction tailored to human smuggling court documents, improving entity and relation F1 by 15.5% and 31.5% over general models. Extracts evidence about smuggling networks from jargon-heavy legal text.

entry.title: CREDENCE: Claim Reduction for Decomposition & Enhanced Credibility -- Semantic Metrics and Convergence Analysis

author.name: Phuong Huu Vu Tran, Thuan Duc Mai, Bach Xuan Le

entry.summary: Improves automated claim decomposition for fact-checking by replacing token-overlap metrics with semantic similarity (Semantic-F1) and adding formal convergence guarantees for a repair loop. It aims to make fact-checking pipelines more reliable for paraphrastic claims.

entry.title: AI Economist Agent: An Agentic Framework for Model-Grounded Economic Analysis with RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Large Language Models

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic AI economist combining RAG, knowledge graphs, and LLMs to ground economic narratives in explicit model-based computations rather than generating quantitative claims directly. Aims to make LLM economic analysis theory- and data-grounded.

entry.title: IHUBERT: Vector-Based Semantic Deduplication and Domain-Balanced Pretraining for Persian Resources

author.name: Arash Ghafouri, Mahdi Firouzmandi, Hossein Saberi, Mohammad Reza Hasani Ahangar

entry.summary: Presents IHUBERT, a from-scratch Persian RoBERTa-base language model trained on a curated 45GB corpus with a multi-stage pipeline including vector-database semantic deduplication for domain balancing. Addresses scarcity of high-quality Persian pretraining resources.

entry.title: The Register Gap: A Meaning Intelligence Framework for Nigerian Public Discourse

author.name: Celestine Achi

entry.summary: Introduces the Meaning Intelligence Framework, a nine-dimension annotation schema for Nigerian public discourse that separates surface sentiment from true communicative intent, irony, and coded subtext. Argues that AI failures on Nigerian discourse stem from context failure rather than translation failure.

entry.title: Closing the Social-Semantic Gap: SPSD for Edge-Based Prompt Compression in Cloud LLM Inference

author.name: Abhinit Sen, Ajeet Kumar, Manaranjan Pradhan

entry.summary: Presents SPSD, an edge-based pipeline using a 4-bit quantized small language model to compress conversational prompts by removing low-information social scaffolding before cloud LLM inference, while preserving sentiment. Aims to reduce cloud-scale prefill energy costs from politeness and rapport-building language.

entry.title: Comparative Study on Agility, Efficiency, and Impact Absorption of Bipedal Robots with Active Toes

author.name: Joong-Gil Kim, Wontae Ye, Geunwoo Cho, Seong-Ho Yun, Se-Hyoung Cho, Yong-Jae Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a 14-DOF bipedal robot with active toes and a high-fidelity simulation environment modeling actual actuators and power consumption to quantitatively compare agility, efficiency, and impact absorption with and without toes. Aims to rigorously validate the benefits of human-like toes in robots.

entry.title: ReNikud: Audio-Supervised Hebrew Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion

author.name: Maxim Melichov, Yakov Kolani, Morris Alper

entry.summary: ReNikud is an audio-supervised grapheme-to-phoneme conversion method for Modern Hebrew that bypasses scarce vowel-diacritic data and captures spoken pronunciation and stress directly. It addresses the abjad-writing ambiguity challenge for Hebrew TTS.

entry.title: U$^2$Mamba: A Two-level Nested U-structure Mamba for Salient Object Detection

author.name: Junhui Li, Jialu Li, Youshan Zhang

entry.summary: U-squared-Mamba is a two-level nested U-structure Mamba network for salient object detection using multiscale Mamba U-blocks to integrate receptive fields from shallow and deep layers without sequence-length constraints. It enhances contextual information and model depth.

entry.title: Evaluation of Augmented Reality-based Intuitive Interface for Robot-Assisted Transesophageal Echocardiography: A User Study

author.name: Xiu Zhang*, Matteo Di Mauro*, Sofia Breschi, Angela Peloso, Emiliano Votta, Arianna Menciassi, Elena De Momi

entry.summary: This study evaluates a model-enhanced augmented reality interface for robot-assisted transesophageal echocardiography through a user study, aiming to improve spatial awareness and control intuitiveness while reducing operator fatigue and radiation exposure. It integrates electromagnetic tracking with a virtual model.

entry.title: GLARE: A Natural Language Interface for Querying Global Explanations

author.name: Bhavan Vasu, Rajesh Mangannavar

entry.summary: Presents GLARE, an LLM-based natural language interface that translates user questions about global explanations of image classifiers into structured SQL queries over local explanation data. Returns statistics-augmented natural language responses for interactive exploration.

entry.title: Improving Code-Switching ASR with Code-Mixing Guided Synthetic Speech

author.name: Yue Heng Yeo, Haoyang Li, Yizhou Peng, Shreyas Gopal, Hexin Liu, Leibny Paola Garcia-Perera, Hardik B. Sailor, Jeremy H. M. Wong, Eng Siong Chng

entry.summary: Proposes a code-mixing-guided preference-learning framework using the Code Mixing Index to steer synthetic TTS toward better code-switching fidelity for ASR data augmentation. Demonstrates gains on the SEAME Mandarin-English corpus.

entry.title: Secure Coding Drift in LLM-Assisted Post-Quantum Cryptography Development: A Gamified Fix

author.name: R. D. N. Shakya, C. P. Wijesiriwardana, S. M. Vidanagamachchi, Nalin A. G. Arachchilage

entry.summary: Defines Secure Coding Drift, a socio-technical vulnerability model capturing gradual degradation of secure coding practices from sustained reliance on LLM-generated post-quantum cryptography code, and proposes a gamified mitigation. Addresses security risks of LLM-assisted cryptographic engineering.

entry.title: TeleMorpher: Toward Robust Simultaneous Motion-Location Editing

author.name: Haengbok Chung

entry.summary: Proposes TeleMorpher, one of the first one-shot frameworks for simultaneous motion-and-location editing in video, analyzing factors degrading quality and leveraging motion priors and ground-truth guidance. Addresses an underexplored combined editing task.

entry.title: CSWinUNETR: Segmentation of Thin Anatomical Structures in Medical Images

author.name: Junho Moon, Haejun Chung, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: Presents a Transformer backbone using cross-shaped stripe self-attention for segmenting thin, tortuous anatomical structures like vessels and wrinkles in 2D and 3D medical images. Targets the persistent problem of fragmented predictions on fine branches.

entry.title: Performance Analysis and Optimization of 3D Generative Diffusion Models across GPU Architectures

author.name: Jeeho Ryoo, Yongchan Jung, Muhammad Ali Khaliq, Weidong Zhang, Jiatong Han, Byeong Kil Lee

entry.summary: Conducts a comprehensive performance analysis of the Med-DDPM 3D MRI diffusion model across three NVIDIA GPU generations, profiling kernel runtimes, instruction mix, memory utilization, and warp activity. Identifies cuDNN convolution and implicit-GEMM kernels as dominant costs with memory-access inefficiencies.

entry.title: Enhancing Graph Neural Networks Using Proximity Graphs for Dust Source Emission Forecasting

author.name: Maryam Sanisales, Zahed Rahmati, Ali Darvishi Boloorani, Ali Vefghi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that proximity graphs such as Delaunay triangulation, Gabriel, kNN, and Yao graphs serve as effective inputs for GNNs in forecasting dust source emissions. Compares GraphSAGE, GCN, and GAT for modeling spatiotemporal dynamics of dust storms.

entry.title: The Hidden Environmental Cost of Poor Coding Practices in TensorFlow and Keras Applications: A Study on Resource Leaks and Carbon Emissions

author.name: Bashar Abdallah, Gustavo Santos, Rola Al Bataineh, Alain Abran, Mohammad Hamdaqa

entry.summary: Empirically investigates two resource-leak code smells (improper model reuse and unreleased tensor references) in TensorFlow/Keras workloads and quantifies their impact on energy consumption and CO2 emissions via controlled experiments. Highlights the hidden environmental cost of poor ML coding practices.

entry.title: TerraMARS: A Domain-Adapted Small-Language-Model Pipeline for Mars Terraforming Literature

author.name: Jyotsna Singh, Ash Black, Jeff Larsen, Scott R. Saleska

entry.summary: Presents TerraMARS, an end-to-end information extraction pipeline using a domain-adapted small language model to answer Mars terraforming questions and convert unstructured Mars science text into structured machine-readable outputs. Aims to extract quantitative constraints for habitability and terraforming studies.

entry.title: PsyScore: A Psychometrically-Aware Framework for Trait-Adaptive Essay Scoring and ZPD-Scaffolded Feedback

author.name: Wei Xia, Jin Wu, Haoran Shi, Xiangyu Wang, Chanjin Zheng

entry.summary: PsyScore integrates automated essay scoring with instructional feedback through a shared latent ability representation, combining a neural item-response-theory scorer with ZPD-scaffolded feedback. It aims to unify reliable assessment and proficiency-adaptive feedback.

entry.title: Stitching and dimensionality effects on large artificially generated volume datasets

author.name: Lucas von Chamier, Jan Philipp Albrecht, Dagmar Kainm\"uller

entry.summary: This paper studies stitching artifacts and 2D-vs-3D patch dimensionality effects when generating large volume datasets via deep learning, using cycleGAN on cryo-EM data and evaluating downstream mitochondria segmentation. It finds FID fails to detect subtle stitching artifacts that harm downstream tasks.

entry.title: Review of Machine Learning Models for Solar Energetic Particle Prediction

author.name: Spiridon Kasapis, Pouya Hosseinzadeh, Kathryn Whitman, Ricky Egeland, Manolis Georgoulis, Angelos Vourlidas, Athanasios Papaioannou, Eleni Lavasa, Anastasios Anastasiadis, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Andres Munoz-Jaramillo, Bala Poduval, Irina N. Kitiashvili, Alexander G. Kosovichev, Viacheslav Sadykov, Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi, Tate T. Hutchins, Hameedullah A. Farooki, Manuel E. Cuesta, Leng Y. Khoo, Sungmin Pak, Robert Czarnota, Jamie S. Rankin, Jamey Szalay, Mitchell M. Shen, Georgios Livadiotis, Zigong Xu, David J. McComas, Nikolaos Sarlis, Dionissios Hristopulos, Arik Posner, Alec J. Engell, Mohammed AbuBakr Ali, Ali G. A. Abdelkawy, Abdelrazek M. K. Shaltout, M. M. Beheary, Christina O. Lee, Sigiava Aminalragia-Giamini, Constantinos Papadimitriou, Ingmar Sandberg, Savvas Raptis, Shah Muhammad Hamdi, Monica Laurenza, Mirko Stumpo, Sumanth A. Rotti, India Jackson, Aatiya Ali, Atilim Gunes Baydin, Nathan Schwadron, Subhamoy Chatterjee, Maher A. Dayeh, Gelu M. Nita, Patrick M. O'Keefe, Chun Jie Chong, Paul Kosovich, Russell D. Marroquin, Berkay Aydin, Petrus C. Martens, Lulu Zhao, Yang Chen, Yian Yu, Monica G. Bobra, Ward Manchester, Tamas Gombosi, Ming Zhang, Jesse Torres, Philip K. Chan, Mohamed Nedal, Kamen Kozarev, Peijin Zhang, Kimberly Moreland, Hazel M. Bain, Samuel Hart, Michael J. Starkey, Alan G. Ling, Simone Benella

entry.summary: A broad review of machine learning models for predicting solar energetic particle events, which pose radiation hazards to aviation, spacecraft, and crewed missions. Compiles physics-based and ML approaches across a very large multi-institution author list.

entry.title: Policy-aware Vector Search: A Vision for Fine Grained Access Control in Vector Databases

author.name: Lakshmi Sahithi Yalamarthi, Primal Pappachan

entry.summary: Proposes a vision for fine-grained access control in vector databases used in RAG and organizational AI pipelines, highlighting the tension between policy enforcement, search recall, and latency. It matters because vector databases are increasingly deployed in security-sensitive contexts but lack mature access control.

entry.title: Neural Additive and Basis Models with Feature Selection and Interactions

author.name: Yasutoshi Kishimoto, Kota Yamanishi, Takuya Matsuda, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Extends neural additive and basis models with feature selection and interaction modeling while reducing the prohibitive compute of two-input networks on high-dimensional data. Aims to keep interpretable GAM-style models tractable and flexible.

entry.title: Advances in Scientific Machine Learning for Coupled Fluid Flow and Transport

author.name: Gabriel F. Barros, R\^omulo M. Silva, Alvaro L. G. A. Coutinho

entry.summary: A review chapter surveying scientific-ML methods for coupled fluid flow and transport governed by incompressible Navier-Stokes and scalar transport equations. Covers reduced-order techniques like DMD and nonlinear approaches like PINNs and beta-VAEs for surrogate modeling.

entry.title: Neural Architectures as Functional Priors in Physics-Informed Control Problems

author.name: Sonia Rubio Herranz, Fernando Carlos L\'opez Hern\'andez, Antonio L\'opez Montes

entry.summary: Investigates how neural architecture choices (MLPs vs Fourier/KAN-like networks) act as implicit functional priors in physics-informed control problems for simple ODE systems like RLC circuits and Duffing oscillators. Compares classical optimal control and PINN-based approaches.

entry.title: A Differentiable Composite Approximation Framework for Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Maneuvering Modeling from Sea-Trial Data

author.name: Aobo Wang, Aifei Xia, Zihao Wang, Lizhu Hao

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable composite-approximation framework for modeling autonomous underwater vehicle maneuvering from sea-trial data, jointly calibrating a polynomial basis and a data-adaptive basis with a sensitivity-aware mechanism. Bridges physics-based and data-driven maneuvering models.

entry.title: CzechDocs: A Multiway Parallel Dataset of Formatted Documents for Minority Languages in Czechia

author.name: Josef Jon, Ond\v{r}ej Bojar

entry.summary: CzechDocs is a multiway parallel dataset of formatted documents (HTML, DOCX, PDF) covering Czech and minority languages, designed to evaluate format-preserving machine translation. It includes an evaluation toolkit and a planned shared task.

entry.title: InfantFace: Detecting infant faces in neonatal clinical environments

author.name: Abdullah Bin-Obaid, Maria M. Cobo, Rebeccah Slater, Lionel Tarassenko, Mauricio Villarroel

entry.summary: InfantFace is a YOLOv11m-based face detector tailored to detect neonatal faces in cluttered, occluded clinical environments for non-contact monitoring such as pain scoring and breathing alerts. It addresses challenges unique to neonatal ICU settings.

entry.title: eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization

author.name: Shengbiao Lu, Xiaodong Wei

entry.summary: Proposes eCNNTO, an element-based CNN that accelerates density-based topology optimization by predicting near-optimal element densities from early iteration history while incorporating spatial correlations among neighboring elements. Improves on prior per-element deep belief network approaches.

entry.title: Leveraging systems' non-linearity to tackle the scarcity of data in the design of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems

author.name: Giancarlo Santamato, Andrea Mattia Garavagno, Massimiliano Solazzi, Antonio Frisoli

entry.summary: Proposes a vibration-based intelligent fault diagnosis approach under severe data scarcity using deep transfer learning, leveraging intrinsic system non-linearities via a periodic multi-excitation procedure to generate images analyzable by pretrained CNNs. Introduces a new data visualization and augmentation method.

entry.title: Zero-Inflated Gaussian Distributions Enable Parameter-Space Sparsity in Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms

author.name: Andreas Faust, Sven Nitzsche, Juergen Becker

entry.summary: Generalizes estimation-of-distribution algorithms to sparse parameter spaces using zero-inflated Gaussian distributions, enabling parameter-space sparsity in black-box optimization where most coefficients are exactly zero. Avoids reintroducing the operator-design biases EDAs were meant to escape.

entry.title: Learner-based Concept Drift Detection: Analysis and Evaluation

author.name: Md Moman Ul Haque Khan, Samira Sadaoui

entry.summary: Theoretically examines concept drift characteristics and evaluates numerous learner-based drift detection algorithms across synthetic and real-world streaming datasets. Provides comparative analysis to guide timely drift detection for sustained model accuracy.

entry.title: Segment-Level Mandarin Chinese Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection via an Autoencoder with Contrastive Learning

author.name: Yongqi Shao, Hong Huo, Flavio Bertini, Danilo Montesi, Tao Fang

entry.summary: This work develops a segment-level autoencoder with contrastive learning for detecting cognitive impairment from Mandarin speech, using augmentation to improve robustness under limited labeled data. It targets a low-cost non-invasive digital biomarker.

entry.title: Weight Adaptation for Improving Parallel Performance of Adaptive Stochastic Natural Gradient

author.name: Yutaro Yamada, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: WA-ASNG incorporates a weight adaptation mechanism into adaptive stochastic natural gradient methods to improve parallel performance for larger population sizes in black-box optimization. It addresses how to set weights for parallel evaluation of time-consuming tasks.

entry.title: Increasing Resilience of Continuum Robots via Motion Planning Algorithms

author.name: Oxana Shamilyan, Ievgen Kabin, Zoya Dyka, Oleksandr Sudakov, Peter Langendoerfer

entry.summary: This experimental study applies multi-criteria decision-making (Analytical Hierarchy Process) to motion planning algorithms (Genetic and A*) for continuum robots, evaluating paths on distance, motor damage, mechanical damage, and accuracy to increase resilience. It studies impact on generated paths and execution time.

entry.title: AI #173: AI Pauses

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's recurring news roundup, this installment dramatizing a scenario in which Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 were shut down via export controls after a misunderstood code-fixing demo was characterized as a jailbreak. It synthesizes governance, policy, and capability developments into commentary.

entry.title: Multi-Head Attention-Based Feature Extractor Integration with Soft Actor-Critic for Porosity Prediction and Process Parameter Optimization in Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Kianoush Aqabakee, Leonardo Stella

entry.summary: Integrates a multi-head attention feature extractor with the Soft Actor-Critic algorithm using a continuous action space to predict porosity and optimize process parameters in additive manufacturing. Aims to overcome slow convergence and local optima of discrete-action RL for high-precision manufacturing.

entry.title: Exploring Feature Extraction Technique Parameters for Acoustic Gunshot Classification

author.name: Sinclair Gurny, Ryan Quinn

entry.summary: Systematically investigates feature-extraction techniques and parameters for acoustic gunshot classification using a 23000-recording dataset across 85 firearms and 21 calibers, benchmarking with ResNet-18. Targets the generalization gap in commercial gunshot detection systems.

entry.title: Improving End-to-End Speech Recognition for Dysarthric Speech through In-Domain Data Augmentation

author.name: Paban Sapkota, Hemant Kumar Kathania, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Explores in-domain data augmentation (speaking-rate, pitch, formant modification) for dysarthric ASR by fine-tuning a pretrained Wav2Vec2 model with attention to severity levels, addressing data scarcity. Part of a series on dysarthric speech recognition from the same group.

entry.title: Generative Engine Optimization at Scale: Measuring Brand Visibility Across AI Search Engines

author.name: Pratyush Kumar (Ranqo)

entry.summary: This paper studies Generative Engine Optimization at scale, measuring how AI search engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini represent, cite, and recommend brands. It focuses especially on visibility for non-authoritative brands like SMEs and creators.

entry.title: Grounded Inference: Principles for Deterministically Encapsulated Generative Models

author.name: Marty O'Neill

entry.summary: Establishes a foundational framework of four primitives for deterministically encapsulating probabilistic generative models within traditional computational systems, plus two industry anti-patterns. Aims to de-risk integration of AI into conventional software.

entry.title: Interpretable Sperm Morphology Classification via Attention-Guided Deep Learning

author.name: Zahra Asghari Varzaneh, Reza Khoshkangini, Thomas Ebner, Lars Johansson

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable attention-guided deep learning framework for sperm morphology classification combining EfficientNet-B0 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module and Grad-CAM++ visualizations. Achieves around 90-94 percent accuracy on SMIDS and HuSHem datasets, outperforming baselines.

entry.title: Trustworthy Multi-Agent Systems: Mitigating Semantic Drift with the Argent Signaling Protocol

author.name: Anantha Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces the Argent Signaling Protocol, a machine-readable header attaching quality signals (certainty, grounding, stochasticity, assumption index) to multi-agent LLM responses to distinguish warranted retries from cases needing a halt. Aims to improve trust and human oversight in multi-agent systems.

entry.title: Cross-Dataset, Age, and Gender Generalization: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fine-Tuning Strategies for Low-Resource Children's ASR

author.name: Paban Sapkota, Hemant Kumar Kathania, Mikko Kurimo, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: A comprehensive analysis of fine-tuning strategies for low-resource children's ASR, examining cross-dataset, age, and gender generalization with acoustic feature combinations, finding pitch features especially helpful. Builds on the TORGO database and hybrid DNN/HMM training.

entry.title: Systematic Study of Dysarthric Speech Recognition: Spectral Features and Acoustic Models

author.name: Paban Sapkota, Hemant Kumar Kathania, Mikko Kurimo, Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Systematically investigates spectral features and acoustic models for dysarthric speech recognition on the TORGO database, finding pitch features notably improve recognition, especially for sentence-level tasks. Targets the acoustic variability from impaired articulation.

entry.title: Speeding up the annotation process in semantic segmentation industrial applications
