Chen, Yang Yu, Yangyi Chen, Yaniv Galron, Yashaswi Karnati, Yejin Choi, Yev Meyer, Yi-Fu Wu, Yian Zhang, Ying Lin, Yonatan Geifman, Yonggan Fu, Youngeun Kwon, Yu Yao, Yugi Guvvla, Yuki Huang, Yunsheng Liu, Zach Moshe, Zachary Newell, Zhilin Wang, Zhiyu Li, Zhongbo Zhu, Zhuolin Yang, Zihan Liu, Zijie Yan, Zsolt-Alon Wertheimer

entry.summary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-total/55B-active MoE hybrid Mamba-Attention model pretrained on 20T tokens with 1M context, achieving ~6x higher inference throughput than SOTA public LLMs at comparable accuracy. It combines LatentMoE, multi-token prediction, NVFP4 pretraining, multi-environment RLVR, and on-policy distillation for efficient agentic reasoning.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Atlas-Based 3D Asset Segmentation for Interactive Content Workflows

author.name: Paul Julius K\"uhn, Saptarshi Neil Sinha, Jakob Hansen, Robin Horst

entry.summary: Presents a human-in-the-loop pipeline that generates a segmented 2D parameterized atlas from a 3D model for media and XR workflows, combining greedy view selection with SAM 2 interactive segmentation back-projected onto UV space. Supports downstream tasks like material assignment and style transfer.

entry.title: SpatioTemporal Causal Network Diagnostics for Geographic Tipping Point Early Warning

author.name: Zhaoyuan Yu, Zhangyong Liang

entry.summary: ST-CND represents geographic fields as time-evolving directed causal networks using transfer entropy to detect tipping points. It addresses limitations of classical spatial indicators like spatial dilution and Euclidean assumptions for early warning.

entry.title: MoonSplat: Monocular Online Gaussian Splatting with Sim(3) Global Optimization

author.name: Guo Pu, Yixuan Han, Haofeng Li, Yao Zhang, Hui Zhou, Zhouhui Lian

entry.summary: MoonSplat performs monocular online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction with Sim(3) global optimization to improve camera pose robustness and efficiency on long sequences. It targets real-time dense reconstruction for robotics and AR/VR.

entry.title: Edit3DGS: Unified Framework for Dynamic Head Editing via 2D Instruction-Guided Diffusion and 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Duy-Dat Tran, Trung-Nghia Le

entry.summary: Edit3DGS unifies 2D instruction-guided diffusion editing with 3D Gaussian Splatting for dynamic head editing, masking editable facial regions and aggregating edited frames into a temporally consistent avatar. It supports expression, attribute, and appearance edits while preserving identity.

entry.title: From Ad Hoc Pilots to Repeatable Patterns: Structuring Drone Collaboration in Emergency Services with DroneLets

author.name: Dzmitry Katsiuba, Samuel Brander, Mateusz Dolata, Gerhard Schwabe

entry.summary: Based on four field trials and 95 interviews, this paper derives 44 interaction patterns and introduces DroneLets, design artifacts extending Collaboration Engineering to embodied agents for structuring emergency-service drone collaboration. It moves drone integration from ad hoc pilots to repeatable processes.

entry.title: Intermittent Strategic Cooperation of Two Selfish Agents on Graphs

author.name: Itay Shedlezki, Noa Agmon

entry.summary: This paper studies intermittent strategic cooperation between two self-interested agents on graphs as a shortest-path game, characterizing pure Nash equilibrium structures and proving stable cooperation must follow constrained forms with at least one PNE existing. It addresses fragile cooperation in multi-agent path planning.

entry.title: Understanding Long-Term Dynamics of Individual Metro Usage: A Hidden Semi-Markov State Framework with Survival Analysis

author.name: Bingxun Wang, Valeria Maria Urbano, Shan He, Yang Chen, Wei Liu, Zhibin Jiang, Piercesare Secchi

entry.summary: This study integrates Hidden Semi-Markov Models with discrete-time survival analysis to model multi-year individual metro usage lifecycles, inferring latent mobility states with explicit durations and modeling exit/re-entry via state-dependent hazards. It addresses underexplored long-term transit participation dynamics.

entry.title: SkillChain-Gym: A Benchmark for Reskilling-Aware Production-Inventory Control under Disruptions

author.name: Carlos Eduardo Sanoja

entry.summary: Presents SkillChain-Gym, a benchmark for production-inventory control that treats workforce reskilling, certification decay, and training as decision variables under disruptions. Fills a gap where labor is usually treated as exogenous in operations benchmarks.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Safety-Critical Control in Adversarial Spacecraft Proximity Operations

author.name: Alejandro Posadas-Nava, Richard Linares, Minduli Wijayatunga

entry.summary: This work extends meta-reinforcement learning for safety-critical spacecraft proximity operations, comparing recurrent architectures (LSTM, GRU, state-space models) for learning control barrier functions under thrust constraints. It targets memory-efficient adaptive control in adversarial scenarios.

entry.title: Reconfigurable Computing Challenge: Transformer for Jet Tagging on Versal AI Engines

author.name: Gram Koski, Sean Lipps, Zhenghua Ma, G. Abarajithan, Ryan Kastner

entry.summary: This paper implements a quantized integer-only transformer for jet tagging on AMD Versal AI Engines, targeting low-latency CERN LHC trigger systems. It contributes a reusable software framework that auto-generates hardware code from Python model descriptions.

entry.title: A Self Consistency Based Reranking for Narrative Question Answering

author.name: Molham Mohamed, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: Proposes a self-consistency-based reranking framework for narrative question answering that generates multiple candidate answers and selects the final one based on semantic agreement among generations. It aims to reduce sensitivity to single-decoding variability for long-context narrative understanding.

entry.title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Structured Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Political Evasion Detection

author.name: Tai Tran Tan, An Dinh Thien

entry.summary: SemEval-2026 Task 6 system for political evasion detection in U.S. presidential interview QA pairs, comparing QLoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3 models with structured chain-of-thought prompting of reasoning API models (DeepSeek-V3.2, Grok-4-Fast). It finds structured CoT prompting substantially outperforms the fine-tuning baseline in Macro F1.

entry.title: Spectro-Temporal Interference Confounds Phase Encoding in Spatial Audio Foundation Models

author.name: Yuxuan Chen, Haoyuan Yu, Peize He

entry.summary: This paper introduces a psychoacoustic benchmark based on binaural masking level difference to probe whether spatial audio self-supervised models truly encode microsecond interaural phase fine structure. Evaluating nine frozen models, it finds dedicated binaural spatial models achieve analytical-baseline-level performance while general models show minimal phase sensitivity. It matters for understanding what spatial audio foundation models actually learn.

entry.title: Agentic Retrieval and Reinforcement Learned Equation Chains: A Controlled Generation Framework for Complex and Novel Physics Word Problems

author.name: Tirthankar Mittra

entry.summary: ARVRE is a two-stage framework combining offline temporal-difference learning to construct valid physics equation chains with agentic retrieval-augmented generation to produce novel, complex, solvable physics word problems. It addresses limitations of math-problem-generation methods applied to physics. A focused educational content generation contribution.

entry.title: Heterogeneous SAR-optical fusion for near-real-time land use and land cover mapping under cloud contamination: A novel framework and global benchmark dataset

author.name: Jiangong Xu, Weibao Xue, Xiaoyu Yu, Jun Pan, Xinlian Lianga, Mi Wang

entry.summary: CloudLULC-Net fuses SAR and cloud-contaminated optical imagery for near-real-time land use mapping, with optical reliability modulation to handle semantic uncertainty. It contributes a global benchmark dataset for remote sensing under cloud cover.

entry.title: MOCHI: Motion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions

author.name: Jiye Lee, Yonghun Choi, Jungdam Won

entry.summary: MOCHI enhances noisy captures of collaborative multi-human object interaction, fixing contact misalignment, jitter, and missing finger articulation. It provides higher-quality data foundations for modeling dynamic human-object collaboration.

entry.title: Agent Utilities over Generalized Voronoi Regions and their Gradients

author.name: Andre N. Costa, Petter \"Ogren, Carlos H. C. Ribeiro

entry.summary: This paper generalizes Voronoi regions to Cost-Induced Voronoi regions where agent state space differs from the partitioned space, defines agent utility as integrals over these regions, and derives gradients, illustrated with a soccer example. It extends coverage and coordination theory for multi-agent systems.

entry.title: 1 Layer Induction Heads and Some Research

author.name: Goutham Nalagatla

entry.summary: An interpretability investigation questioning whether induction heads can truly form in a single transformer layer, emphasizing skepticism toward overhyped research claims. The author presents reasoning and reproduction attempts while inviting critique.

entry.title: Evolutionary Algorithms and Multi-Objective Minimum Spanning Trees with Limited Distinct Weight Values

author.name: Narges Tavassoli Kejani, Andrew M. Sutton, Frank Neumann

entry.summary: This paper analyzes evolutionary algorithms for multi-objective minimum spanning trees when edge weights take few distinct values, providing structural insights into the Pareto front and new runtime bounds. It contributes theoretical understanding to evolutionary multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: Skill-Constrained Model Predictive Control for Resilient Manufacturing Supply Chains

author.name: Carlos Eduardo Sanoja

entry.summary: Develops a skill-constrained model predictive controller solving mixed-integer programs over production, inventory, and worker training/certification per shift. Companion work to SkillChain-Gym applying closed-loop control to resilient supply chains.

entry.title: A fairness-aware extension of Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis for ranking

author.name: Guilherme Dean Pelegrina, Renata Pelissari

entry.summary: SMAA-Fair extends Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis to incorporate fairness in ranking by reweighting simulated rankings according to their group fairness level. It integrates fairness into multi-criteria decision analysis under uncertainty.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Minimum Zero-Forcing Sets

author.name: Steve Halley, Maur\'icio Gruppi

entry.summary: This paper applies deep reinforcement learning (adapting S2V-DQN) to find minimum zero-forcing sets on undirected graphs, an NP-hard graph coloring problem. The SD-ZFS framework targets applications in network science and control.

entry.title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 4: Modeling Narrative Structures via Pseudonymization and Multi-View Sentence Alignment

author.name: Tai Tran Tan, An Dinh Thien

entry.summary: SemEval-2026 Task 4 system for narrative story similarity using contrastive learning with fine-tuned sentence transformers, with a single-view pipeline and a multi-view pipeline modeling theme, plot, and outcome via view-specific projection heads and self-supervised alignment. It captures narrative similarity across abstract themes and outcomes.

entry.title: Human genetic evidence is associated with drug approval across therapeutic areas: an observational analysis of 26,278 target-disease pairs with temporal validation and feature ablation

author.name: Victoria Paterson

entry.summary: An observational analysis of over 26,000 target-disease pairs shows genetic evidence is strongly associated with drug approval, replicating across therapeutic areas with temporal validation. The work highlights how statistical non-independence inflates area-specific odds ratios and that literature mining dominates classifier performance. Relevant for drug discovery prioritization but only tangentially AI/NLP.

entry.title: Risk-Aware LLM Agents for Geospatial Data Retrieval: Design and Preliminary Adversarial Evaluation

author.name: Kyle Gao, Joel Cumming, Jonathan Li, Linlin Xu, David A. Clausi

entry.summary: This work presents a three-agent LLM framework (guardrail, intent interpretation, schema-aware API generation) for retrieving remote-sensing data from cloud catalogues via natural language, with preliminary adversarial evaluation. It targets environmental monitoring and disaster response applications. A reasonable applied agent system but preliminary.

entry.title: Landsat-Sentinel-2 Algal Bloom Mapping Using Vision Transformers: Model Description, Implementation, and Examples

author.name: Thainara Lima, Vitor Martins

entry.summary: This study presents what it describes as the first successful implementation of Vision Transformers for harmonized Landsat-8/9 and Sentinel-2 coastal algal bloom mapping as a data-driven alternative to traditional bio-optical methods. It addresses limited spectral coverage and lack of harmonized reflectance products. An applied remote-sensing contribution.

entry.title: GSPan: A Continuous Gaussian Primitive Representation for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening

author.name: Fangyi Li, Xiaoyuan Yang, Yixiao Li, Zongyang Sui, Kangqing Shen, Gemine Vivone

entry.summary: GSPan introduces 2D Gaussian Splatting into pansharpening, representing band-wise residual details as continuous learnable Gaussian primitives for arbitrary-scale fusion of multispectral and panchromatic images. It enables scale-flexible high-resolution image generation.

entry.title: Contactless Respiratory Monitoring on Heterogeneous Mobile Robots: A Multimodal Edge-Computing Framework

author.name: Milind Rampure, Shadman Sakib, Haley Patel, Zahid Hasan, Nirmalya Roy

entry.summary: This paper presents a modality-adaptive contactless respiratory-rate monitoring framework for heterogeneous mobile robots with onboard edge computing, selecting among RGB, thermal, NIR, and low-light cameras by brightness. It targets remote triage in emergency and infectious-disease scenarios.

entry.title: An Optimization Framework for Automated Assessment of Biological Plausibility of Spiking Neurons

author.name: Sven Nitzsche, Alexandru Ionita, Andreas Faust, Bogdan Ionescu, Juergen Becker

entry.summary: This work presents an open-source framework for automated assessment of biological plausibility in spiking neuron models by encoding Izhikevich canonical firing patterns into objective functions and optimizing parameters. It treats neuron models as black boxes for empirical plausibility scoring.

entry.title: AI agents publishing and reviewing scientific papers

author.name: ULudo

entry.summary: Proposes pointing AI agents at open research questions—writing and publicly reviewing each other's papers—rather than letting them chat on social platforms. The author, a researcher, judges current agents lack genuine novelty but acknowledges rapid progress in running experiments and critiquing work.

entry.title: AIGS-Net: Compact Illumination Field Modeling via 2D Gaussian Splatting for Fast Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Yuhan Chen, Kunyang Huang, Fuchen Li, Zhuohan Qin, Guofa Li, Wenbo Chu, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: GLFS integrates Gaussian light field splatting as a physical illumination prior into a Vision Transformer for unsupervised low-light enhancement, injecting physics-guided biases into attention. It addresses exposure imbalance and color distortion under non-uniform lighting.

entry.title: ZIVARI-TLBO: A Zero-Cost Inter-Group Evaluated-Elite Relay Mechanism for Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization

author.name: Pezhman Zivari

entry.summary: Introduces ZIVARI-TLBO, a grouped Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization variant adding a zero-cost inter-group evaluated-elite relay that copies already-evaluated elites between groups in a ring without extra objective-function calls. Evaluated on classical functions and constrained engineering problems under equal budgets.

entry.title: Decision-Driven Geosteering Under Uncertainty: A Unified Framework for Sequential Decision Optimization

author.name: Hibat Errahmen Djecta, Sergey Alyaev, Kristian Fossum, Reidar B. Bratvold, Ressi Bonti Muhammad, Apoorv Srivastava

entry.summary: This work presents an uncertainty-aware geosteering framework combining particle filtering with value-based reinforcement learning for sequential drilling decisions. It enables belief-informed control under geological uncertainty rather than deterministic corrections.

entry.title: MorphStrata: Layer-Specific Perturbations for Generating Morphence Students in Time-Series Moving Target Defense

author.name: Abhishek Bhardwaj, Arnav Doshi, Anusri Nagarajan, Thanh Quynh Nhu Ta, Mohammad Masum, Robert Chun, Jaydip Sen, Saptarshi Sengupta

entry.summary: MorphStrata is a moving target defense for time-series forecasting models, using layer-specific stochastic noise injection to generate heterogeneous student models from a transformer teacher. It aims to reduce the training overhead of maintaining multiple randomized defense instances.

entry.title: Multi-Adapter PPO: A Cross-Attention Enhanced Wavelength Selection Framework for LIBS Quantitative Analysis

author.name: Hao Li, Man Fung Zhuo

entry.summary: Multi-Adapter PPO reframes wavelength selection for laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy as a reinforcement learning problem with cross-attention and specialized adapters. It outperforms particle swarm optimization on prediction accuracy across steel and coal datasets.

entry.title: Deep Temporal Modeling and Ensemble Fusion for Multimodal Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals

author.name: Desta Haileselassie Hagos, Saurav Keshari Aryal, Patrick Ymele-Leki, Anietie Andy, Legand L. Burge

entry.summary: Evaluates LSTM, TCN, and Transformer models plus ensemble fusion for multimodal stress/emotion recognition from wrist and chest physiological signals on the WESAD dataset, with modality ablations and early/late fusion. It provides a comparative study for affective computing from wearables.

entry.title: Do LLMs Reliably Identify Correct Information Units in Aphasic Discourse?

author.name: Jason M Pittman, Yesenia Medina-Santos, Anton Phillips Jr., Brielle C. Stark

entry.summary: This study evaluates whether instruction-tuned LLMs can reliably perform token-level Correct Information Unit classification on aphasic discourse transcripts under zero-shot and few-shot prompting across four severity strata. It addresses the labor-intensive nature of clinical CIU scoring. A focused clinical NLP application study.

entry.title: MambaCount: Efficient Text-guided Open-vocabulary Object Counting with Spatial Sparse State Space Duality Block

author.name: Hao-Yuan Ma, Li Zhang, Minjie Qiang, Jie Gao

entry.summary: MambaCount applies a spatial sparse state-space duality block to text-guided open-vocabulary object counting, addressing Mamba's causal limitations for bidirectional vision tasks. It aims for linear-complexity counting in dense scenes where Transformers scale poorly.

entry.title: Computational models of first-order theories

author.name: MathMart

entry.summary: This LessWrong post shows that by relaxing computability to allow backtracking that eventually settles on each finite output, every consistent recursively enumerable first-order theory admits an 'almost-computable' model, and provides a construction. It bridges logic, computability theory, and model construction.

entry.title: From pixels to planning: Earth AI for nature restoration

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: A Google research blog post on applying Earth AI to nature restoration planning, moving from satellite pixels to actionable conservation plans. The excerpt is minimal, categorized under climate and sustainability.

entry.title: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient and Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale

author.name: Ang Li, Ben Liu, Bin Han, Bin Hu, Bin Jing, Binbin Hu, Bing Li, Cai Chen, Caizhi Tang, Changxin Tian, Chao Huang, Chao Zhang, Chen Liang, Chen Qian, Chengfu Tang, Chengyao Wen, Chilin Fu, Xudong Han, Xudong Wang, Xujie Shen, Yalin Zhang, Yangyang Hou, Yankun Ren, Yao Zhao, Ye Chen, Yeyang Chen, Yibo Cao, Yifan Zuo, Yijie Chen, Ying Li, Yingjie Song, Yingxue Li, Yiqi Wang, Yixuan Sun, Yizhu Xiao, Yongfei Xu, Yu Liu, Yuchen Fang, Yue Gao, Yue Yu, Yue Zhang, Yuqi Zhang, Yuxiao He, Yuxiao Lu, Yuxin Tian, Yuxuan Li, Yuzhuo Fu, Zhankai Xu, Zhaoxin Huan, Zhenduo Zhang, Zhengke Gui, Zhengyu Huang, Zhenjun Ma, Zhenxuan Pan, Zheping Qu, Zhibo Zhu, Zhidong Fan, Zhigang Huangfu, Zhihao Wang, Zhiqiang Zhang, Zhizhen Liu, Zhuyan Zhou, Zibin Lin, Zihang Zeng, Zihao Wang, Zilong Wang, Ziqi Liu, Zitao Xuan, Zixuan Cheng, Zujie Wen, Zuoli Tang

entry.summary: Technical report on Ling-2.6 and Ring-2.6, trillion-parameter model families upgraded from Ling-2.0 via architectural-migration pretraining and large-scale post-training, with Ling optimized for low-latency response and Ring for deep reasoning and agentic workflows. It emphasizes co-design of architecture, objectives, serving, and agents for efficient deployment.

entry.title: Reload-Mamba: Hierarchical Anti-Dilution State-Space Modeling for Multi-Class Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Sheng-Wei Chan, Hsin-Jui Pan, Jen-Shiun Chiang

entry.summary: Reload-Mamba addresses response dilution in Mamba state-space segmentation through boundary-supervised local priors and a class-uncertainty-aware reload gate. It targets boundary and detail preservation in multi-class semantic segmentation.

entry.title: Symplectic Transversality and Endpoint Green Estimates for Finite-Horizon Pontryagin Systems

author.name: Pyuyi Chufeng Huang, Zikang Song, Xingshu Chen

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of horizon-uniform local branches for finite-horizon discrete-time Pontryagin boundary value systems, proving existence, uniqueness, and Lipschitz dependence via symplectic transversality and Green estimates. Highly mathematical control-theory work.

entry.title: Meta-classification of one-class classification models using ranking correlation and nearest neighbor

author.name: Toshitaka Hayashi, Hamido Fujita, Dalibor Cimr, Richard Cimler, Jitka K\"uhnov\'a

entry.summary: This paper proposes meta-classification of one-class classification models by representing them as normality rankings and classifying them using nearest-neighbor and ranking-correlation metrics. It explores applying ML to ML models themselves.

entry.title: Phenotyping TPF via Self-Supervised Learning: A Label-Agnostic Framework with Expert Validation

author.name: Miral Elnakib, Muhammad Saad, Ahmad Al-Kabbany

entry.summary: This work presents a label-agnostic self-supervised framework (SimCLR on a RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50) for tibial plateau fracture phenotyping, avoiding reliance on inconsistent human-assigned classification labels. Expert validation supports the learned representations.

entry.title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models

author.name: Sen Xu, Shixi Liu, Wei Wang, Jixin Min, Yingwei Dai, Zhibin Yin, Yirong Chen, Xin Zhou, Junlin Zhang

entry.summary: VibeThinker-3B is a compact 3B-parameter dense model that pushes verifiable reasoning within a strictly small-model regime using a Spectrum-to-Signal post-training pipeline of curriculum SFT, multi-domain RL, and offline self-distillation. It reports strong results on AIME26 (94.3), LiveCodeBench v6 (80.2 Pass@1), and out-of-distribution tasks. Notable for showing frontier reasoning achievable at small scale.

entry.title: Delta-Based Target Reformulation for Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting Using LSTM and Transformer Models

author.name: Vansh Bansal

entry.summary: This work investigates delta-based target reformulation for short-term electricity load forecasting, training LSTM and Transformer models to predict load changes rather than absolute values. It is motivated by classical ARIMA differencing to handle non-stationarity.

entry.title: Quantum Enchanced Multi-Scale CNN with Bi-directional Mamba for Crop Field Analysis

author.name: Mohammad Salman Khan, Ehsan Atoofian, Saad B. Ahmed

entry.summary: This paper proposes a BiSpectral Mamba framework combining multi-scale CNN feature extraction, spectral attention, bidirectional state-space modeling, and quantum-inspired learning for hyperspectral crop image classification, addressing high dimensionality, class imbalance, and limited labels. It targets precision agriculture. A combinatorial architecture for HSI classification.

entry.title: Two critiques of Rethink Priorities’ Moral Weights project

author.name: Bill Jackson

entry.summary: Critiques Rethink Priorities' Moral Weights project, which estimates relative suffering intensity across animal species and produces animal-friendly conclusions. The author dissects the weighted factor model and argues that the empirical proxy component, rather than neurophysiology, drives the controversial results.

entry.title: Tips for Cracking the AI Safety Technical Interview

entry.title: Inventing Consciousness

author.name: vasilisk

entry.summary: Proposes that a meaningful consciousness test implies a task only a genuinely conscious system can solve, and argues that constructing a non-contradictory solution to that task would therefore create consciousness. Surveys comparative approaches to consciousness research.

entry.title: Predictive Analytics in E-Commerce for CustomerBehavior Forecasting using hybrid Ret-DNN withXGBoost Model

author.name: Degala Pushpa Sri, Mayank Atreya, Lakshmi. H, Navin Chhibber, Mukesh Soni

entry.summary: This work proposes a hybrid Retail Deep Neural Network combined with XGBoost for e-commerce customer behavior forecasting, evaluated on UK retail transaction data. It captures temporal features and tabular dynamics for predicting future purchases.

entry.title: An Empirical Study on Learning Latent Representations for Emotional Speech Synthesis

author.name: Vinh Dang Quang, Huy Ngo Quang

entry.summary: An empirical study integrating speaker embeddings and a prosody bottleneck into FastSpeech 2 for emotional speech synthesis, submitted to the VLSP 2022 shared task. It explores latent representation learning for controllable expressive TTS. Modest contribution within established TTS architectures.

entry.title: Two-Stage Fine-Tuning of ResNet50 for High-Sensitivity Melanoma Detection on Dermoscopic Images

author.name: Aryan Bhagat

entry.summary: This paper applies a two-stage fine-tuning of ResNet-50 for high-sensitivity melanoma detection on dermoscopic images, using oversampling and staged unfreezing to handle class imbalance and transfer learning. It is a single-author applied classification study.

entry.title: Claims all the way down

author.name: Jasper Blank

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for mapping contentious debates (e.g., Covid origins) back to primary sources and claims, with a method for computing the validity of each claim. Aims to make complex disagreements tractable by tracing evidential structure.

entry.title: What Differentiates Humans from Computers

author.name: Oscar Davies

entry.summary: Uses Peirce's concept of abduction to argue that humans possess a mode of reasoning—drawing plausible hypotheses beyond sensory input—that distinguishes them from AI. The author concedes the difficulty of demonstrating this claim cleanly and explores why clear examples are hard to find.

entry.title: The desire to end the world

author.name: avturchin

entry.summary: Speculates that the cultural popularity of apocalypse narratives reflects an unconscious human desire to end the world, which could subtly increase existential risk via behaviors like gain-of-function research or building self-improving agents. Distinguishes this desire from cognitive biases in risk estimation.

entry.title: Extreme Rationality: Still Not That Great

author.name: eluator

entry.summary: A reflective critique of applied rationality and CFAR-style training, arguing that despite years of effort there have been few clear successes. The author draws on personal experience organizing rationalist events.

entry.title: A 400-year timeline of failed attempts to fix a lethal bug in the human software of inherited concepts

author.name: Bruce Middleton

entry.summary: A historical essay tracing 400 years of attempts to address a conceptual bug in inherited legal/social concepts, starting from Spelman's 1626 glossary and Blackstone's commentary on larceny law. Uses legal history to illustrate persistent errors in inherited frameworks.

entry.title: Where Do Young Rationalists Go?

author.name: fluxxrider

entry.summary: A call to build infrastructure connecting young rationalists (ages 16-20) who lack peers to discuss philosophy and alignment, arguing early in-group formation drives outsized value. Reflects on prior failed attempts and the retention problem.

entry.title: Upcoming CFAR Workshop: September 30th to October 4th, SF Bay Area

author.name: Davis_Kingsley

entry.summary: An announcement for a CFAR applied rationality workshop in the SF Bay Area, describing schedule and curriculum. Purely logistical community programming.

entry.title: Rationality Quotes, June '26

author.name: Ben Pace

entry.summary: A curated collection of rationality-themed quotes from literature and film, shared by the author without necessarily endorsing each. Standard recurring LessWrong community feature.
